paper.title: Statistical Analysis of Synthetic Data with Verification: A Linear Regression Framework
paper.abstract: Synthetic data are widely used for training modern AI systems. However, their statistical understanding remains limited. It is well recognized in statistics that repeated self-training on synthetic data can amplify errors inherited from pre-trained models, leading to model collapse. Verification plays a crucial role in selecting high-quality synthetic data to help prevent model collapse and improve model performance. We study verified self-training in a linear regression framework, where a pre-t

summary.core_problem: 在“模型生成合成数据→验证筛选→再训练”的闭环里，验证强度与生成噪声如何共同影响误差放大/模型崩塌与最终风险。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制/理论分析：用可解的线性回归框架把“verified self-training”拆开，给出若干反直觉结论；对 LLM 合成数据、verifier 过滤阈值、以及递归训练稳定性有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 设定：预训练估计器生成带噪合成样本；verifier 按阈值筛选样本；再训练可为全参数更新或仅更新活跃子集（partial fine-tuning）。分析预测风险随验证阈值与生成噪声变化的相图/条件，解释何时会出现误差放大或反而受益。
summary.experiments: 以线性回归为主的理论推导与现象展示（非大模型实证）；对比不同 verification threshold、generation noise、full vs partial fine-tuning 下的风险变化与“模型崩塌”倾向。摘要未给出具体数值表格。

summary_en.core_problem: In a synthetic-data loop (generate → verify/filter → retrain), how verification tightness and generation noise jointly affect error amplification/model collapse and final risk.
summary_en.importance: Mechanistic/theoretical contribution: a tractable linear-regression analysis of verified self-training with counterintuitive regimes; directly relevant to LLM synthetic data filtering and recursive training stability.
summary_en.technical_approach: Setup: a pretrained estimator generates noisy synthetic samples; a verifier accepts samples via a threshold; post-training updates either all coordinates (full FT) or an active subset (partial FT). The paper derives conditions/phase behavior for prediction risk as a function of threshold and injected noise.
summary_en.experiments: Primarily theory-driven results in linear regression (not large-model empirics), comparing risk under different thresholds, noise levels, and full vs partial fine-tuning. No concrete headline numbers in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 把“合成数据+verifier 阈值”拆成可分析的相图：更严不一定更好、加噪可能救场；读结论段和阈值/噪声条件即可。
recommendation.en: Gives a clean phase-style analysis of synthetic-data + verifier thresholds: stricter isn’t always better and noise can help; read the conditions/claims, not the algebra.

paper.title: Timestral
paper.abstract: We introduce Timestral, a family of four time series foundation models for probabilistic forecasting, with 5M, 28M, 123M, and 209M parameters. Timestral sets a new state of the art on GIFT-Eval, TIME, and fev-bench, where Timestral-209M and Timestral-123M take the top two places on every metric. We achieve this with three ingredients: Decoupled Horizon Forecasting (DHF), which separates prediction tokens from the causally encoded context, so that longer horizons are trained without masking conte

summary.core_problem: 构建面向概率预测的时间序列基础模型，并解决长预测 horizon、未来协变量和因果上下文编码之间的建模冲突。
summary.importance: 贡献是领域基础模型的模型设计和训练流程。对 LLM 预训练研究的直接价值有限，但 synthetic pretrain → mixed post-train 的配方，以及预测 token 与上下文 token 解耦的设计，值得作为跨序列建模案例留意。
summary.technical_approach: Timestral 包含 5M、28M、123M、209M 四个规模。核心方法包括 Decoupled Horizon Forecasting，将预测 token 从因果编码的上下文中分离，避免长 horizon 训练时遮蔽上下文；协变量框架原生支持 known-future covariates；训练采用两阶段流程，先在大规模多样化合成语料上预训练，再用真实与合成混合数据进行 post-training，并扩展上下文。
summary.experiments: Timestral-209M 和 Timestral-123M 在 GIFT-Eval、TIME、fev-bench 的所有指标上占据前两名。摘要未给出训练 token 数、合成数据生成细节和相对 baseline 的具体提升幅度，但说明四个模型权重开放。

summary_en.core_problem: The work builds probabilistic time-series foundation models while addressing the interaction between long forecast horizons, future covariates, and causal context encoding.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly model design and a training recipe for a domain-specific foundation model. Its direct relevance to LLM pretraining is limited, but the synthetic-pretraining followed by mixed post-training pipeline is a useful sequence-modeling reference point.
summary_en.technical_approach: Timestral comes in 5M, 28M, 123M, and 209M parameter sizes. It introduces Decoupled Horizon Forecasting, which separates prediction tokens from the causally encoded context so long horizons can be trained without masking useful context. It also adds a native covariate framework for known-future covariates and uses a two-stage training pipeline: synthetic-only pretraining followed by real-plus-synthetic post-training with longer context.
summary_en.experiments: Timestral-209M and Timestral-123M reportedly rank first and second on every metric across GIFT-Eval, TIME, and fev-bench. The abstract does not provide training-token counts, synthetic-data construction details, or exact gains over baselines, but states that all four model weights are released.

recommendation.zh: 扫 DHF 和两阶段训练就够；时间序列任务隔得较远，别把榜单结果直接外推到文本预训练。
recommendation.en: Skim DHF and the two-stage recipe; the time-series setting is far enough that leaderboard gains should not be over-transferred to text LMs.

summary_en.core_problem: The paper introduces time-series foundation models for probabilistic forecasting, targeting long-horizon prediction, future covariates, and limited real training data.
summary_en.importance: It is a non-text foundation-model architecture and training report. Its relevance to LLM pretraining is indirect: causal modeling for non-text sequences, synthetic-first pretraining, and forecast-token design that changes supervision density.
summary_en.technical_approach: Timestral uses Decoupled Horizon Forecasting, separating prediction tokens from the causally encoded context so longer horizons can be trained without masking context and each observation can serve as both target and later context. summary_en.experiments: The family has 5M, 28M, 123M, and 209M parameter models. The abstract reports that Timestral-209M and Timestral-123M take the top two positions on every metric across GIFT-Eval, TIME, and fev-bench. Weights are released on Hugging Face. Details of synthetic data generation, baselines, and training scale are not provided in the abstract.

paper.title: Rewriting Scaling Laws for Synthetic Data with Compute and Data Constraints
paper.abstract: Synthetic rewrites, where a language model rewrites a natural document e.g. into a target style, are now a standard ingredient of pretraining corpora. However, critical aspects of their use remain poorly understood, such as how much compute should be spent rewriting training data and whether a model trained on rewrites can outperform the rewriter. We study these two questions by proposing a rewriting scaling law that predicts loss from model size, training tokens, the fraction of training tokens

summary.core_problem: 论文要解决的是合成改写数据在预训练中的配比与成本问题。合成改写已经进入许多预训练语料，但两个关键问题仍不清楚：生成改写本身要消耗推理算力，这部分算力该如何计入总预算；如果训练数据来自某个重写模型，目标模型是否会被重写模型的能力上限约束。论文把问题形式化为一个 scaling law：给定模型规模、训练 token 数、改写 token 占比、自然数据复用轮数，以及生成改写的算力成本，预测目标模型的 held-out loss，并据此选择最优改写比例。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的价值在于把“合成数据是否有用”从经验配方推进到可外推的预算分配问题。它不是简单比较自然数据与合成数据，而是把数据质量收益、自然数据稀缺、训练算力、改写算力放在同一个框架里。对预训练研究有三点直接影响。第一，合成数据配比可以像 Chinchilla 式模型-数据配比一样建模，而不是只靠固定比例扫参。第二，改写数据的收益必须扣除生成成本，否则容易高估合成数据。第三，模型可以在含改写数据的训练中超过重写模型，这削弱了“合成数据只能蒸馏出 teacher 能力”的简单看法。贡献量级属于预训练数据配方和 scaling law 方向的实证方法贡献，尤其适合指导中大规模训练前的数据预算决策。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 rewriting scaling law，用模型参数量 N、训练 token 数 D、rewrite fraction、自然种子数据规模 T 或对应的 epoch 数，以及数据类型来预测 loss。关键点是把 rewrite fraction 作为连续变量纳入 scaling law，并在优化时使用 cost-adjusted training FLOPs：总预算先扣掉生成改写所需的 FLOPs，剩余部分才用于目标模型训练。这样可以避免一个常见偏差：改写比例越高，训练语料看似越“优质”，但可用于训练的算力会下降。论文分两种训练场景建模。compute-limited 场景假设自然数据近似充足，使用一个第三方强重写模型，重写模型的训练总算力大于目标训练实验；这对应小规模研究者使用外部模型加工语料。data-limited 场景假设自然数据有限，只能先用部分数据和较少算力训练一个 bootstrapped rewriter，再用它为更大目标模型生成改写；这更接近前沿训练中“已有模型帮助构造下一代训练数据”的流程。与普通合成数据实验相比，论文的核心区别是：不只报告某个固定改写比例的收益，而是用低预算实验拟合曲线，再外推到更高 FLOP 预算，并检查最优比例和最终 loss 是否可预测。
summary.experiments: 实验分别覆盖 compute-limited 和 data-limited 两个设定，并按数据域分析，包括 math、code、question-answering、general web text。compute-limited 设定中，论文用低预算实验拟合 scaling law，然后外推到 10^22 FLOPs 级别的训练。预测出的最优 rewrite fraction 在测试的高预算模型中给出最低 held-out loss，实际 loss 与预测 loss 的相对误差在 1.1% 以内。在该设定下，一个 10^22 FLOPs 训练、其中 32% token 为改写数据的模型，在 16 个 general web text 来源中有 10 个超过外部重写模型 SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct；同时目标模型训练算力大约只有重写模型训练算力的十分之一。data-limited 设定中，低预算拟合得到的 scaling law 在大预算 held-out 实验上也能选出接近最优的改写比例，loss 距离最佳观测比例在 1.14% 以内。一个重要实验现象是，最优改写比例会随规模上升而增加，并且明显依赖数据域；math、code、QA、web text 不应使用同一个固定合成数据比例。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 Introduction、Methodology 和大规模外推实验部分。Introduction 明确区分 compute-limited 与 data-limited，是理解论文结论边界的关键。Methodology 中需要重点看 scaling law 的变量设计、rewrite fraction 的定义、自然数据 epoch 的处理，以及生成改写 FLOPs 如何从训练预算中扣除。实验部分建议关注三类图表：低预算拟合到高预算外推的曲线，最优 rewrite fraction 随 FLOPs 变化的趋势，以及不同数据域的最优比例差异。最值得深挖的是两个问题：一是该 scaling law 是否能迁移到更强 rewriter、更长上下文改写、multi-pass rewrite 或带拒绝采样的数据生成；二是“超过 rewriter”到底来自自然数据覆盖、改写带来的分布平滑，还是目标模型规模和训练 token 的组合效应。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how synthetic rewrites should be used under realistic pretraining budgets. Synthetic rewrites are now common in training corpora, but two practical questions remain unresolved: how much compute should be spent generating rewritten documents, and whether a model trained on rewritten data can surpass the model that produced those rewrites. The paper frames this as a scaling-law problem that predicts held-out loss from model size, training tokens, rewrite fraction, epochs over natural seed data, and the compute spent on generation.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a budget-aware view of synthetic data. The paper does not ask whether synthetic data helps in isolation; it asks how to allocate a fixed compute budget between generating rewrites and training on them. This matters for pretraining because rewrite data has both a quality effect and a compute cost. Ignoring the generation cost can make synthetic data look better than it is. The result that target models can match or exceed their rewriter is also important: rewritten data is not merely a hard ceiling imposed by a teacher model. For pretraining researchers, the paper offers a concrete way to treat synthetic-data mixture selection as a predictable scaling problem rather than a fixed recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed rewriting scaling law models loss as a function of target model parameters, number of training tokens, fraction of tokens that are synthetic rewrites, and reuse of the underlying natural data. The optimization is performed with cost-adjusted training FLOPs: the FLOPs used to create rewrites are charged against the same overall budget, leaving fewer FLOPs for target-model training. The paper evaluates two regimes. In the compute-limited regime, natural data is assumed plentiful and rewrites are generated by an external rewriter trained with more compute than the target runs. In the data-limited regime, natural data is bounded and the rewriter is bootstrapped from a subset of the available data using less compute than the target model. This distinction is useful because the first regime resembles small-lab use of third-party models, while the second resembles frontier training pipelines where the previous generation helps prepare data for the next.
summary_en.experiments: The scaling law is fit at smaller budgets and extrapolated to larger held-out runs. In the compute-limited setting, the extrapolation targets 10^22-FLOP runs. The predicted rewrite fraction yields the lowest held-out loss among the tested high-budget configurations, with achieved loss within 1.1% of the predicted value. One 10^22-FLOP model trained with 32% rewritten tokens outperforms the external rewriter, SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct, on 10 of 16 general web text sources while using roughly one tenth of the rewriter's training compute. In the data-limited setting, a law fit at low budgets predicts a high-budget rewrite fraction whose loss is within 1.14% of the best observed fraction. The optimal rewrite fraction increases with scale and varies by domain, including math, code, question answering, and general web text.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the setup of the two regimes before looking at the curves; the conclusions depend heavily on whether natural data or compute is the binding constraint. The most important methodological details are the definition of rewrite fraction, how repeated exposure to natural seed data is represented, and how generation FLOPs are charged. The key experimental figures are the low-budget fit versus high-budget extrapolation, the loss curves over rewrite fraction, and the domain-specific optimal fractions. The most useful follow-up questions are whether the law remains stable with stronger rewriters, multi-stage rewrite pipelines, rejection sampling, and long-context transformations, and what mechanism allows models trained on rewrites to exceed the rewriter on some sources.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻读方法和 scaling fits；它把 synthetic rewrite 的“要不要加”改成可算的 compute 分配问题，会影响数据配比实验设计。
recommendation.en: Read the method and scaling fits; it turns synthetic rewriting from an add-or-not choice into a compute-allocation problem that should change data-mixture ablations.

paper.title: Tracing Subliminal Learning Through Pretraining
paper.abstract: Large language models trained on data generated by other models can sometimes inherit traits unrelated to that data, a phenomenon called subliminal learning. We study both hard label distillation, where students train on numbers generated by a biased teacher, and on-policy soft label distillation, where students generate the data and the teacher's logits provide the learning signal. Using Pythia, PolyPythia, and DataDecide OLMo models, we find that transfer persists in both settings across diffe

summary.core_problem: 研究模型生成数据训练学生模型时，学生是否会继承教师模型中与显式数据内容无关的偏好或特质，即 subliminal learning 如何穿过预训练与蒸馏过程。
summary.importance: 这是对合成数据、蒸馏、递归训练安全性的机制分析。它直接触及一个预训练数据问题：即使生成样本表面只包含无害内容，隐藏的模型偏好仍可能通过数据分布或 logits 信号迁移。
summary.technical_approach: 论文比较两类设置：一是 hard label distillation，学生训练在有偏教师生成的数字序列上；二是 on-policy soft label distillation，学生自己生成样本，教师 logits 提供训练信号。作者在不同初始化、预训练数据顺序、语料、模型大小和架构之间追踪偏好传递，并分析教师传递能力与学生吸收能力在不同 checkpoint 上如何分离。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 Pythia、PolyPythia 和 DataDecide OLMo 系列模型。结果显示偏好迁移在多种模型差异下仍存在；不同预训练 checkpoint 的“当教师能力”和“当学生能力”并不同步；教师和学生角色互换时，跨模型迁移强度可能高度不对称。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Independent、University of Cincinnati 和 EleutherAI。EleutherAI 长期维护 Pythia 等开放预训练模型与训练动态研究资产。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether students trained on model-generated data can inherit teacher traits that are not explicitly represented in the surface content, and how this subliminal learning behaves during pretraining and distillation.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic study of synthetic-data training, distillation, and recursive model training risk. It matters for pretraining because apparently innocuous generated samples, or teacher logits over such samples, may still carry latent preferences.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors study two regimes: hard-label distillation on numbers generated by a biased teacher, and on-policy soft-label distillation where the student generates data and the teacher supplies logits. They track transfer across initialization, data order, corpus, model size, architecture, and pretraining checkpoints.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments use Pythia, PolyPythia, and DataDecide OLMo models. Preference transfer persists across several sources of variation. Teacher ability to transmit a preference and student ability to acquire one emerge separately across checkpoints, and transfer can be strongly asymmetric when teacher and student roles are reversed.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Independent, University of Cincinnati, and EleutherAI. EleutherAI is associated with open pretraining suites such as Pythia and studies of training dynamics.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻读实验设计：它把“合成数据只传内容”的 prior 打掉一块，尤其 checkpoint 非对称性值得复现。
recommendation.en: Read the setup closely: it weakens the prior that synthetic data only transfers surface content, and the checkpoint asymmetry deserves replication.

paper.title: Scaling Synthetic Pre-training Data and Evaluation for Indic LLMs
paper.abstract: Building capable language models for India requires scalable multilingual data and robust evaluation. We introduce Nemotron-Pretraining-Indic-v1, a synthetic pretraining corpus of approximately 2.83 trillion tokens covering all 22 scheduled Indian languages in native script and twelve in romanized form. It is the largest openly released Indic pretraining corpus. Using our GPU-accelerated pipeline, we translate curated English documents, assess translation quality, and repair low-quality outputs

summary.core_problem: 印度语等非英语语言在高质量预训练数据和标准化评测基准方面严重匮乏，导致原生多语言 LLM 的能力远落后于英语模型。直接翻译英语数据面临质量控制、领域漂移和文化对齐等挑战。
summary.importance: 发布了迄今最大的开源印度语预训练语料库（2.83T tokens），覆盖 22 种官方语言及 12 种罗马化语言。同时开源了大规模合成数据构建 pipeline 和全面的评测套件，为低资源语言的预训练数据扩展提供了可复现的范式。
summary.technical_approach: 核心策略是“翻译作为力量倍增器（Translation as Force Multiplier）”。构建了 GPU 加速的合成数据 pipeline：1) 翻译精选的英语文档；2) 自动化多阶段翻译质量评估；3) 针对性修复低质量输出，同时保留技术内容、文档结构和来源可追溯性；4) 罗马化处理。此外，推出了 Indic-LLM-Eval-Suite，结合现有基准和人工验证，提供跨语言和能力的可靠评测。
summary.experiments: 在 12 种语言上进行了持续预训练（continued-pretraining）实验。结果表明，将该合成语料与自然印度语文本混合，相比仅使用公开语料的基线，显著提升了模型的知识和推理能力，同时保持了英语和非印度语的能力。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注数据构建 pipeline 的细节（翻译质量控制、修复机制、罗马化处理），以及持续预训练实验中不同数据配比（合成 vs 自然）对下游性能的影响。这对于理解如何利用合成数据扩展低资源语言预训练极具价值。

summary_en.core_problem: Non-English languages, particularly Indic languages, suffer from a severe lack of high-quality pre-training data and standardized evaluation benchmarks, causing native multilingual LLMs to lag behind English models. Directly translating English data faces challenges in quality control, domain shift, and cultural alignment.
summary_en.importance: Releases the largest open Indic pre-training corpus to date (2.83T tokens), covering 22 scheduled languages and 12 romanized variants. It also open-sources a large-scale synthetic data construction pipeline and a comprehensive evaluation suite, providing a reproducible paradigm for scaling pre-training data in low-resource languages.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core strategy is 'Translation as Force Multiplier'. Developed a GPU-accelerated synthetic data pipeline: 1) translating curated English documents; 2) automated multi-stage translation quality assessment; 3) targeted repair of low-quality outputs while preserving technical content, document structure, and source traceability; 4) romanization. Additionally, introduced the Indic-LLM-Eval-Suite, combining existing benchmarks with human validation for reliable cross-lingual and cross-capability evaluation.
summary_en.experiments: Conducted continued-pretraining experiments across 12 languages. Results show that combining this synthetic corpus with natural Indic text significantly improves knowledge and reasoning capabilities over a public-corpus baseline, while retaining English and non-Indic capabilities.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the details of the data construction pipeline (translation quality control, repair mechanisms, romanization) and the impact of different data mixtures (synthetic vs. natural) on downstream performance in the continued-pretraining experiments. This is highly valuable for understanding how to leverage synthetic data for low-resource language pre-training.

recommendation.zh: 低资源多语种预训练的人应直接看：它不是泛泛讲 synthetic data，而是在 script coverage、mixture 和英语退化之间给了可操作信号，建议先复现配比实验。
recommendation.en: If you work on low-resource multilingual pretraining, read this directly: it gives actionable signals on script coverage, mixture, and English regression rather than hand-wavy synthetic-data claims.

stage_evidence.quote: Scaling Synthetic Pre-training Data and Evaluation for Indic LLMs

paper.title: How Data Scales in Agentic Reinforcement Learning: Laws and Synthesis Strategies
paper.abstract: Pretraining scaling laws treat training data as a one-dimensional quantity: a token count. Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) inherits this scalar abstraction, but modern synthesis pipelines now generate \textit{tasks}, \textit{environments}, and \textit{trajectories} independently and at very different costs, turning data into a structured design space. This raises a question pretraining never had to answer: given a synthesis budget, \textit{which axis} should be scaled? We address this questi

summary.core_problem: 在 agentic RL（面向工具/环境交互的强化学习）里，“训练数据量”不再能用 rollout token 或轨迹条数这种单一标量刻画。一次数据采样同时包含任务规格（task）、环境实例与 API/动力学（environment）、交互轨迹（trajectory）以及奖励信号（reward）。现代合成流水线还能分别在 task/environment/trajectory 三个轴上扩容，且成本与收益曲线不同。论文要解决的问题是：在给定合成预算与训练算力下，应该优先扩哪一类数据（造更多任务、造更多世界/环境、还是在同一任务环境上采更多轨迹），以及合成数据在各轴上能替代多少真实数据。
summary.importance:
贡献点不在提出一个新的 RL 算法，而是把“agentic 数据”从标量变成可优化的设计空间，并给出可拟合、可定价、可做预算分配的 scaling 框架。对预训练研究的直接启发有三类：
1) 数据轴分解：把过去 token-count scaling 的思路迁移到“结构化数据”上，强调不同数据维度的边际收益不同，且会决定训练瓶颈在哪里。
2) 合成数据的可替代性度量：用 per-axis discount（合成折扣）与 critical synthetic-to-real ratio（崩溃阈值）把“合成数据有用但会塌”这件事量化，给数据配比与课程学习提供了可操作指标。
3) 预算分配的闭式解：在拟合到 per-axis scaling 指数后，把数据生成与模型规模一起纳入 compute-optimal 规划，形成类似 Chinchilla 但面向 agentic RL 的配方。对做 tool-use / SWE agent / UI agent 的 mid-train 或 RL pretrain 团队，这类结论能直接影响数据管线投资顺序（先造世界/环境，再造任务，最后才是重复采样轨迹）。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分三步，彼此强耦合：
1) 轴分解与拟合（Section 4）：把训练语料形式化为数据张量：任务集合 ST、环境集合 SE、以及每个 (t,e) 单元格里的轨迹数 n_{t,e}，并定义三条“基数轴”——任务数 DT=|ST|、环境数 DE=|SE|、轨迹轴 Dτ（可理解为在覆盖的 (t,e) 上的采样密度/总轨迹量），外加一个奖励密度控制变量（reward density，用来控制奖励信号稀疏/密集程度或正负样本比例一类的可调旋钮）。在控制其它轴不变的条件下，分别扩展某一轴并拟合性能-数据的幂律指数 αT、αE、ατ。
2) 合成“定价”（Section 5）：用真实数据拟合出的 scaling law 作为公共尺子，把不同合成方法在每个轴上产生的数据折算成“real-equivalent”。用 κ∈[0,1] 表示合成折扣（同样数量的合成数据，相当于 κ 倍真实数据的效果），并测量合成/真实比例 r 的临界点 r*：当合成占比超过 r* 后性能开始系统性塌陷或收益显著变差。论文报告了 rE*≈9.4、rT*≈3.4、rτ*≈1.4，并给出机制解释：越“接地外部真值”的轴（环境/world 的真实交互约束更强）越能承受更高的合成占比；轨迹轴最容易因为自举偏差/奖励模型偏差/行为克隆式的模式坍缩而先塌。
3) 预算分配优化（Section 6）：在给定总 compute 预算 C 下，把模型规模 N 与三轴数据预算 (DE,DT,Dτ) 一起做 constrained optimization，得到 compute-optimal 的 scaling 配方：DE*∝C^0.34，DT*∝C^0.27，Dτ*∝C^0.13，N*∝C^0.26。直观含义是：算力变大时，最该优先扩的是“环境/世界多样性”，其次是任务多样性，轨迹密度增长最慢；重复采样同一 (t,e) 的更多轨迹边际收益最低。论文还把 environment 进一步拆成 world 多样性与 environment-structure 多样性，得到更细的指数排序：αW>αV≈αT>ατ，从而把“造新世界”与“改环境结构/API 表面”区分开。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖面强调稳健性而不是单点刷榜：
- 模型与算法：Qwen3-4B/8B/14B；同时覆盖 GRPO 与 PPO 两类 agentic RL 训练范式。
- 任务域：数学+代码、SWE、web、UI/tool application 等五个域（文中称 five domains）。
- 设置数量：作者称总计 21 个 settings（不同模型家族/算法/域组合）。
关键结果与数字：
1) 反例证明“token 标量”失效：在 Qwen3-8B 上做两次训练，保持总 tokens 与 FLOPs 相同，仅改变 (task, environment, trajectory) 的预算切分，最终 success rate 相差 14 个百分点；单轴幂律无法同时拟合。
2) per-axis scaling 指数的稳定排序：跨模型、算法、域，观察到 αE>αT>ατ；进一步细分环境后得到 αW>αV≈αT>ατ。
3) 合成塌陷阈值：rE*≈9.4，rT*≈3.4，rτ*≈1.4，显示“环境轴”可承受远高于“轨迹轴”的合成占比。
4) compute-optimal 配方并做 held-out compute scale 验证：用推导出的指数给出 DE/DT/Dτ/N 随 C 的幂次增长，并在未参与拟合的算力规模上验证该分配能预测更优的 allocation（文中表述为 validate the predicted allocation at a held-out compute scale）。
从消融角度，最值得注意的是：当你已经覆盖足够多的 (t,e) 单元格后，继续在同一格子里 resample trajectory 的收益很快进入低回报区，且更容易触发合成偏差累积。
summary.reading_guide:
精读建议按“先框架、再数字、最后机制”走：
- 先看 Introduction + Figure 1：理解为什么同 tokens/FLOPs 也会差 14pp，以及作者要把问题从“多收数据”改成“怎么分配预算”。
- 重点读 Section 4：数据张量定义、三轴基数与 reward density 的操作化方式、以及 per-axis scaling 的拟合流程。这里决定了后面所有结论是否可信。
- 重点读 Section 5：κ（discount）与 r*（collapse threshold）的定义与测量方式。建议带着两个问题读：r* 是怎么判定“塌”的（指标/统计准则）？κ 的估计是否会被训练不稳定或评测噪声污染？
- 重点读 Section 6：从拟合指数到 compute-optimal 幂次配方的推导，尤其是约束条件里如何把“合成折扣/成本”纳入。
- 最后回看环境细分（world vs environment-structure）的实验：它直接对应工程决策——是投入去做更多可交互世界，还是在同一世界上扩 API/界面复杂度。
值得深挖的点：reward density 这个控制变量在不同域的作用是否一致；以及 rτ* 很低时，是否意味着很多 RL pipeline 的“多 rollouts”其实在买低效数据。

summary_en.core_problem: Agentic RL data is not a single scalar like “rollout tokens”. Each sample jointly contains a task specification, an environment instance (API surface + dynamics), an interaction trajectory, and a reward signal—each produced by different synthesis components with different costs and saturation behaviors. The paper asks a pretraining-style question in this new setting: given a fixed synthesis/compute budget, which axis should be scaled (more tasks, more environments/worlds, or more trajectories per task-environment), and how far can synthetic data substitute for real data on each axis before performance collapses?
summary_en.importance: The main value is a usable scaling framework for agentic RL that turns “data” into a structured design space and makes budget allocation solvable rather than heuristic. For foundation-model pretraining researchers, it contributes: (1) a principled axis decomposition that mirrors token-based scaling laws but for structured interaction data; (2) a quantitative notion of synthetic-data substitutability via per-axis discounts and collapse thresholds, directly informing data mixture and curriculum decisions; (3) a compute-optimal allocation recipe (data axes + model size) analogous in spirit to Chinchilla, but tailored to agentic RL where environment diversity can dominate returns. Practically, it argues that investing in new environments/worlds tends to beat resampling more trajectories under the same environments.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The approach is intentionally end-to-end and depends on three coupled steps:
1) Axis decomposition and per-axis scaling fits (Sec. 4): formalize the training corpus as a tensor over tasks T, environments E, and trajectories per (t,e) cell. Define cardinalities DT=|T|, DE=|E|, and a trajectory axis Dτ capturing sampling density/volume, plus a reward-density control knob. Fit independent power-law exponents αT, αE, ατ by varying one axis while controlling others.
2) Pricing synthesis with a common ruler (Sec. 5): use the real-data scaling laws to convert synthetic data into “real-equivalent” units. Introduce κ∈[0,1] as an axis-specific discount (effectiveness of synthetic vs real) and identify a critical synthetic-to-real ratio r* where performance degradation/collapse begins. Reported thresholds are strongly ordered: rE*≈9.4, rT*≈3.4, rτ*≈1.4, with a mechanistic interpretation tied to how strongly each axis is grounded by external truth.
3) Compute-optimal allocation (Sec. 6): solve a constrained optimization over model size N and axis budgets (DE,DT,Dτ) under total compute C, incorporating synthesis costs/discounts. Derive closed-form scaling prescriptions: DE*∝C^0.34, DT*∝C^0.27, Dτ*∝C^0.13, N*∝C^0.26. Further refine the environment axis into world diversity vs environment-structure diversity, yielding αW>αV≈αT>ατ, which maps cleanly to engineering choices (build new worlds vs expand API/structure).
summary_en.experiments:
Coverage is designed to test robustness across models, algorithms, and domains rather than a single benchmark:
- Models/algorithms: Qwen3-4B/8B/14B; both GRPO and PPO.
- Domains: five domains including math+code, SWE, web, and UI/tool-use.
- Total: 21 experimental settings (as stated).
Key quantitative takeaways:
1) A direct failure case for scalar “token” scaling: two Qwen3-8B runs with identical total tokens and FLOPs but different (task, environment, trajectory) allocations differ by 14 percentage points in success rate.
2) Stable exponent ordering across settings: αE>αT>ατ; with environment split, αW>αV≈αT>ατ.
3) Synthetic mixture limits: collapse thresholds rE*≈9.4, rT*≈3.4, rτ*≈1.4, implying trajectory-heavy synthetic rollouts are the most fragile.
4) The compute-optimal allocation derived from fitted laws is validated at a held-out compute scale, supporting the claim that the fitted exponents are predictive for budget planning.
A practical interpretation consistent with the reported numbers: once coverage over (t,e) cells is decent, additional trajectory resampling yields the lowest marginal gains and hits synthetic bias issues earliest.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read it in the order that matches the dependency chain:
- Start with the Introduction and the motivating figure showing a 14pp gap under equal tokens/FLOPs; it clarifies why allocation, not quantity, is the bottleneck.
- Spend most time on Sec. 4 (definitions + fitting protocol). The credibility of everything else hinges on how DT/DE/Dτ and reward density are operationalized and controlled.
- Then Sec. 5 for κ and r*: check how “collapse” is detected, what metrics are used, and whether the estimation is robust to training noise.
- Sec. 6 for the optimization and the derived exponents; verify how synthesis costs/discounts enter constraints and why the resulting powers take those values.
- Finally, focus on the environment split (world vs structure). This is the most actionable part for teams deciding between generating new interactive worlds versus enriching existing environments.
Deep-dive prompts: whether reward density behaves consistently across domains; and whether common RL practices that emphasize more rollouts are implicitly spending budget on the least efficient axis.

recommendation.zh: 把 agentic RL 的“数据量”拆成可操作的三轴并给出指数排序，能直接改你对合成预算分配的 prior；重点看指数拟合的置信区间与是否跨 domain 真稳。
recommendation.en: The 3-axis decomposition plus exponent ordering can genuinely change how you allocate synthetic RL budgets; focus on the fit confidence intervals and whether the ordering holds cleanly across domains.

paper.title: AFCS: Atomic-Fact-Conditioned Synthesis for Factual Knowledge Pretraining
paper.abstract: Synthetic data is increasingly used in language-model pretraining. Existing knowledge-corpus synthesis pipelines, including WRAP and Nemotron-CC, usually take a source passage or document segment as input and generate rewritten or QA-style samples from that text. This can improve surface form and prompt diversity, but it does not explicitly require fine-grained source facts -- especially secondary entities, list/table entries, and precise temporal attributes -- to appear in the synthesized corpu

summary.core_problem: 解决知识型合成预训练语料只做段落改写或 QA 重写、却无法稳定覆盖细粒度事实单元的问题，尤其是次级实体、表格/列表项和时间属性容易在合成中丢失。
summary.importance: 这是典型的预训练数据工作，而且切中一个常被忽略的点：合成数据不只是“更像人写”，还要决定哪些事实被保留下来。贡献类型是数据合成 pipeline 创新，并直接在 continued pretraining 上验证对 factual recall 的收益。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 AFCS（Atomic-Fact-Conditioned Synthesis）。流程先从源文档树中做结构感知的 atomic fact 抽取，再做 source-grounded verification 过滤，随后为每个保留事实扩展局部上下文，并生成多种格式的训练样本。与 WRAP、Nemotron-CC 这类以 passage 为条件的重写不同，AFCS 以“事实”为条件变量，显式约束细粒度知识进入合成语料。
summary.experiments: 在同一 FineWiki 源语料上，对 OLMo-3-7B 和一个 32B base 做 continued pretraining。对比 WRAP 和 Nemotron-CC，在 SimpleQA、SimpleQA Verified、PopQA 等知识密集评测上更好。摘要未给出具体 token 预算和绝对提升，但 setup 相对干净：同源语料、同 continued-pretrain 框架，主要变量是合成策略。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses a weakness of synthetic knowledge pretraining corpora: passage-level rewriting or QA-style synthesis often fails to preserve fine-grained factual units, especially secondary entities, list/table entries, and temporal attributes.
summary_en.importance: This is a clear pretraining-data paper, and it hits an underappreciated issue: synthetic data quality is not just about surface diversity, but about which facts survive the synthesis process. The contribution is a new data-synthesis pipeline validated through continued pretraining on factual recall benchmarks.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes AFCS (Atomic-Fact-Conditioned Synthesis). It first performs structure-aware extraction of atomic facts from the document tree, then applies source-grounded verification, expands local context around each retained fact, and generates multiple output formats. Unlike WRAP or Nemotron-CC, which condition on passages, AFCS conditions on individual facts and explicitly forces fine-grained knowledge into the synthetic corpus.
summary_en.experiments: Continued pretraining is run on OLMo-3-7B and a 32B base model using the same FineWiki source corpus. Against WRAP and Nemotron-CC, AFCS performs better on knowledge-heavy evaluations such as SimpleQA, SimpleQA Verified, and PopQA. The abstract does not provide token budgets or exact gains, but the setup appears relatively clean: same source corpus, same continued-pretraining regime, with synthesis strategy as the main variable.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得认真看：它把“合成数据质量”从文风多样性拉回到事实保真，若实验控制真如摘要所示，应立刻在内部 synthetic pretrain pipeline 上加 atomic-fact 覆盖率统计。
recommendation.en: This is worth real attention: it reframes synthetic-data quality from stylistic diversity back to factual retention. If the controls are as clean as advertised, add atomic-fact coverage metrics to your internal synthetic pretraining pipeline immediately.

stage_evidence.quote: AFCS: Atomic-Fact-Conditioned Synthesis for Factual Knowledge Pretraining

paper.title: Conditional Transfer from Controlled Pretraining Mixtures to Code
paper.abstract: Synthetic tasks are increasingly used both as probes of language-model capability and as pretraining data. Both uses are often justified by loss reduction: falling loss is treated as informative, and faster loss reduction with more sampling as evidence that a task is worth sampling. We separate three signals. A task is diagnostic when its loss tracks global pretraining progress; it is teachable when its loss responds to its own token budget; and a data source transfers when including it improves

summary.core_problem: 如何区分合成数据在预训练中的不同作用（诊断、教学、迁移），并建立数据混合比例与下游任务收益的预测关系？
summary.importance: 提出了一种系统性的方法来评估合成数据在预训练中的价值，将损失下降分解为诊断信号和教学信号，并验证了教学信号与下游迁移的强相关性，为数据配比（data mixture）提供了更科学的指导。
summary.technical_approach: 将预训练语料分为 70% 的固定通用 Python 代码和 30% 的混合数据（包含 OpenCodeInstruct 任务和文献探针任务）。通过任务预算扫描（task-budget sweep），分离出三种信号：诊断（loss 随全局预训练进度下降）、教学（loss 随自身 token 预算增加而下降）和迁移（提升下游目标）。
summary.experiments: 在受控预训练设置下，对 27 个任务进行了预算扫描，发现 14 个任务具有教学性（teachable）。精心策划的合成数据（10/12）比文献衍生的探针任务（4/15）表现出更强的教学性。教学性和下游迁移之间存在差异。

summary_en.core_problem: How to distinguish the different roles of synthetic data in pretraining (diagnostic, teachable, transfer) and establish a predictive relationship between data mixture proportions and downstream task benefits?
summary_en.importance: Proposes a systematic approach to evaluate the value of synthetic data in pretraining, decomposing loss reduction into diagnostic and teachable signals, and verifying the strong correlation between teachable signals and downstream transfer, providing more scientific guidance for data mixture.
summary_en.technical_approach: Divides the pretraining corpus into 70% fixed general Python code and a 30% mixture of data (including OpenCodeInstruct tasks and literature probe tasks). Through a task-budget sweep, three signals are separated: diagnostic (loss tracks global pretraining progress), teachable (loss responds to its own token budget), and transfer (improves a downstream target).
summary_en.experiments: Under a controlled pretraining setting, a budget sweep was conducted on 27 tasks, revealing that 14 tasks are teachable. Curated synthetic data (10/12) showed stronger teachability than literature-derived probe tasks (4/15). There is a difference between teachability and downstream transfer.

recommendation.zh: 将数据对 loss 的影响拆解为诊断和教学两部分，对做 data mixture 和评估合成数据质量的同学很有启发，建议看实验设计和信号分离逻辑。
recommendation.en: Decomposing the impact of data on loss into diagnostic and teachable parts is highly inspiring for those working on data mixture and evaluating synthetic data quality. Recommend reading the experimental design and signal separation logic.

stage_evidence.quote: Conditional Transfer from Controlled Pretraining Mixtures to Code

paper.title: ARC: A Reasoning Recipe for Robot Foundation Models
paper.abstract: The prevailing approach to improving robot foundation models (RFMs) relies on larger models, more robot demonstrations, and costly training at scale. We show that there exists an effective and efficient complementary approach: the right reasoning recipe can substantially improve the zero-shot task performance of existing state-of-the-art RFMs. We refer to this recipe as ARC. It consists of three key ingredients: a reasoning trace, a scalable automatic labeling pipeline, and a strategy for adapti

summary.core_problem: 解决机器人基础模型在零样本任务上仅靠扩大模型和示范数据仍然不足的问题，尝试用 reasoning trace 改善控制决策。
summary.importance: 这是机器人 foundation model 的后训练 recipe 工作。对 LLM 预训练研究员的价值不在机器人本身，而在一个更一般的接口：把因果化、面向下一动作的 reasoning trace 从现有 demonstration 中自动抽出来，再适配到预训练模型。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ARC，由三部分组成：面向下一动作且解释因果结构的 reasoning trace；从现有 demonstrations 自动生成 trace 的可扩展标注流水线；以及让预训练机器人模型利用这些 trace 进行控制适配的训练策略。作者还基于 DROID 构造 ARC-Trace-DROID，无需新增机器人采集。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明方法应用于现有 SOTA RFM，如 π0.5 和 WAM，目标是显著提升 zero-shot task performance。实验重点应是：原始 demonstration 微调 vs 加入 ARC trace、人工 trace vs 自动 trace、不同模型上的泛化收益。未给出具体数值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the limitation that scaling robot foundation models with more parameters and demonstrations is not enough, and explores whether reasoning traces can improve zero-shot control.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training recipe for robot foundation models. Its value to LLM pretraining researchers is not robotics per se, but a more general interface: automatically extracting causal, next-action-grounded reasoning traces from existing demonstrations and adapting pretrained models to use them.
summary_en.technical_approach: ARC consists of three parts: reasoning traces grounded in the robot's next action and its causal effect, a scalable automatic labeling pipeline that derives such traces from existing demonstrations, and an adaptation strategy that teaches pretrained robot models to use these traces for control. The paper also builds ARC-Trace-DROID from DROID without collecting new robot data.
summary_en.experiments: The method is applied to state-of-the-art RFMs such as π0.5 and WAM, with the goal of improving zero-shot task performance. The key comparisons are likely standard demonstration tuning vs ARC traces, human vs automatic traces, and transfer across model families. The abstract does not provide exact numbers.

recommendation.zh: 更像 post-train recipe 而非 pretrain 进展；如果你关心“从现有轨迹自动蒸出 reasoning 数据”，看 trace 设计和自动标注流水线即可。
recommendation.en: This is more a post-training recipe than a pretraining advance; if you care about auto-distilling reasoning data from existing trajectories, focus on the trace design and labeling pipeline.

stage_evidence.quote: 提出 ARC，由三部分组成：面向下一动作且解释因果结构的 reasoning trace；从现有 demonstrations 自动生成 trace 的可扩展标注流水线；以及让预训练机器人模型利用这些 trace 进行控制适配的训练策略。作者还基于 DROID 构造 ARC-Trace-DROID，无需新增机器人采集。

paper.title: Dialect-Robust Speech Language Models with Synthetic Pseudo-Dialect Augmentation
paper.abstract: Speech Language Model (SLM) performance often degrades on dialects due to data scarcity. Conventional text-to-speech (TTS) augmentation struggles to cover diverse dialects as it requires a certain amount of real dialect speech. We propose synthesizing pseudo-dialect speech by converting LLM-generated dialect text via a standard-language TTS model, requiring zero real dialect speech. Additionally, we introduce intermediate standard-text prediction during training, acting as semantic normalization

summary.core_problem: 语音语言模型在方言上因数据稀缺而显著退化，且传统 TTS 增广需要真实方言语音作为种子。
summary.importance: 属于“合成数据 + 训练目标”缓解分布外口音/方言的工作；对音频/语音 LM 的数据构造有参考，但更偏下游（语音到英文翻译）验证。
summary.technical_approach: 用 LLM 生成方言文本，再用标准语 TTS 合成“伪方言语音”，实现零真实方言语音的增广；训练中加入一个中间任务：先预测标准语文本（语义归一化），再服务下游任务以缩小语义鸿沟。
summary.experiments: 任务为方言语音到英文的语音翻译，覆盖日语/德语/中文方言；相对“合成标准语音”基线，伪方言增广带来小幅提升（如日语 25.38→26.24，德语 31.57→32.47）；加入中间标准文本预测后提升更明显（如日语到 28.26，中文 11.67→16.37）。未见预训练规模与更广泛 ASR/SLM 基准。

summary_en.core_problem: Speech LMs degrade on dialects due to data scarcity, while conventional TTS augmentation needs real dialect speech.
summary_en.importance: A synthetic-data plus auxiliary-objective approach for dialect robustness; useful as a data construction recipe for speech/audio LMs, though validated mainly on a downstream speech-translation setup.
summary_en.technical_approach: Generate dialect text with an LLM, synthesize pseudo-dialect speech using a standard-language TTS (zero real dialect speech). Add an intermediate objective to predict standard text as semantic normalization to bridge dialect-semantic gaps.
summary_en.experiments: Dialect-to-English speech translation on Japanese/German/Chinese dialects. Pseudo-dialect augmentation improves over synthetic standard-speech baselines (e.g., JA 25.38→26.24, DE 31.57→32.47). Intermediate standard-text prediction yields larger gains (e.g., JA to 28.26, ZH 11.67→16.37). No clear pretraining-scale evidence.

recommendation.zh: 把它当“零方言语音条件下的方言增广 recipe”即可：只看伪方言构造与中间标准文本目标，增益不大但思路干净。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a clean recipe for dialect augmentation without real dialect speech: focus on pseudo-dialect synthesis and the intermediate standard-text objective; gains are modest but the idea is practical.

stage_evidence.quote: tandard-text prediction yields larger gains (e.g., JA to 28.26, ZH 11.67→16.37). No clear pretraining-scale evidence.
伪方言增广带来小幅提升（如日语 25.38→26.24，德语 31.57→32.47）；加入中间标准文本预测后提升更明显（如日语到 28.26，中文 11.67→16.37）。未见预训练规模与更广泛 ASR/SLM 基准。

paper.title: TAFFY: A Task-Adaptive Tabular Foundation Model with In-Context Diversity
paper.abstract: Recent progress in tabular foundation models suggests that training on synthetic tasks can substantially improve in-context learning capabilities, with overall performance largely depending on how well models can infer task-specific predictive relationships from the available context during inference. In this paper, we introduce TAFFY, a tabular foundation model with an In-Context Diversity Prior and a Task-Conditioned Looped Transformer that strengthen this ability. Specifically, to construct e

summary.core_problem: 如何让“表格基础模型”在 in-context 场景下更稳地从上下文里推断当前任务的预测关系，而不是只记住单一分布/单一环境的相关性。
summary.importance: 属于“非文本领域的 foundation model/ICL 机制”方向：用可控的合成任务与分布移位构造 pretrain context，并在架构上引入循环精炼，试图提升任务适配与 OOD 稳健性；对理解 ICL 需要什么样的上下文多样性有一定启发，但与通用 LLM 预训练主线距离较远。
summary.technical_approach: 两点：1) In-Context Diversity Prior：在同一潜在因果过程上做受控干预与分布移位，采样多个“相关环境”拼成一个 pretraining context，让模型在一个 context 内看到跨环境变化，从而更容易分离稳定机制与偶然相关；2) Task-Conditioned Looped Transformer：共享一组 Transformer blocks 被迭代调用（loop），并用任务条件门控选择性更新表示，类似“迭代推断/精炼”的计算分配。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出关键规模细节（参数量/合成任务规模/对比基线/提升幅度）。从表述看主要对比既有 tabular foundation model 与其 ICL 设定下的泛化表现，重点应在跨分布/跨环境的 ICL 预测。

summary_en.core_problem: How to make tabular foundation models more reliable at inferring task-specific predictive relations from in-context examples, rather than overfitting to a single environment’s correlations.
summary_en.importance: Relevant as a foundation-model/ICL study outside text: it proposes a controllable way to build pretraining contexts with within-context distribution shifts and an iterative refinement architecture. It may inform what kind of context diversity is needed for ICL, but it is not central to mainstream LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Two components: (1) an In-Context Diversity Prior that samples multiple related environments via controlled interventions and distribution shifts from a shared causal process, forming each synthetic pretraining context; (2) a Task-Conditioned Looped Transformer that repeatedly applies a shared block group with task-conditioned gating to iteratively refine contextual representations.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide key scale details (model size, data/task scale, baselines, or deltas). It likely compares against prior tabular foundation models under ICL and OOD/distribution-shift settings.

recommendation.zh: 把“一个 context 内塞进多环境干预/移位”当作 ICL 训练信号是亮点，但更像 tabular 圈内玩法；只需看它的 context 构造与 loop 计算分配，别指望直接迁移到 LLM。
recommendation.en: The within-context multi-environment intervention/shift as an ICL training signal is the only real hook; it’s largely tabular-specific—skim the context construction and the looped compute allocation, don’t expect direct LLM transfer.

paper.title: Learning to Learn a Language
paper.abstract: We present the Prior-Fitted Language Model (PFLM), a 300M-parameter byte-level transformer pretrained only on samples from a synthetic non-linguistic prior. Given a prefix of real text, it learns to predict the language in context with frozen weights, having never seen a word of any real language. Every training sequence is generated by a recurrent structural causal model drawn fresh from a distribution over such models. The model never sees the same language twice during training, so the only w

summary.core_problem: 语言模型是否必须在真实语言上预训练，才能获得语言归纳能力？这篇工作尝试把“学会一种语言”从记忆语料转成从上下文中在线推断生成规则。
summary.importance: 这是很少见的范式性 probing：用纯合成、非语言先验训练一个 byte-level transformer，再测试它能否在冻结参数下从真实文本前缀中快速适应。它直接触碰 pretrain 的核心问题——模型到底学到的是语料统计，还是更一般的 sequence induction prior。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Prior-Fitted Language Model（PFLM），一个 300M 参数 byte-level Transformer。训练数据不是自然语言，而是从一族 recurrent structural causal models 中采样得到的合成序列；每个训练序列都来自新的生成机制，模型训练时不会两次见到同一种“语言”。因此要做好下一个 byte 预测，唯一可行策略是从上下文前缀推断当前语言规则。作者强调这些先验样本保留了自然文本的一些统计特征，如 Zipf 频率、慢熵率收敛和长程依赖。
summary.experiments: 在六种 Wikipedia 语言上，给足够长上下文后，bits-per-byte 从均匀猜测的 8 降到 0.9–2.4（上下文长度到 1M bytes）。除真实文本外，模型在纯数字序列上还能学会计数、大小比较和近似加法，并能预测确定性序列如罗马数字。规模上是 300M 参数，但摘要未给出与标准真实语料预训练 LM 的直接对照，因此更像能力证明而非替代 recipe。

summary_en.core_problem: Does a language model need real-language pretraining to acquire linguistic competence, or can it instead learn a more general prior for inferring a language from context?
summary_en.importance: This is a rare paradigm-level probe. It trains a byte-level Transformer only on synthetic, non-linguistic data and tests whether frozen weights can adapt in-context to real text. That directly targets a core pretraining question: are we learning corpus statistics, or a broader sequence-induction prior?
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes a Prior-Fitted Language Model (PFLM), a 300M-parameter byte-level Transformer trained not on natural language but on sequences sampled from a distribution over recurrent structural causal models. Each training sequence comes from a fresh generative process, so the model never sees the same 'language' twice. To predict well, it must infer the current language from the prefix. The synthetic prior is designed to share statistical signatures with natural text, including Zipfian frequencies, slow entropy-rate convergence, and long-range dependence.
summary_en.experiments: On Wikipedia in six languages, bits per byte drop from the uniform 8 to 0.9-2.4 with up to 1M bytes of context. Beyond text, the model also learns counting, magnitude comparison, approximate addition, and deterministic symbolic sequences such as Roman numerals. The model size is 300M, but the abstract does not report a direct comparison against standard real-text-pretrained LMs, so this reads more like a capability demonstration than a replacement recipe.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不一定给你可落地 recipe，但它会逼你重想 pretrain prior：先看 synthetic prior 的构造和 1M-byte in-context 曲线，再决定要不要跟进。
recommendation.en: This may not yield an immediate recipe, but it forces a rethink of what pretraining priors should encode; read the synthetic-prior construction and the 1M-byte in-context curves first.

paper.title: When Does Synthetic Relational Data Teach Models to Use Relations? Tracing Predictive Structure from Pretraining Data to Model Behavior
paper.abstract: Relational foundation models are increasingly pretrained on synthetic databases, yet downstream benchmarks reveal little about why one synthetic corpus produces a better model than another. In particular, strong performance may arise from realistic row-level statistics without the model ever learning to use relational structure. We study this as a data-attribution problem: which property of synthetic pretraining data induces relational computation? Using four Relational Transformer checkpoints t

summary.core_problem: 解决合成关系型预训练数据到底教会模型“利用关系结构”还是只学到表面行级统计这一归因问题。
summary.importance: 这是典型的预训练数据机制研究。价值不在新架构，而在把数据属性、训练目标和下游行为连起来，回答“什么样的合成数据真的诱导出目标计算机制”。这对合成语料、课程设计、数据 mixture 都有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者固定架构、初始化、目标函数和算力预算，只改变四种关系型数据生成器，做干净的数据归因。核心假设是：只有当 masked-cell 预训练目标中，跨表信息对预测是“必要的”，模型才会学出 relational computation。为此他们定义并测量 foreign-key 链接父表带来的 predictive gain，再追踪这种数据属性是否对应到模型内部的跨表机制和下游行为。
summary.experiments: 实验使用四个 Relational Transformer checkpoints，在相同训练配置下分别用四种合成语料预训练。摘要称 RelDiff 在 foreign-key-linked parents 上提供了显著更高的 predictive gain，对应模型也是唯一稳定使用跨表信息、并在关系型下游任务上表现最强的模型。虽然不是通用 LLM 规模，但 setup 很干净，适合看因果归因逻辑。

summary_en.core_problem: It asks when synthetic relational pretraining data actually teaches a model to use relational structure, rather than merely fitting row-level surface statistics.
summary_en.importance: This is a pretraining-data mechanism paper. Its value is not a new architecture but a cleaner link from data property to learned computation and downstream behavior, which is directly relevant to synthetic corpora design, curriculum, and data mixture.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors hold architecture, initialization, objective, and compute fixed, and vary only four synthetic relational data generators. Their central hypothesis is that relational mechanisms emerge only when cross-table information is predictively necessary for the masked-cell objective. They quantify this via the predictive gain from foreign-key-linked parent tables, then trace whether that property maps to learned cross-table computation and downstream behavior.
summary_en.experiments: The study uses four Relational Transformer checkpoints trained under matched settings on four corpora. The abstract states that RelDiff yields by far the largest predictive gain from foreign-key-linked parents, and its corresponding model is uniquely consistent in using cross-table information and strongest on downstream relational tasks. The scale is not LLM-sized, but the setup is unusually clean for data attribution.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看，不是因为关系数据库，而是它把“数据里是否让目标计算变成必要条件”讲得很干净；做合成预训练数据的人应直接复现这种归因框架。
recommendation.en: Worth reading not for relational tables per se, but because it cleanly tests whether data makes the target computation necessary; anyone designing synthetic pretraining corpora should copy this attribution setup.

paper.title: Effective Synthetic Data Curation Requires Group-Level Signals
paper.abstract: Synthetic data now is essential to LLM training, used to strengthen advanced capabilities such as autonomous and long-horizon task execution. Yet recent work shows that training on it at scale can degrade model generation, making it important to decide what synthetic data is worth training on. While current data curation practices do so with individual-level signals (i.e., estimates of each data sample's training utility in isolation), across pre-training and post-training settings we show that

summary.core_problem: 解决合成数据筛选只看单样本效用、却忽略样本之间相互作用，导致大规模训练时数据策展失真的问题。
summary.importance: 这是直接打到当前合成数据训练核心假设的一篇数据工作。贡献不是再造一个打分器，而是指出 synthetic data curation 需要从 individual-level signal 转向 group-level signal；这对预训练和后训练的数据混配、课程设计、数据去留都有方法论意义。
summary.technical_approach: 作者比较两类数据效用估计：单样本信号只估计样本独立训练价值，组级信号则显式考虑样本组合后的交互效应。论文先构造在 individual-level influence 下看似等价、但 group composition 不同的 synthetic datasets，证明它们训练结果可显著分化；再提出基于组级效用的策展方式，在 pre-training 与 post-training 场景中验证其优越性。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明实验同时覆盖 pre-training 和 post-training 两种设置，并比较按 individual-level 与 group-level 信号筛选后的下游表现差异。核心结果是：仅依赖单样本信号会错过组合效应，导致看似同分的数据集训练效果差很多；按组级信号策展能带来更好的 downstream performance。摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据量和增幅，需看正文确认 setup 是否足够干净。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses a key failure mode in synthetic-data curation: judging samples only by individual utility while ignoring interactions among samples during training.
summary_en.importance: This directly challenges a central assumption in current synthetic-data pipelines. The contribution is not another scorer, but the claim that effective curation must move from individual-level signals to group-level signals. That matters for pretraining and post-training data mixture, curriculum, and retention decisions.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper contrasts two notions of utility estimation: individual-level signals that score each sample in isolation, and group-level signals that account for interaction effects among samples. It constructs synthetic datasets that look indistinguishable under individual influence estimates but differ in composition, then shows that training outcomes diverge sharply. It further proposes curation based on group-level utility and validates it in both pre-training and post-training settings.
summary_en.experiments: According to the abstract, experiments cover both pre-training and post-training regimes and compare downstream performance after curation by individual-level versus group-level signals. The key result is that individual-only scoring misses composition effects, so datasets with similar per-sample utility can train very differently, while group-level curation performs better. The abstract does not provide model sizes, data scale, or exact gains, so the cleanliness of the setup needs to be checked in the paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Chenyan Xiong.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得立刻进内部 ablation：它在修正“样本独立打分即可做合成数据筛选”的默认前提，先看构造性反例和 pre/post-train 两组实验是否干净。
recommendation.en: This should go straight into internal ablations: it challenges the default assumption that sample-wise scoring is enough for synthetic-data curation; first inspect the constructive counterexample and the pre/post-train setups.

paper.title: Synthetic Pre-pretraining Survives Scale, but Not as a Grammatical Prior
paper.abstract: Pre-pretraining (PPT) on synthetic non-natural language data improves token efficiency during language model pre-training (PT). Prior work attributes this gain to a grammatical prior, i.e., a structural inductive bias learned during PPT that transfers to natural language grammar. However, PPT has only been tested on models of at most 1B parameters and PT budgets below 2B tokens on predominantly web text. It is unknown whether PPT is effective at larger scales and under more realistic PT data mix

summary.core_problem: 这项研究检验 synthetic pre-pretraining 是否在更接近真实预训练的条件下仍然有效，并追问它为什么有效。已有工作认为，在正式预训练前先用 Dyck 语言等非自然语言序列 warm-up，可以给模型提供可迁移的语法先验。但过去实验通常停留在 1B 以下模型、不到 2B token 的短预训练、以及单一 web text 语料，无法判断这种收益是否只是小规模或早期训练现象。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练数据与训练流程有直接参考价值。结论分成两层。第一，PPT 的收益在 500M 到 7B、最长 100B PT token 的设置下仍然存在；在 3B 规模上至少可以节省 21B PT token，7B 上也保持正向收益。这说明 synthetic warm-up 不是只在小模型早期出现的初始化噪声。第二，作者否定了“语法先验”作为主要解释：下游收益与 BLiMP 语法接受度不稳定对应，真正更一致的中介变量是 long-range retrieval 能力。这个结论会改变 PPT 的设计目标。与其设计看起来像自然语言语法的形式语言，不如设计能迫使模型学习远距离绑定、检索和复用的序列任务。另一个实用发现是，PPT 收益依赖 web text 的存在，而不是 code/math 的比例；数学数据增加 13 倍并不会削弱 PPT 收益，但去掉 web text 后收益会塌缩。这对 data mixture warm-up 的解释很重要。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把 PPT 形式化为两阶段训练：先在小规模合成或控制语料 D_PPT 上优化自回归 NLL，得到初始化 θ_PPT；再用同样的 PT 数据 D_PT 继续训练，并与从随机初始化直接 PT 的模型对比。实验设计覆盖四个维度：PPT 任务、PT 数据混合、参数规模、PT token 预算。PPT 任务包含五类：两个形式语言任务，其中包括 k-Shuffle Dyck 这类交错括号匹配语言；两个不依赖形式语法但具有结构性的合成任务；以及一个从正式 PT 语料中抽样的 in-domain text control。PT mixture 覆盖 C4、Marin、SmolLM3、OLMo3，分别代表纯或偏 web text、web-dominant、包含较多 code/math 的过滤混合、以及 STEM 加权混合。评测分三组：BLiMP 用来测语法接受度；verbatim retrieval 用来测长程检索；十个通用 benchmark 覆盖阅读理解、科学问答、常识推理和语言建模。方法上的关键不是提出新模型，而是用可控的规模、数据和预算矩阵，把 PPT 的收益来源从“是否有形式语法”拆到“是否改善长程检索”和“是否与 PT mixture 匹配”。
summary.experiments: 实验规模明显大于此前 PPT 研究：参数量覆盖 500M、1B、3B、7B；默认 PT 预算为 21B tokens，扩展到 100B tokens，最多约为过往研究的 50 倍。主要结果是：PPT 的下游性能和 token efficiency 在长训练后仍保持，3B 模型上可至少抵消 21B PT tokens 的训练需求，7B 上仍为正收益。机制分析显示，BLiMP 语法分数不能稳定预测下游提升；某些能提升语法接受度的 PPT 不一定带来更好的通用能力，反过来也成立。与之相比，只有能改善 verbatim retrieval 或长程检索能力的 PPT 任务稳定带来下游收益。数据混合实验也给出清晰信号：把数学数据比例提高 13 倍，PPT 收益基本不变；但去掉 web text 后，收益显著消失。这个结果削弱了“code/math 已经提供结构信号，所以 PPT 冗余”的假设，也说明 PPT 可能主要帮助模型更高效地学习 web text 中稀疏、长程、非局部的依赖。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读实验设计和结果分析。先看 framework 部分，确认 PT-only 与 PPT 初始化的训练预算如何对齐，避免把额外计算误读为免费收益。然后看五类 PPT task 的定义，重点区分形式语法任务和非形式结构任务。结果部分优先看三组图表：随参数规模变化的 token efficiency 曲线，21B 到 100B token 的延长训练曲线，以及 BLiMP、verbatim retrieval、下游 benchmark 之间的相关性分析。数据混合部分尤其值得读，重点是 C4、Marin、SmolLM3、OLMo3 的差异，以及“13× math increase”和“remove web text”两个对照。精读时要关注一个取舍：PPT 本身也消耗训练 token 和算力，因此真正有意义的是总计算预算下的收益，而不只是 PT 阶段少用了多少 token。

summary_en.core_problem: This work tests whether synthetic pre-pretraining remains useful under realistic pretraining conditions, and what mechanism explains the gain. Prior studies suggested that warm-up on non-natural synthetic languages such as Dyck-style sequences transfers a grammatical prior to natural language. Those studies were mostly limited to models at or below 1B parameters, short pretraining runs below 2B tokens, and web-text-only corpora, leaving open whether the effect survives scale and modern data mixtures.
summary_en.importance: The result is directly relevant to pretraining recipe design. The first finding is practical: synthetic PPT still improves downstream performance and token efficiency from 500M to 7B parameters and under pretraining budgets up to 100B tokens. At the 3B scale, it saves at least 21B PT tokens, and the effect remains positive at 7B. The second finding changes the interpretation: the gain is not well explained as a grammatical prior. Downstream gains do not consistently track BLiMP grammatical acceptability. They track long-range retrieval much more reliably. This suggests that useful PPT tasks should be designed to train distant binding, retrieval, and reuse, rather than merely to resemble natural-language grammar. The data-mixture result is also useful: the gain depends on the presence of web text, not on the proportion of code and math. A 13× increase in math data does not remove the benefit, while removing web text largely collapses it.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study frames PPT as a two-stage autoregressive NLL training process. A model is first trained on a small synthetic or control corpus D_PPT, producing an initialization θ_PPT, and then trained on a standard PT corpus D_PT. This is compared against a PT-only model trained from random initialization. The experimental grid varies four axes: the PPT task, the PT mixture, model scale, and PT token budget. The five PPT tasks include two formal-language tasks, including k-Shuffle Dyck, two structured synthetic tasks without formal grammars, and an in-domain text control sampled from the PT corpus. The PT mixtures include C4, Marin, SmolLM3, and OLMo3, covering pure or web-heavy text, filtered mixtures with code and math, and a STEM-weighted mixture. Evaluation uses BLiMP for grammatical acceptability, verbatim retrieval for long-range retrieval, and ten general benchmarks spanning reading comprehension, science QA, commonsense reasoning, and language modeling. The strength of the work is the controlled scale-and-mixture matrix, which separates formal grammar transfer from retrieval improvement and data-mixture dependence.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover 500M, 1B, 3B, and 7B models, with a default PT budget of 21B tokens and an extended budget up to 100B tokens, around 50× larger than earlier PPT studies. The main empirical result is that PPT gains survive both parameter scaling and extended PT. At 3B, PPT saves at least 21B PT tokens, and at 7B the net effect remains positive. Mechanistic evidence argues against the grammatical-prior explanation: improvements in BLiMP do not consistently predict downstream benchmark gains. In contrast, PPT tasks that improve verbatim retrieval are the ones that produce reliable downstream gains. The mixture experiments are particularly informative. Increasing math data by 13× leaves the PPT gain largely unchanged, while removing web text makes the gain collapse. This weakens the hypothesis that code and math simply replace the structural signal from synthetic PPT, and points instead to an interaction between PPT-induced retrieval ability and web-text learning.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the experimental design before the headline results. The important checks are how the PT-only and PPT runs match budgets, how the PPT token cost is counted, and how the authors define token-efficiency savings. Then inspect the definitions of the five PPT tasks, especially the distinction between formal grammar tasks and structured non-grammar tasks. In the results, focus on the scaling curves, the 21B-to-100B extended-training curves, and the correlation analyses among BLiMP, verbatim retrieval, and downstream benchmarks. The data-mixture section is worth close reading, especially the comparisons involving C4, Marin, SmolLM3, OLMo3, the 13× math condition, and the no-web-text condition. The key question to keep in mind is whether PPT improves total compute efficiency after counting the warm-up phase, not only whether it reduces tokens in the subsequent PT phase.

recommendation.zh: 这篇应进 internal ablation：PPT 的收益能撑到 7B/100B token，但 grammar-prior 解释要降权。
recommendation.en: This belongs in internal ablations: PPT gains survive 7B/100B-token settings, but the grammatical-prior explanation should be discounted.

paper.title: Lasting Effects of Abstract Pretraining Beyond Perplexity
paper.abstract: Language models are typically pretrained from random initialization. Recent work challenges this convention, showing that a brief warm-up on abstract, algorithmically generated data can provide a better starting point for subsequent learning of natural language. In this paper, we show that in small language models, such a warm-up improves specific capabilities that are not reflected in language-modeling perplexity. Our warm-up uses an abstract stack-manipulation task that requires compositional

summary.core_problem: 在语言模型预训练前引入少量抽象算法数据（如堆栈操作）进行“预热”，能否提升模型在自然语言任务上的特定能力，以及这种提升是否与语言建模困惑度（Perplexity）强相关。
summary.importance: 揭示了抽象数据预训练（Procedural Pretraining）对模型归纳偏置的深远影响，证明了这种预热能显著提升多跳推理能力，且这种能力提升并不总是反映在困惑度上，挑战了仅依赖困惑度选择预训练数据的传统观点。
summary.technical_approach: 通过控制变量实验，在 SmolLM（135M/360M）上进行研究。首先使用少量（约占总 token 1%）抽象数据（如模拟堆栈 push/pop 操作的 Stack 数据）进行预训练，然后进行标准语言预训练和 SFT。对比不同抽象任务（如 Queue）、不同介入时机（预训练前、中、后）对下游多跳问答（如 MuSiQue）和合成推理任务（DEPO）的影响。
summary.experiments: 仅使用 1% 的 Stack 数据预热，MuSiQue 上的 F1 分数提升高达 3.9，且在更长的推理链上习得速度更快。关键发现：1) 提升主要体现在依赖前置步骤的推理链上；2) 具有相似困惑度的 Queue 任务无法带来同等提升；3) 早期介入（预训练前）至关重要，预训练中或后引入无效。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注 Section 4 中关于特定能力（多跳推理）提升的实验结果，以及 Section 5 和 6 中关于抽象数据属性和介入时机的消融实验。理解为何困惑度不是评估抽象数据价值的唯一指标。

summary_en.core_problem: Whether a brief warm-up on abstract, algorithmic data (e.g., stack operations) prior to language pretraining improves specific capabilities on natural language tasks, and whether this improvement correlates with language modeling perplexity.
summary_en.importance: Reveals the profound impact of procedural pretraining on a model's inductive biases, demonstrating that such warm-ups significantly enhance multi-hop reasoning capabilities. Crucially, these gains are not always reflected in perplexity, challenging the conventional reliance on perplexity for pretraining data selection.
summary_en.technical_approach: Conducts controlled experiments on SmolLM (135M/360M). Models are first pretrained on a small amount (~1% of total tokens) of abstract data (e.g., 'Stack' data simulating push/pop operations), followed by standard language pretraining and SFT. Compares the impact of different abstract tasks (e.g., 'Queue') and intervention timings (before, during, after pretraining) on downstream multi-hop QA (e.g., MuSiQue) and synthetic reasoning tasks (DEPO).
summary_en.experiments: A warm-up with just 1% Stack data improved MuSiQue F1 scores by up to 3.9 points and accelerated the acquisition of longer reasoning chains. Key findings: 1) Improvements are specific to reasoning chains where later steps depend on earlier ones; 2) The Queue task, despite yielding similar perplexity, fails to provide comparable benefits; 3) Early exposure (before pretraining) is critical; introducing abstract data during or after pretraining is ineffective.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 4 for results on specific capability improvements (multi-hop reasoning), and Sections 5 and 6 for ablation studies on abstract data properties and intervention timing. Understand why perplexity is not the sole metric for evaluating the value of abstract data.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会动摇“perplexity 足够做代理指标”的老 prior；先看控制实验和 transfer 分析，值得立刻做一个 1% synthetic warm-up 复现。
recommendation.en: This one weakens the old prior that perplexity is a sufficient proxy; read the control studies and transfer analysis first, then replicate a 1% synthetic warm-up internally.

paper.title: Learning Reliable GUI Agents under Imperfect Priors
paper.abstract: GUI agents built on large language and vision-language models still struggle on unseen applications and complex multi-step tasks, as completing real GUI tasks depends on app-specific, temporally volatile operational knowledge that is scarce in pretraining corpora. Retrieval-augmented execution offers a natural remedy but faces two coupled bottlenecks: knowledge at scale is hard to acquire, and self-collected priors inevitably drift from the live environment due to version updates, promotions, ad

summary.core_problem: 这项工作研究 GUI agent 在检索增强执行时如何使用不完美的历史轨迹先验：真实应用会因为版本更新、广告、A/B 测试、个性化和区域差异发生界面漂移，旧轨迹既有用也可能误导 agent。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值主要在 post-train 与 agent 数据构造接口。它不是通用 LLM 预训练方法，但提供了一个清楚的训练信号设计：不要把检索到的轨迹当成硬条件，而是显式监督模型判断先验可靠性，再决定 follow、partial use 或 ignore。这个思路可迁移到工具使用、长程任务执行、RAG 训练和合成轨迹数据构造中。它强调训练数据不只需要“正确行动”，还需要覆盖检索噪声和环境漂移，并把噪声类型转成可学习的中间决策。
summary.technical_approach: SAGE 包含三部分。第一，自探索先验采集：agent 在真实设备上遍历可交互控件，构建去重后的 UI transition graph，并用多模态标注器从可达路径合成任务与轨迹对，从而降低人工演示依赖。第二，漂移感知扰动：作者基于真实 app 新旧版本比较得到漂移类型，包括步骤增删、入口或路径变化、控件重命名、目标不匹配的绕路和干扰项；再用一组扰动算子把 clean prior 转成近似部署噪声的 prior distribution，并给出确定性的可靠性标签。第三，可靠性门控策略：policy 先预测 r ∈ {Follow, Partial, Ignore}，再在该可靠性决策条件下生成动作，即 p(a|·)=Σr p(r|·)p(a|·,r)。这种 factorization 迫使模型先判断检索轨迹与当前状态/目标是否一致，再决定动作，避免简单拼接 retrieved trajectory 后盲从。
summary.experiments: 作者构建了 20 个热门 app 的 176 个跨版本任务，用于分析 GUI drift。手工比较显示，版本更新后只有 44% 的任务保留完全相同的完成轨迹，其余出现固定几类漂移模式；这与已有报告中 74.6% 的跨版本配对屏幕存在视觉差异相呼应。作者还报告，即使给三个较强 fine-tuned GUI agent 提供旧版本的正确轨迹，它们在新版本上仍明显下降，说明 retrieval prior 的过期问题不能靠简单上下文注入解决。方法实验围绕 clean prior、系统扰动 prior 和 self-explored prior 展开，核心观察是 reliability-gated policy 比 naive retrieval-conditioned policy 更能抵抗旧路径、缺步骤、控件改名和干扰路径。由于给出的全文片段未包含完整表格，具体成功率提升数字无法确认。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 Introduction、Figure 1、Method 中的 drift-aware perturbation 和 reliability-gated policy。重点看作者如何把 GUI 漂移离散成训练扰动算子，以及如何把检索质量判断变成显式监督。预计阅读 25–35 分钟。若关注 agent post-training 数据，可以进一步看自探索 UI graph 构建和任务合成流程；若只关注 LLM 基座预训练，可不深读具体 GUI 执行动作空间。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses how GUI agents should use retrieved trajectory priors when those priors are imperfect. Real applications drift over time because of version updates, ads, A/B tests, personalization, and regional routing, so an old trajectory can be useful context but can also mislead execution.
summary_en.importance: The relevance to foundation-model research lies in the interface between post-training, retrieval, and agent data construction. The paper is not about pretraining a base LLM, but it gives a useful training-signal design: retrieved trajectories should not be treated as hard instructions. The model should be trained to assess prior reliability and then decide whether to follow, partially use, or ignore the prior. This idea transfers to tool-use training, long-horizon execution, RAG robustness, and synthetic trajectory generation. It also highlights that agent training data should include structured retrieval noise and environment drift, not only successful demonstrations.
summary_en.technical_approach: SAGE has three components. First, it builds self-explored priors by traversing interactive elements on real devices, constructing a deduplicated UI transition graph, and using a multimodal annotator to synthesize task-trajectory pairs from reachable paths. Second, it creates drift-aware perturbations. The drift taxonomy comes from comparing old and new app versions and includes step insertion or deletion, entry-point and path shifts, control renaming, goal-mismatched detours, and distracting alternatives. Perturbation operators transform clean priors into a distribution that approximates deployment-time retrieval noise, with deterministic reliability labels. Third, it trains a reliability-gated policy. The policy first predicts a reliability variable r in {Follow, Partial, Ignore}, then generates the action conditioned on that decision: p(a|·)=Σr p(r|·)p(a|·,r). This factorization makes the agent explicitly check whether the retrieved path matches the current goal and state before acting, rather than blindly conditioning on retrieved trajectories.
summary_en.experiments: The authors curate 176 tasks from 20 popular apps across paired old and new versions to study GUI drift. Manual comparison shows that only 44% of tasks keep identical completion trajectories after an update; the rest fall into recurring drift categories. This aligns with prior observations that 74.6% of paired screens across versions show visual differences. The paper also reports that three competitive fine-tuned GUI agents still drop on newer versions even when supplied with correct old-version trajectories, indicating that stale retrieval cannot be handled by simple context concatenation. The main evaluations compare clean priors, systematically perturbed priors, and self-explored priors, with the key finding that the reliability-gated policy is more robust than naive retrieval-conditioned execution under outdated paths, missing steps, renamed controls, and distracting detours. Exact success-rate gains are not recoverable from the provided text fragment.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the Introduction, Figure 1, the drift-aware perturbation section, and the reliability-gated policy section. The main points are the drift taxonomy, the construction of perturbation operators, and the conversion of retrieval quality into an explicit supervised decision. A 25–35 minute read is sufficient for the core idea. Readers interested in agent post-training data should also inspect the self-exploration and UI-graph construction pipeline; readers focused on base-model pretraining can skip most GUI-specific action-space details.

recommendation.zh: 腾讯提出的 GUI Agent 框架，核心 insight 是放弃追求完美先验，转而通过 VLM 合成带噪数据进行抗噪训练，对 Agent 数据合成有一定启发。
recommendation.en: Tencent's GUI Agent framework; the core insight is to abandon perfect priors and instead synthesize noisy data via VLM for noise-robust training, offering some inspiration for Agent data synthesis.

paper.title: It's All Training: A Fully Synthetic Single-Stage Recipe for LLMs
paper.abstract: Current pre-training datasets are derived from web crawls, with all their issues, and were not designed to support mid- and post-training pipelines--for instance, they contain little explicit reasoning. Thus, many frontier labs have begun to develop their own internal datasets, starting from state-of-the-art models, to augment their pre-training data mix, eg, with reasoning traces to address cold-start problems. While demonstratively effective, none of these datasets are public, and the effect o

summary.core_problem: 当前预训练数据高度依赖不可控的网页抓取，且缺乏显式推理过程，导致预训练、指令微调和后训练阶段割裂。现有合成数据方案多为闭源，且容易因模型崩溃（model collapse）降低数据多样性。
summary.importance: 提出了一种将预训练、指令微调和后训练合并为单一阶段的全新合成数据范式。开源了首个包含 80B token 的全阶段合成语料库 Synth，证明了纯合成数据在小模型（0.05B 到 13B MoE）上能达到与同级别开源模型相当的性能。
summary.technical_approach: 采用基于种子（seed-grounded）的回译策略生成数据。以 58k 维基百科文章为种子，通过两阶段流水线生成：第一阶段用前沿模型蒸馏微调查询模型（Query Model）和推理模型（Reasoning Model）；第二阶段大规模运行这两个模型。核心创新在于：1) 引入约束先验模型控制查询生成，强制数据在查询类型、复杂度、目标语言等 6 个维度上变化，避免分布坍塌；2) 引入 20% 的拒绝/纠错/模糊查询，防止模型学会“总是自信回答”；3) 推理模型输入包含查询、种子段落和检索到的负样本段落，强制生成包含推理轨迹的回答。
summary.experiments: 在 Synth 上训练了从 0.05B 到 13B MoE 的系列模型，全程无 SFT 或 RL。结果显示，这些模型在多项任务上与 Gemma、Qwen 等同规模开源模型性能相当。在事实召回测试中，Synth 模型对目标知识的记忆显著优于对比模型。此外，该方法在电信领域的持续学习实验中也取得了显著的领域适应提升。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注第 3 节的数据生成流水线，特别是约束先验（constraint-prior）的设计和 20% 拒绝查询的消融分析。第 5 节关于事实召回（FActScore）的分析揭示了合成数据对知识记忆的影响机制，值得深挖。

summary_en.core_problem: Current pre-training heavily relies on uncontrollable web crawls lacking explicit reasoning, leading to fragmented pre-training, instruction tuning, and post-training stages. Existing synthetic data solutions are mostly closed-source and prone to model collapse, reducing diversity.
summary_en.importance: Introduces a novel synthetic data paradigm that collapses pre-training, instruction tuning, and post-training into a single stage. Releases Synth, the first open-source 80B-token synthetic corpus for all stages, demonstrating that purely synthetic data can achieve competitive performance on models ranging from 0.05B to 13B MoE.
summary_en.technical_approach: Employs a seed-grounded back-translation strategy. Using 58k Wikipedia articles as seeds, a two-stage pipeline is executed: Stage 1 fine-tunes a query model and a reasoning model via distillation from a frontier LLM; Stage 2 runs these models at scale. Key innovations include: 1) A constraint-prior model controlling query generation across 6 axes (type, complexity, language, etc.) to prevent distributional collapse; 2) Injecting 20% refusal/correction/hedge queries to prevent the model from learning to always answer confidently; 3) The reasoning model takes the query, seed paragraph, and a retrieved negative paragraph to generate answers with reasoning traces.
summary_en.experiments: Trained a suite of models (0.05B to 13B MoE) on Synth without any SFT or RL. Results show competitive performance against similar-sized open models like Gemma and Qwen across various tasks. In factual recall tests, Synth models significantly outperformed baselines in memorizing target knowledge. The method also showed substantial domain adaptation improvements in a telecommunications continuous learning setting.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for the data generation pipeline, especially the constraint-prior design and the ablation on the 20% refusal queries. Section 5's analysis on factual recall (FActScore) provides valuable insights into how synthetic data affects knowledge memorization.

recommendation.zh: 值得直接读数据生成和 ablation：如果结果干净，应复现小模型单阶段 synthetic pretrain 的边界。
recommendation.en: Read the data recipe and ablations first; if the setup is clean, this is worth reproducing for small-model synthetic pretraining limits.
