paper.title: Knowledge Acquisition During Pre-training? Large Language Models Learn Better With Auxiliary Views
paper.abstract: Gaps remain in our understanding of how large language models (LLMs) acquire knowledge during pre-training. We posit that auxiliary views, reformulations of knowledge, are causally helpful for learning. We design controlled experiments to isolate this. First, we confirm that repetition is necessary for acquisition and clarify that paraphrasing helps only at smaller batch sizes. Second, holding the token budget fixed, allocating tokens from document repetition to auxiliary views improves learning

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究预训练中的一个基础问题：模型获得知识时，究竟需要更多重复，还是需要同一知识的多种表达。作者把“auxiliary views”定义为围绕同一知识生成的解释、问答、教程、类比、上下文和前置知识，并用受控 continued pre-training 实验检验这些视角是否因果地帮助知识学习。
summary.importance: 这是数据研究里比较有信息量的一类工作。它没有只停留在“高质量、多样性、去重”这些语料级概念，而是把多样性落到单个知识单元的表示方式上。结论对合成预训练数据、领域 continued pre-training、低资源知识注入都很直接：在固定 token budget 下，把一部分重复文档 token 换成围绕同一知识的辅助视角，比简单重复原文更有利，甚至对 factual recall 也有帮助。这一点反直觉，因为事实记忆通常被认为更依赖重复曝光。论文还指出辅助视角的收益不完全依赖强 teacher，说明收益可能来自表示结构和语义覆盖，而不只是来自 teacher 的能力蒸馏。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构造了一个受控知识学习环境。基础任务仍是 autoregressive next-token prediction，训练方式是 continued pre-training。知识单元来自 36 篇新文档，覆盖三个领域：12 篇计算机科学 arXiv 论文、12 篇美国联邦上诉法院法律意见、12 篇 PubMed Central 医学病例报告。为减少泄漏，文档选择在 OLMo-2 预训练 cutoff 之后，并用 Infini-gram API 检查缺失。围绕每个文档，作者生成或收集多种视角：paraphrase 作为语言表述变化的控制组；textbook、Stack Exchange 风格 Q&A、blog 作为 auxiliary views；prerequisite knowledge 以 textbook 形式生成；contextual knowledge 来自引用的 arXiv paper 和司法意见，医学病例因缺少类似引用结构而不使用 contextual setting。评测采用 LAMA-style probes，要求预测句末词或多词答案，区分 factual probes 和更偏理解的 probes。核心实验控制 token budget，对比文档重复、paraphrase、auxiliary views、contextual/prerequisite knowledge，以及不同 teacher 生成视角的影响。论文还分析了层间表示变化，观察辅助视角带来的 layer-wise bias 和更压缩的知识编码。
summary.experiments: 关键实验结论有四个。第一，新知识学习需要重复；paraphrasing 有帮助，但主要在 batch size 较小时明显，batch size 变大后收益下降。这说明 paraphrase 的部分作用可能是改善小 batch 下的梯度覆盖，而不是提供真正新的概念结构。第二，在固定 token budget 下，把用于重复原文的一部分 token 分配给 auxiliary views，可以同时提升理解类 probe 和 factual recall。作者强调这不是单纯“换说法”，而是不同形式的解释、问答和博客让模型形成更一般化的知识表示。第三，辅助视角的有效性不依赖生成它们的 teacher 一定很强，弱一些的生成模型也能提供有用视角。第四，当模型存在 prior knowledge gaps 时，contextual knowledge 和 prerequisite knowledge 能帮助学习目标知识。规模趋势也很重要：更大的模型更能整合多视角信息，表现为更高的参数效率，并把学习信号更多分配到中层和后层。可直接确认的实验规模包括 36 个知识文档、3 个领域、每领域 12 个文档；具体准确率曲线和提升幅度需要以正文表格和图为准。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读，预计 1.5–2 小时。优先看实验设置和数据构造，因为这决定了结论能否解释预训练中的真实知识获取，而不是某个 probe 的偶然现象。其次看 repetition、paraphrase、auxiliary views 在固定 token budget 下的对照，这里是论文的核心。再看 batch size 消融，它解释了为什么 paraphrase 有时有效、有时收益变小。最后看 contextual/prerequisite knowledge 和 layer-wise analysis，这两部分对设计领域 continued pre-training 数据很有用。值得深挖的问题有三个：辅助视角是否会引入测试 probe 的格式偏置；多视角收益是否来自更好的语义覆盖还是更长的有效上下文链；这些结论在大规模混合预训练中是否仍能通过数据配比体现出来。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how knowledge should be represented during pretraining. Instead of treating data diversity as a corpus-level property, it studies whether multiple auxiliary views of the same knowledge—explanations, Q&A, tutorials, contextual material, and prerequisite concepts—causally improve knowledge acquisition under next-token training.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is directly relevant to pretraining data design. It gives an operational meaning to diversity around a knowledge unit, rather than only across a corpus. The main practical lesson is that, under a fixed token budget, replacing some document repetition with auxiliary views can improve both conceptual understanding and factual recall. This matters for synthetic pretraining data, domain continued pretraining, and low-data knowledge injection. The result is also useful because the benefit does not appear to rely only on a very strong teacher model, suggesting that structure and coverage of representation are important, not just teacher capability.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build a controlled continued-pretraining setup. The base objective remains autoregressive next-token prediction. They select 36 recent documents as self-contained knowledge units: 12 computer science arXiv papers, 12 U.S. federal appellate legal opinions, and 12 PubMed Central medical case reports. The documents are chosen after the OLMo-2 pretraining cutoff, with absence checked using the Infini-gram API. For each document, they construct several forms of evidence. Paraphrases generated with GPT-4.1 serve as a control for linguistic variation. Auxiliary views generated with GPT-5-mini include textbook-style explanations, Stack Exchange-style Q&A, and blog-style expositions. Prerequisite knowledge is generated as textbook material. Contextual knowledge is collected from cited arXiv papers and cited legal opinions; the medical setting is excluded from this part due to the lack of a comparable citation structure. Learning is measured with LAMA-style probes, including factual probes and probes intended to test broader understanding. The experiments compare repetition, paraphrasing, auxiliary views, contextual knowledge, prerequisite knowledge, and teacher strength under controlled token budgets. The paper also examines how these data choices change layer-wise encoding and compression of knowledge.
summary_en.experiments: The main findings are clear. First, repetition is necessary for new knowledge acquisition; paraphrasing helps, but its benefit is concentrated at smaller batch sizes and weakens as batch size grows. This suggests that paraphrasing partly improves gradient coverage rather than always adding new conceptual information. Second, when the token budget is fixed, allocating tokens away from repeated original documents and toward auxiliary views improves both understanding-oriented probes and factual recall. This is the strongest result because factual recall is often assumed to benefit mainly from repeated exposure. Third, auxiliary views remain useful even when they are not generated by the strongest teacher model. Fourth, contextual and prerequisite knowledge help when the model lacks relevant prior knowledge. The scale trend is also important: larger models integrate diverse views more effectively, encode knowledge with better parameter efficiency, and shift learning toward middle and later layers. The concrete setup includes 36 source documents across 3 domains with 12 documents per domain; exact accuracy gains should be read from the paper’s figures and tables.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read carefully in about 1.5–2 hours. Start with the data construction and leakage controls, because the validity of the conclusions depends on whether the documents really function as new knowledge. Then focus on the fixed-token-budget comparisons between repetition, paraphrases, and auxiliary views. The batch-size ablation is important for understanding why paraphrasing helps in some regimes but not others. The contextual and prerequisite knowledge experiments are the most useful parts for domain continued pretraining. The layer-wise analysis is worth reading if the goal is to connect data representation with internal knowledge encoding. Key questions to keep in mind: whether auxiliary views introduce probe-format bias, whether the gains come from semantic coverage or longer inferential chains, and how the same principle could be implemented in a large-scale mixed pretraining corpus.

recommendation.zh: 极其重要的预训练数据机制研究，证明了在固定 token 预算下，用 auxiliary views 替代简单的文档重复能显著提升知识获取，直接指导 pretrain data mixture 和合成数据策略。
recommendation.en: A crucial mechanistic study on pre-training data, proving that replacing simple document repetition with auxiliary views under a fixed token budget significantly improves knowledge acquisition, directly guiding pretrain data mixture and synthetic data strategies.

paper.title: Building Pretraining Data for World Models: An Unreal Engine-Based Pipeline for Action-Conditioned Video Generation
paper.abstract: Action-conditioned video models require large-scale visual data paired with control signals that are temporally aligned with the resulting scene transitions. Such supervision is difficult to obtain from ordinary real-world video because the actions that caused each visual change are typically unknown. We present a large-scale synthetic data production pipeline built on Unreal Engine for generating action-conditioned, multi-view video. To accommodate the different execution requirements of real-t

summary.core_problem: 解决 action-conditioned world model 缺少大规模、动作与视频严格时序对齐训练数据的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是数据生产管线与合成语料构建。对做世界模型、视频生成预训练的人有参考价值，但与 LLM 基座预训练的直接距离较远。
summary.technical_approach: 基于 Unreal Engine 搭建两阶段数据生产流程：第一阶段在实时物理环境中执行轨迹并记录逐帧角色状态、控制输入和相机状态；第二阶段在独立进程中回放轨迹并用高质量离线渲染生成视频。外围再配套分布式生产系统、缓存感知任务切分和节点级调度，以提高吞吐与一致性。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出最终数据规模、模型参数量或具体 world model 训练结果。可确认的是，论文重点不在新模型，而在能稳定产出多视角、动作条件、时序对齐视频数据的工程化 pipeline。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自京东 Joy Future Academy、清华大学、香港科技大学。Nan Duan 来自工业界大模型/多模态研究背景，这使其在数据生产系统设计上有一定参考价值。

summary_en.core_problem: It tackles the lack of large-scale training data where actions are temporally aligned with resulting videos for action-conditioned world models.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a synthetic data production pipeline and dataset construction recipe. It is relevant to world-model and video-pretraining work, but only indirectly relevant to LLM foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Built on Unreal Engine, the pipeline uses two stages: Stage I runs real-time physics and records per-frame character states, control inputs, and camera states; Stage II replays trajectories in a separate process and renders high-quality videos offline. A distributed production system with cache-aware partitioning and node-level scheduling supports scalable generation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide final data scale, model size, or downstream world-model results. The emphasis is on a robust engineering pipeline for producing multi-view, action-conditioned, temporally aligned video data rather than a new model.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from JD Joy Future Academy, Tsinghua University, and HKUST. Nan Duan has an industry background in large-model and multimodal research, which makes the systems angle somewhat more relevant.

recommendation.zh: 若你关心 world model 数据供给，可只看 pipeline 设计；对文本 LLM 预训练帮助有限，不值得深读正文。
recommendation.en: Useful only if you care about world-model data supply; for text LLM pretraining, skim the pipeline and move on.

paper.title: Synthetic Semantic Supervision for Contrastive Code Representation Learning in Small Transformers: An Empirical Study
paper.abstract: General-purpose code embeddings power tools for code search, classification, and retrieval. Compact transformer encoders for code typically rely on either human-written docstrings (labor-intensive and inconsistent) or mined structural signals such as execution traces (setting-specific and costly to collect). We empirically study an alternative: contrastive pretraining of small encoders with synthetically generated natural-language descriptions emphasizing code functionality and intent, paired wi

summary.core_problem: 小参数代码编码器在缺少高质量语义监督（docstring/trace）时，如何获得更强的通用代码表征用于检索/分类等任务。
summary.importance: 贡献类型偏“数据合成 + 对比学习经验结论”：用合成自然语言功能描述作为训练期语义监督，验证其对小模型代码 embedding 的收益与边界；对“用 LLM 合成监督喂小模型”这一常见工程路径给出较系统的实证信号。
summary.technical_approach: 双塔对比学习：训练时将(代码, 合成的自然语言功能/意图描述)配对做对比学习；推理时丢弃文本塔，仅保留小型 Transformer 编码器作为代码 embedding 模型。核心变量是“语义监督来源”从人工 docstring/结构信号转为合成描述，并在多语言(C/C++/Java)与多任务上做对照。
summary.experiments: 在 8 个检索/分类/生成相关任务上，对比同等推理尺寸的预训练基线、通用 LLM、embedding 专用模型；结论是合成语义监督在 5/8 任务上显著优于同尺寸预训练基线，2/8 持平；微调后可达到或超过若干零样本设置（摘要未给出参数量/数据规模与具体提升幅度）。

summary_en.core_problem: How to improve general-purpose code representations for small Transformer encoders when high-quality semantic supervision (docstrings/traces) is unavailable or costly.
summary_en.importance: Primarily a synthetic-supervision + contrastive-learning empirical study: it tests whether LLM-generated functional/intent descriptions can serve as training-time semantic supervision for small code embedding models, providing practical evidence for the common “distill semantics into a small encoder” workflow.
summary_en.technical_approach: Dual-encoder contrastive pretraining on (code, synthetic natural-language description) pairs; the text side is used only during training and discarded at inference, keeping a compact code encoder for embeddings. The key intervention is replacing human docstrings/structural signals with synthetic semantic descriptions.
summary_en.experiments: Benchmarked on 8 retrieval/classification/generation-related tasks across C/C++/Java against same-inference-size pretraining baselines, generalist LLMs, and embedding-specific models; reports statistically significant gains on 5/8 tasks and parity on 2/8 (abstract does not specify model/data scale or exact deltas).

recommendation.zh: 把它当“合成语义监督蒸馏到小编码器”的实证记录看：只需扫实验设置与失败任务，别指望有新预训练范式。
recommendation.en: Read it as evidence for “synthetic semantic supervision distilled into a small encoder”; skim the setup and where it fails—there’s no new pretraining paradigm.

paper.title: Xiaomi-TabLDM: A Tabular Foundation Model Technical Report
paper.abstract: We introduce Xiaomi-TabLDM, a tabular large data foundation model for classification and regression via in-context learning, which delivers superior prediction accuracy without requiring task-specific fine-tuning. Pretrained exclusively on synthetic data generated from structural causal models (SCMs), our model enables more flexible context utilization and more efficient capacity scaling.   i) A new performance standard. Strong regression performance across benchmarks: Xiaomi-TabLDM ranks 1st on

summary.core_problem: 如何构建一个无需针对每个数据集重新训练，即可通过上下文学习（In-Context Learning）在多样化表格数据上实现强泛化预测的表格基础模型？
summary.importance: 展示了表格基础模型（Tabular Foundation Models）在回归任务上的巨大潜力，并通过引入稀疏专家计算和灵活的上下文利用机制，在提升模型容量的同时控制了推理成本。这为结构化数据的通用预测提供了一个强有力的 Baseline，推动了表格数据处理从“一数据集一模型”向“预训练+上下文学习”范式的转变。
summary.technical_approach: 提出了 Xiaomi-TabLDM，一个基于 Transformer 的上下文学习模型。核心创新包括：1) 列级特征嵌入：使用双流特征分组和 Set Transformer 提取列表示，增强对特征排列的鲁棒性；2) 行级特征聚合：引入轻量级 Attention Residual (AttnRes) 连接，替代传统的加性残差；3) 稀疏专家计算：在保持激活计算量有限的前提下，扩大模型总容量；4) 大规模合成数据预训练与测试时计算扩展。
summary.experiments: 在 TALENT、TabArena、BCCO 和 OpenML-CTR23 四个基准上评估。在回归任务上表现尤为突出：在 OpenML-CTR23 上排名第一，在 TabArena 上回归 Elo 排名第二。与 TabFM 相比，在 TabArena 回归任务上，训练时间减少 82%，预测时间减少 68%，同时取得了更高的 Elo 分数。在同等参数规模下，性能优于 TabPFN-3。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注 Overall Framework 部分，特别是列级特征嵌入（Set Transformer 的应用）和行级特征聚合（AttnRes 的设计）。实验部分可重点看其在回归任务上的表现以及与 TabPFN 系列的对比，这反映了当前表格基础模型的 SOTA 水平。

summary_en.core_problem: How to build a tabular foundation model that achieves strong generalization across diverse tabular datasets via in-context learning, without requiring dataset-specific retraining?
summary_en.importance: Demonstrates the significant potential of tabular foundation models, particularly for regression tasks. By incorporating sparse expert computation and flexible context utilization, it scales model capacity while controlling inference costs. This provides a strong baseline for general-purpose structured data prediction and advances the paradigm shift from dataset-specific models to 'pretraining + in-context learning'.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces Xiaomi-TabLDM, a Transformer-based in-context learning model. Key innovations include: 1) Column-wise feature embedding: uses dual-stream feature grouping and a Set Transformer to extract column representations, enhancing robustness to feature permutation; 2) Row-wise feature aggregation: introduces lightweight Attention Residual (AttnRes) connections to replace standard additive residuals; 3) Sparse expert computation: expands total model capacity while keeping activated computation limited; 4) Large-scale synthetic pretraining and test-time compute scaling.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on TALENT, TabArena, BCCO, and OpenML-CTR23. Excels in regression: ranks 1st on OpenML-CTR23 and 2nd in regression Elo on TabArena. Compared to TabFM on TabArena regression, it reduces training time by 82% and prediction time by 68% while achieving a higher Elo. Outperforms TabPFN-3 at a comparable model scale.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Overall Framework, specifically the column-wise feature embedding (application of Set Transformer) and row-wise feature aggregation (design of AttnRes). In the experiments, pay attention to its performance on regression tasks and the comparison with the TabPFN series, which reflects the current SOTA for tabular foundation models.

recommendation.zh: 小米提出的表格数据基础模型，完全使用合成数据预训练，展示了 ICL 在结构化数据上的潜力，关注其合成数据生成逻辑和模型架构设计。
recommendation.en: A tabular foundation model by Xiaomi, pretrained entirely on synthetic data, demonstrating the potential of ICL on structured data. Pay attention to its synthetic data generation logic and model architecture design.

paper.title: SonicCaps: Large-Scale Diverse and Fine-Grained Captioning for Improved Audio-Retrieval
paper.abstract: Recent advances in audio-language modeling have been driven by large-scale audio captioning datasets. However, existing datasets remain limited by low semantic diversity, generic descriptions lacking acoustic details, and one-to-one audio-caption mappings that poorly reflect the inherent ambiguity of auditory perception. We introduce SonicCaps, a large-scale audio captioning dataset comprising ~15M captions paired with ~700k audio clips, generated using a multi-modal large language model (Qwen3-

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是音频-文本预训练数据中的 caption 质量和多样性不足问题：同一段音频常有多种合理描述，但现有数据集通常只有少量、偏泛化、缺少声学细节的文本标注。
summary.importance: 这项工作与通用 LLM 预训练的关系是跨模态数据构建，尤其是 audio-language 模型的数据侧问题。它的主要价值不在模型结构，而在说明音频 caption 不能只追求规模，还要显式处理一音多文、语义粒度、风格变化和声学属性覆盖。对统一多模态预训练有启发：当模态信息本身有歧义时，单一 caption 会把多种可接受解释压成一个标签，可能损害 contrastive learning 和检索泛化；多 caption 采样可以作为一种低成本的数据增广和监督平滑。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构建 SonicCaps，包含约 70 万条音频和约 1500 万条 caption。caption 由多模态大模型 Qwen3-Omni 生成，条件同时包含音频和已有文本信息。流程分三步：第一是 fidelity-focused recaptioning，目标是生成更忠实于音频内容、包含更多声学细节的描述；第二是 diversity-focused recaptioning，通过结构化 prompt 和 few-shot generation 为每段音频生成约 24 条 caption，覆盖主描述、不同 verbose 程度、不同写作风格的改写，以及 semantic tags；第三是 post-processing，用于清理和规范输出。设计重点是把 auditory perception 的一对多特性显式写进数据生成流程，而不是为每段音频保留一个看似标准的描述。
summary.experiments: 论文报告了两类结果。第一，使用 SonicCaps 的多样化 caption 训练 CLAP 类音频-文本检索模型，在 audio retrieval 和 zero-shot classification 上相对现有训练数据获得一致提升，并且在公开与 proprietary benchmark 上都有泛化收益。作者还释放了面向检索的 SonicCLAP_AR。第二，作者设计了人类 pairwise caption evaluation 框架，从多个定性维度比较 caption，并收集结构化反馈。人评显示 fidelity-focused captions 更符合人类偏好，也被认为更具描述性，能覆盖更丰富的声学细节。基于这些 caption 训练的 CLAP 模型，其 CLAP score 与人类 MOS score 的一致性更好，作者释放了 SonicCLAP_MOS。全文片段未给出完整表格数值，因此具体提升幅度需要读实验表确认。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看 SonicCaps 数据构建部分，尤其是音频来源、三阶段 captioning pipeline、每段音频约 24 条 caption 的类型设计，以及 post-processing 规则。实验部分建议看数据混合和 caption 采样策略的消融，因为这比最终检索分数更能解释收益来源。人评框架也值得快速看一遍，它体现了作者如何定义“好音频 caption”：不只是事件名称正确，还包括背景、质感、时间动态、强度变化等声学属性。若关注统一音频 LM 或 audio-text pretraining，可重点判断这些 caption 是否适合作为生成式训练目标，而不只是 contrastive retrieval 监督。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a data bottleneck in audio-language pretraining: existing audio captions are often generic, low-diversity, and sparse, even though a single audio clip can support many valid textual descriptions at different levels of detail.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance is multimodal pretraining data, not model architecture. The paper makes a useful point for audio-language and unified multimodal training: scale alone is insufficient if captions collapse ambiguous audio perception into one canonical sentence. For contrastive learning, retrieval, and possibly generative audio-language modeling, multiple captions per clip can serve as both data augmentation and a softer supervision signal. The work is also a reminder that caption quality should include acoustic attributes such as texture, background ambience, temporal dynamics, and intensity, not only the dominant sound event.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build SonicCaps, a dataset with roughly 700k audio clips and about 15M captions. Captions are generated with Qwen3-Omni, conditioned on both audio and existing text metadata. The pipeline has three stages. First, fidelity-focused recaptioning aims to produce descriptions that better match the actual sound and include richer acoustic detail. Second, diversity-focused recaptioning uses structured prompts and few-shot generation to produce around 24 captions per clip, including main descriptions, rephrased variants with different verbosity and styles, and semantic tags. Third, post-processing cleans and normalizes the generated outputs. The core design choice is to encode the one-to-many nature of auditory perception into the dataset rather than treating each clip as having a single target caption.
summary_en.experiments: The reported experiments cover retrieval, zero-shot classification, and human caption evaluation. Training CLAP-style audio-text models with diverse SonicCaps captions yields consistent gains on audio retrieval and zero-shot classification compared with existing data baselines, with improvements observed on both public and proprietary benchmarks. The authors release SonicCLAP_AR for audio retrieval. They also introduce a pairwise human evaluation framework for caption quality across qualitative dimensions. Human evaluation shows that fidelity-focused captions are preferred more often and are judged to be more descriptive, especially in capturing fine acoustic detail. A CLAP model trained on these captions aligns better with human MOS scores, released as SonicCLAP_MOS. The provided text does not include the full numeric tables, so exact gains should be checked in the experiment section.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus first on the SonicCaps construction section: audio sources, the three-stage captioning pipeline, the design of roughly 24 captions per clip, and the post-processing rules. In the experiments, prioritize ablations on data composition and caption sampling because they explain where the gains come from better than headline retrieval scores alone. The human evaluation protocol is also useful, since it clarifies what the authors count as a high-quality audio caption: not only correct event labels, but also ambience, texture, temporal structure, and intensity. For researchers working on unified audio-language pretraining, the key question is whether these captions are suitable as generative targets in addition to contrastive retrieval supervision.

recommendation.zh: 做音频/语音预训练的人可以看，重点不是模型而是数据 recipe；先盯住“24 captions per clip”到底带来信息增益还是只是 prompt 扩写噪声。
recommendation.en: Worth a look if you work on audio/speech pretraining—the value is in the data recipe, not the model; the key question is whether 24 captions per clip add real signal or just prompt-expanded noise.

stage_evidence.quote: The paper tackles a data bottleneck in audio-language pretraining: existing audio captions are often generic, low-diversity, and sparse, even though a single audio clip can support many valid textual descr
论文解决的是音频-文本预训练数据中的 caption 质量和多样性不足问题：同一段音频常有多种合理描述，但现有数据集通常只有少量、偏泛化、缺少声学细节的文本标注。

paper.title: PersonaForge: Realistic Multi-Turn User Simulation for Agentic Systems
paper.abstract: Large language models are increasingly used as agentic workflow executors, yet existing training data and benchmarks largely assume informationally complete, single-turn queries. Our analysis of 16K real-world sessions shows that 75.9% of interactions are multi-turn, revealing a substantial gap between how users interact with agents and how such systems are trained and evaluated. We introduce \textbf{PersonaForge}, a user simulation framework for synthesizing realistic multi-turn user--agent int

summary.core_problem: 现有 agent 训练与评测大多假设单轮、信息完备用户输入，无法覆盖真实多轮交互中的用户行为分布。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的主要价值是评测与数据资产：用真实会话统计驱动用户模拟，构造多轮 agent 训练集和 benchmark。对 pretrain 本身帮助有限，但对 post-train agent 数据分布设计有现实意义。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先分析 16K 真实会话，发现 75.9% 交互是多轮；随后提出 PersonaForge 用户模拟框架，包含四维 persona 空间、SOUL 行为控制，以及基于真实种子查询的 Reverse Deep Construction。基于该框架构建 6.3K 训练数据和 PersonaForge-Bench，覆盖 20 多个专业领域，并采用四维评分。
summary.experiments: 在 Qwen3.5-27B 上，PersonaForge 训练带来复合分数约 +4 的提升。实验重点是多轮 agent 训练和评测，而不是基座模型预训练。摘要没有给出更大规模模型、跨家族泛化或更严格的 ablation 细节，因此更适合作为 agent eval/data 资产参考。
summary.authors_note: Peking University、Xiaomi 等；Lei Li、Lingpeng Kong 属于较知名研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: Current agent training and evaluation mostly assume single-turn, information-complete user queries, missing the distribution of real multi-turn interactions.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is an evaluation and data asset: a user simulator grounded in real session statistics, plus a multi-turn training set and benchmark. It is only indirectly relevant to pretraining, but useful for post-training data design for agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper analyzes 16K real-world sessions and finds that 75.9% are multi-turn. It then introduces PersonaForge, a user simulation framework with a four-dimensional persona space, SOUL-based behavioral control, and Reverse Deep Construction seeded from authentic queries. This is used to build a 6.3K training set and PersonaForge-Bench with 138 manually annotated tasks across 20+ professional domains and four-dimensional scoring.
summary_en.experiments: On Qwen3.5-27B, training with PersonaForge improves the composite score by about +4. The focus is multi-turn agent training/evaluation rather than foundation-model pretraining. The abstract does not show broader cross-model generalization or especially deep ablations, so this is best treated as an agent eval/data reference.
summary_en.authors_note: Peking University, Xiaomi, and collaborators; Lei Li and Lingpeng Kong are recognizable researchers.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心 post-train agent 数据分布，这篇可看真实会话统计和 benchmark 设计；对 pretrain 几乎没有直接动作，不必细读方法细节。
recommendation.en: If you care about post-training data distributions for agents, read the real-session statistics and benchmark design; it has little direct consequence for pretraining, so skip the method details.

paper.title: StepGuard: Learning Step-Level Guardrails with Scalable Supervision and Safety-Utility Balancing
paper.abstract: LLM-based agents can interact with external environments through tool invocation, but this capability also introduces security risks such as file modification, information leakage, and unauthorized actions. Existing guardrails often evaluate completed trajectories, leaving pre-execution monitoring of step-level actions underexplored. We propose StepGuard, a step-level guard model that can audit completed agent trajectories and check tool actions before they are executed. To train StepGuard, we i

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM agent 工具调用中的安全问题，尤其是如何在动作执行前做 step-level 风险审计，而不是只在整条轨迹结束后做事后判断。
summary.importance: 属于后训练与安全对齐方向。对基座预训练研究员的价值主要在训练信号设计：同上下文下构造安全/不安全动作对，以及如何在 guard model 训练中平衡过防御与漏防御。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 StepGuard，一个可用于轨迹审计和执行前检查的 step-level guard model。训练数据由 StepGen 自动生成：在相同上下文下，只替换风险步骤的动作，形成 safe/unsafe 对照。训练上再引入 Balance-GRPO，根据 safe/unsafe 两类动作当前准确率动态调节学习权重，试图同时压低 over-defense 和 under-defense。
summary.experiments: 摘要称 StepGuard 在 open-weight guard models 中平均准确率最高，性能接近 GPT-5.4，并能在 Agent 安全评测上有效保护下游 agent。未给出模型规模、数据量和具体 benchmark 名称，因此目前更像值得跟踪的工程型后训练工作，而不是可直接迁移到 pretrain 的方法论文。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses safety in tool-using LLM agents, focusing on step-level auditing before an action is executed rather than only judging a completed trajectory afterward.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training and alignment paper. Its relevance to pretraining researchers mainly comes from training-signal design: constructing safe/unsafe action pairs under identical context, and balancing over-refusal against missed detections during guard-model training.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes StepGuard, a step-level guard model for both trajectory auditing and pre-execution action checking. Training data are generated by StepGen, which creates paired safe and unsafe trajectories by changing only the risky action under the same context. Training then uses Balance-GRPO, which dynamically reweights learning on safe versus unsafe actions based on observed accuracy to reduce both over-defense and under-defense.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims the best average accuracy among open-weight guard models, with performance comparable to GPT-5.4, and improved protection for downstream agents on agent-safety evaluations. However, model size, data scale, and benchmark details are missing from the abstract, so this currently looks more like a practical post-training systems paper than something directly transferable to pretraining.

recommendation.zh: 对 pretrain 的直接价值有限，但“同上下文只改危险动作”的对比式数据构造很干净；只看数据引擎和 Balance-GRPO 即可。
recommendation.en: Limited direct pretraining value, but the paired same-context action construction is clean; read the data engine and Balance-GRPO parts, skip the rest.

paper.title: RecPFN: Prior-Fitted Networks for In-Context-Based Recommendations
paper.abstract: We introduce RecPFN, a prior-fitted network that brings in-context learning to sequential recommendation. RecPFN is pretrained entirely on synthetic clickstream environments sampled from a broad structural causal prior, enabling it to amortize Bayesian-style inference from a small support set. At inference, a lightweight decoder-only transformer conditions on a handful of domain sequences and produces next-item predictions for queries in a single forward pass, without any weight updates. summary.core_problem: 如何利用在合成数据上预训练的 Transformer 模型，通过上下文学习 (ICL) 实现零样本的序列推荐。

paper.title: The Fairness Collapse Phenomenon: Bias Amplification in Language Models Trained on Synthetic Data
paper.abstract: Generative models trained on artificially generated data have been shown to exhibit model collapse, resulting in significant performance degradation. As synthetic content increasingly contaminates the training corpora of language models, this raises critical concerns about the use of open data in continued pretraining. summary.importance: 这篇工作的价值在于把“model collapse”从性能层面扩展到公平性层面，提出 fairness collapse 这一数据污染风险视角；它更像数据分布与 continual pretrain 风险分析，而不是新方法。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构造受控递归训练流程：用模型生成的合成数据反复训练后续代模型，并在 Bias in Bios 上跟踪人口统计刻板印象与偏见指标的代际变化，分析 synthetic contamination 对偏见放大的影响。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether repeated training on synthetic data amplifies social bias in language models, beyond the already discussed performance-side model collapse.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is conceptual: extending model-collapse concerns from capability degradation to fairness degradation, framed as fairness collapse. This is more a data-risk analysis for continual pretraining than a new method.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build controlled recursive training regimes where later-generation models are trained on synthetic data produced by earlier models, and then track demographic stereotype amplification on Bias in Bios across generations.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract indicates controlled experiments on Bias in Bios under repeated synthetic-data training. There is no evidence of large-scale frontier-model pretraining or realistic web-scale contamination mixtures, so the result should be treated as a directional warning rather than a settled law.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Laboratoire Hubert Curien, CNRS UMR 5516.

paper.title: DeepVoyager-VL: Incentivizing Vision-in-the-Loop Search for Long-Horizon Multimodal Agents
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have advanced visual understanding and reasoning, yet their static parametric knowledge limits their ability to address knowledge-intensive and dynamically evolving open-world problems. To move beyond this limitation, multimodal deep search has emerged as a key direction for open-world information access, evolving from single-turn factual retrieval toward long-horizon, multi-turn search guided by visual evidence. However, existing methods typically confin

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是多模态 agent 在开放世界长时程搜索中，视觉信息只出现在输入或答案阶段、无法持续驱动中间检索与推理的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent 框架加训练数据合成。它对预训练本身不是直接推进，但对“视觉证据如何进入长时程决策闭环”有一定方法论价值，尤其适合关注 post-train 与 agent 反馈如何反哺多模态基座的人。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 DeepVoyager-VL，一个 vision-in-the-loop 的长时程 multimodal deep-search 框架。核心包括：构建 multimodal event graph 来驱动数据合成，生成需要多轮交互和视觉证据持续参与的问题；在 agent 过程中让视觉证据不仅用于初始理解和最终回答，还参与中间检索、状态更新和后续搜索决策。方法重点在于把视觉观察纳入 search trajectory，而不是做静态 VQA。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明实验关注 long-horizon multimodal search，比较对象应是只在输入/输出阶段使用视觉的现有多模态搜索或检索增强方法。摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据量和具体提升幅度，因此目前更适合把它看成 agent 设计与数据构造工作，而非可直接迁移到预训练 recipe 的结论。
summary.authors_note: 从作者名单看是较大团队协作，含 Bowen Zhou、Bo Li 等名字，但仅凭当前信息无法稳妥确认具体机构归属。

summary_en.core_problem: This paper addresses the limitation that multimodal agents use vision only at the input or answer stage, rather than letting visual evidence drive intermediate retrieval and reasoning in long-horizon open-world search.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly an agent framework plus training-data synthesis. It does not directly advance pretraining, but it is relevant if you care about how visual evidence should enter long-horizon decision loops and how post-training/agent signals may feed back into multimodal foundation models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes DeepVoyager-VL, a vision-in-the-loop framework for long-horizon multimodal deep search. The key components are: a multimodal event graph for data synthesis, producing problems that require multi-turn interaction with persistent visual grounding; and an agent design where visual evidence participates not only in initial understanding and final answering, but also in intermediate retrieval, state updates, and subsequent search decisions. The emphasis is on integrating vision into the search trajectory rather than treating it as static VQA.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract suggests experiments on long-horizon multimodal search, likely comparing against methods that use vision only at the input/output stage. The abstract does not provide model sizes, data scale, or exact gains, so this currently reads more as an agent/data-construction paper than a result that can be directly transferred into pretraining recipes.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list suggests a large collaborative team and includes names such as Bowen Zhou and Bo Li, but the exact institutional affiliations cannot be confirmed from the provided metadata alone.

recommendation.en: Read it only if you care about how multimodal agent trajectories become new training signals; otherwise this is closer to an application-oriented agent paper than a foundation-model result.

paper.title: Evidence-Type Competition: When Can Interventional Data Teach Language Models Causal Direction?
paper.abstract: Interventional data is widely regarded as the gold standard for teaching models causal reasoning. We test this assumption in a fully controlled synthetic environment pitting observational correlation against causal effect, and find it fails instructively. In Simpson's-paradox worlds, where the two have systematically opposite signs, increasing the fraction of interventional samples in pretraining does not improve causal direction: the magnitude of the model's do()-response grows monotonically, y

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作检验一个很常见但很少被严格验证的假设：只要在预训练里加入更多干预数据，语言模型就会更容易学到因果方向。作者把问题放进完全可控的合成结构因果模型环境里，专门构造 Simpson 悖论世界，让观测相关与真实因果效应符号相反。这样可以把“模型到底是在学相关，还是在学因果方向”拆得很干净。全文给出的结论是否定的：提高训练中干预样本占比，并不会稳定提升因果方向判断；模型会随着干预比例上升而更好地学到 do 响应的幅度，但方向仍持续被上下文中的观测证据牵着走。这不是简单的失败结果，而是揭示了一个更细的现象：幅度和方向被模型以不同方式编码，方向判断主要受推理时上下文证据类型控制，而不是受训练混合比例直接控制。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要有三层。第一，它直接挑战了“多加高层级因果数据就会自然带来更强因果能力”这类数据配比直觉。至少在这类受控环境里，训练分布里有多少 intervention，并不是决定模型是否使用 intervention 证据的主变量。第二，它把问题从“数据里有没有因果信号”推进到“模型在什么上下文下会调用哪类证据”。这对预训练和 post-train 都有启发：数据混合之外，提示格式、上下文证据组织、训练时 evidence type 的条件化方式，可能同样关键。第三，方法论上它给出了一个较干净的因果评测框架：在线生成、训练/验证/测试世界严格隔离、可计算真值、还能量化 probe 评测的采样噪声地板。对研究训练动态、数据课程、合成因果语料的人，这种实验设计比直接在自然语言 benchmark 上看分数更有解释力。量级上，它不是直接改进大模型能力的工程结果，而是一个会影响数据配比和因果训练假设的负结果研究。
summary.technical_approach:
技术上最重要的是实验控制做得很严。作者使用参数化 SCM 生成世界：5 到 12 个节点，图结构在 Erdős–Rényi 与 scale-free 间随机，机制既有线性也有非线性，并用 confounding strength ρ 控制潜在混杂。测试域固定在高混杂 ρ=0.9，并筛出观测相关与因果效应符号相反的三元组，形成标准 Simpson trap。训练数据在线生成，避免固定语料记忆污染。每个样本由 4 条 evidence record 加 1 个 query 组成，evidence type 被系统拆成 obs、int、probe、obs_probe、none。这里 probe 很关键：它不是一般 intervention，而是直接对查询变量 X 做 do(X=v)，并观察所有变量响应，因此最接近回答目标查询所需的局部因果证据。

作者先做 α-mixture 扫描：训练时每个样本以概率 α 来自 interventional distribution，α 从 0 到 1 分六档。结果发现 corrected sign accuracy 没有随 α 单调上升，但 Simpson-slope 的幅度单调增大。于是作者提出 magnitude-direction duality：模型从干预数据里学到了响应强度，却没有学会在冲突证据下翻转方向。

接着，全文真正的主结果来自 evidence-type factor 分析。作者固定训练配方，尤其固定在 α=1.0 的纯干预训练，再在推理时只改变上下文证据类型，比较 pure obs、mixed、pure probes 等条件。结果显示，是否能恢复正确因果方向，主要由上下文里放的是什么证据决定，而且呈现剂量效应：观测证据越多，因果方向越被压制。随后用一组零训练成本的 inference-time intervention 去定位机制：增加 probe 数量不能解除压制；删掉观测记录则立刻恢复正确插值；只保留观测格式 token 但移除观测内容时，压制也会释放。这说明抑制不是训练阶段把能力学坏了，而是推理时被上下文内容门控掉了。作者把这种现象描述为“插值电路一直在参数里，但被上下文关掉”。

另外两个技术点也值得注意。其一，作者专门分析了 probe-based causal evaluation 的噪声地板：即便是完美插值器，单次采样也会有 26% 的符号错误，因此必须做 evidence averaging，否则容易把评测噪声误判成模型缺陷。其二，作者做了 0.93B 规模的 rate-level persistence 检查，以及 CLadder 审计与 sign randomization 分析，发现模型还学到一个正效应先验，而且这个先验有两层结构。这些补充实验让结论不只停留在小模型玩具现象。
summary.experiments:
关键实验有五组。第一组是 α 扫描。25.7M GPT-style decoder，8 层，词表 41，block size 640，训练 20,000 steps，batch 64，学习率 6e-4。α∈{0,0.1,…,1.0} 的六级扫描中，corrected sign accuracy 大致为 0.5/0.3/0.2/0.4/0.4/0.4，没有随干预比例增加而改善；但 Simpson-slope 幅度从 0.169 单调升到 0.384，说明模型确实吸收了更多干预信号，只是没有把它用于方向判定。

第二组是 50 个世界上的 evidence-type 四臂比较。在固定训练下，pure obs、mixed、pure probes 等上下文条件的 mean ratio_true 从 -0.288、-0.092 到 +0.418，配对 McNemar 检验显著，p 值最低到 1.1e-9。这个结果比 α 扫描更强，因为它说明主导变量是 inference context，而不是 train mixture。

第三组是机制定位实验 E1。把 probe 剂量翻倍，抑制不解除；把观测证据删掉，ratio_true 从 -0.09 直接升到 +0.56，接近 probe-only 模型；说明 suppression 发生在推理时，而不是训练时缺失了能力。

第四组是 E5 的 dose titration 和 content manipulation。1 条观测记录几乎不抑制，2 条开始稀释，4 条则基本“捕获”方向判断；如果只保留观测格式 token 而移除内容，抑制会消失。也就是说，关键不是表面模板，而是观测内容本身。

第五组是稳健性与边界条件。作者报告这种 suppression 在 0.93B 规模上仍存在；novel-topology 域也做了泛化隔离；CLadder 审计显示模型存在 learned positive-effect prior，并通过 sign randomization 暴露其分层结构。虽然全文不是大规模 LLM 训练论文，但实验设计完整，负结果可信度较高。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction 里对 H1 的定义、magnitude–direction duality 的提出，以及 evidence-type factor 的主结论。然后直接看 Table 1 和 Figure 1，这两处基本概括了全文最重要的发现：训练混合比例不决定方向判断，推理上下文才决定。接着看方法部分里 synthetic world generator 和 evidence formats，理解 obs、int、probe 的区别，尤其 probe 为什么是回答 do 查询的关键证据。之后看 §4 关于 sampling noise floor 的分析，这一节很重要，因为它解释了为什么单次 probe 评测会高噪声。最后看 §5.3、§5.6 的 inference-time intervention 和 content manipulation，这里最能看出作者是在定位机制，而不是只报现象。预计 30 到 45 分钟可以抓住主线；如果关心因果预训练或数据配比，再细读 0.93B persistence 和 CLadder audit。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tests a common but rarely isolated assumption: adding more interventional data to pretraining should help a language model learn causal direction. The authors place this question in a fully controlled synthetic SCM setting and deliberately construct Simpson’s-paradox worlds where observational correlation and true causal effect have opposite signs. This makes it possible to separate “learning correlation” from “learning causal direction” with minimal ambiguity. The main result is negative in a precise way: increasing the intervention fraction in training does not reliably improve directional accuracy. What improves is the magnitude of the model’s do-response, while the sign remains copied from observational context. The core finding is therefore a magnitude–direction split: intervention helps the model estimate response strength, but contextual observational evidence still dominates directional judgment at inference time.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining research, the contribution is less about a new model and more about correcting a data-mixture intuition. The paper shows that, at least in this controlled regime, the amount of interventional data in pretraining is not the operative variable for whether the model uses interventional evidence correctly. That matters for anyone thinking about causal pretraining, synthetic data curricula, or “higher-quality evidence” mixtures. A second contribution is conceptual: the bottleneck is not only whether causal evidence exists in training, but also whether the inference context activates or suppresses its use. This shifts attention toward context formatting, evidence composition, and conditional retrieval of learned circuits. Third, the evaluation methodology is unusually clean: online data generation, strict train/val/test world separation, computable causal ground truth, and an explicit analysis of the noise floor in probe-based evaluation. It is a negative result, but one that meaningfully constrains how to think about causal data in pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The technical setup is carefully controlled. Worlds are generated from parametric structural causal models with 5–12 nodes, either Erdős–Rényi or scale-free topology, mixed linear/nonlinear mechanisms, and a confounding-strength parameter rho controlling latent confounding paths. The evaluation domain fixes strong confounding at rho=0.9 and selects triples where observational correlation and causal effect have opposite signs, creating a clean Simpson trap. Training data are generated online, so there is no fixed-corpus memorization issue.

Each sample contains four evidence records plus one query. Evidence types are systematically varied: observational records, generic interventions, direct probes on the queried variable, mixed observation-plus-probe contexts, and no-context cases. The distinction between generic intervention and probe is important. Probe records intervene directly on X, the queried cause, and expose downstream responses, so they are the most task-aligned evidence for answering do(X=x)->Y.

The first analysis sweeps the intervention mixture ratio alpha during training. This falsifies the simple hypothesis that more intervention in pretraining should monotonically improve causal direction. Directional accuracy does not improve monotonically, but the estimated Simpson slope grows in magnitude. The authors interpret this as a magnitude–direction duality.

The stronger result comes from isolating the evidence type present at inference time. With training held fixed, including the alpha=1.0 condition, they vary only the context evidence type and show a contextual dose gradient: more observational evidence in context suppresses correct causal direction more strongly. A set of zero-training-cost inference-time interventions then localizes the mechanism. Increasing probe dose does not rescue the model. Removing observational records immediately restores the latent interpolation ability. Keeping observational-format tokens while removing observational content also releases suppression. This argues that the relevant switch is content-mediated and acts at inference time, not that the model failed to store the causal interpolation circuit during training.

A final methodological contribution is the analysis of probe-evaluation noise. Even a perfect interpolator incurs substantial single-shot sign error, so evidence averaging is necessary. The paper also includes larger-scale persistence checks at 0.93B and CLadder-style audits showing a learned positive-effect prior with layered structure under sign randomization.
summary_en.experiments:
The main experiments come in five parts. First is the alpha sweep. Using a 25.7M GPT-style decoder with 8 layers, vocab size 41, block size 640, trained for 20k steps with batch size 64 and learning rate 6e-4, the authors vary the intervention fraction alpha across six levels from 0 to 1. Corrected sign accuracy is roughly 0.5/0.3/0.2/0.4/0.4/0.4, showing no monotonic gain from more intervention. In contrast, the Simpson-slope magnitude rises monotonically from 0.169 to 0.384.

Second is the 50-world evidence-type comparison. With training fixed, changing only the inference context shifts mean ratio_true from -0.288 in pure observational context to -0.092 in mixed context and +0.418 in pure probe context. Paired McNemar tests are highly significant, with p-values down to 1.1e-9.

Third is the inference-time mechanism test E1. Doubling the probe dose does not remove suppression. Erasing observational evidence raises ratio_true from about -0.09 to +0.56, close to the probe-only condition. This is strong evidence that the capability exists in the weights but is gated off by context.

Fourth is E5, which studies dose titration and content manipulation. One observational record barely suppresses, two dilute the causal signal, and four effectively capture the directional judgment. If observational-format tokens remain but observational content is removed, suppression disappears. The effect is therefore driven by content, not superficial formatting.

Fifth are robustness checks. The suppression pattern persists at 0.93B scale. The train/validation/test split is done over disjoint world domains, with additional novel-topology evaluation. CLadder audits reveal a learned positive-effect prior and suggest a two-layer structure under sign randomization. The paper is not a large-scale LLM systems study, but the experimental logic is strong and unusually well controlled.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction, especially the definition of H1, the magnitude–direction duality, and the claim that evidence type at inference dominates mixture ratio in training. Then go straight to Table 1 and Figure 1. Those two artifacts carry most of the paper’s message. After that, read the setup sections on the synthetic world generator and evidence formats, paying attention to why probe evidence is different from generic intervention. The section on the sampling noise floor is worth reading carefully because it explains why naive single-shot probe evaluation is misleading. Finally, focus on the inference-time intervention sections, especially the experiments that remove observational content or vary observational dose. That is where the paper moves from a negative result to a mechanism claim. A first pass should take around 30–45 minutes; read the larger-scale persistence and CLadder audit only if you care about robustness beyond the toy-model regime.

paper.title: OntoBook: Ontology-Grounded Synthetic Textbooks for Medical Encoder Pretraining
paper.abstract: We present OntoBook, a method that converts medical ontology structure into pretraining signal for encoder language models. Our approach has three stages: random walks through ontology graphs capture hierarchical and causal relations between medical codes, a large language model reformulates these walks into fluent textbook-style prose, and the resulting text is used to train ModernCamemBERT, a 149M-parameter French encoder, with two objectives on the same data: masked language modeling and rela

summary.core_problem: 如何把结构化医学本体（ontology）转成可用于语言模型预训练的高质量文本与关系监督信号。
summary.importance: 属于“结构→文本”的合成预训练数据管线，并强调多目标与数据对齐的重要性；虽然是医疗与法语 encoder 的垂直场景，但方法对合成数据与多任务预训练设计有可迁移的教训。
summary.technical_approach: 三步：①在本体图上做随机游走以采样层级/因果关系；②用 LLM 将游走序列改写为教材风格自然语言；③用同一份合成教材同时训练 MLM 与 code-pair 关系预测，并指出任务-数据对齐是关键（不同任务用不同数据会崩）。
summary.experiments: 训练 ModernCamemBERT（149M，法语 encoder）；在 FRACCO/Cantemist-FR/Distemist-FR 上优于仅 MLM 预训练（FRACCO +2.5 micro-F1，Distemist +8.0 micro-F1）；“任务各用不同数据”导致约 30 点退化；发布约 130 万合成教材，覆盖 CIM-10/CCAM/ATC 三个法语医学本体。

summary_en.core_problem: How to convert structured medical ontologies into effective pretraining signals (text + relations) for language models.
summary_en.importance: A structure-to-text synthetic pretraining pipeline highlighting objective/data alignment; domain-specific (French medical encoders) but offers transferable lessons for synthetic data and multi-objective pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Three stages: (1) random walks on ontology graphs to sample hierarchical/causal relations, (2) an LLM rewrites walks into fluent textbook-style prose, (3) pretrain with MLM plus relation prediction on the same synthetic corpus; shows misaligned data per objective collapses performance.
summary_en.experiments: Pretrains ModernCamemBERT (149M French encoder). Gains over MLM-only: +2.5 micro-F1 on FRACCO and +8.0 on Distemist-FR; misaligned training (different data per task) drops ~30 points. Releases ~1.3M synthetic textbooks from CIM-10/CCAM/ATC.

recommendation.zh: 别只看医疗结果，重点看“多目标必须共享同分布数据否则直接崩”的负例；合成数据管线可复用但外推需谨慎。
recommendation.en: Ignore the medical scores—focus on the strong negative result: multi-objective pretraining can collapse if objectives see mismatched data distributions; the synthetic pipeline is reusable but domain transfer is non-trivial.

paper.title: Answer-Conditioned Chains of Thought Degrade Verifiable-Reasoning Distillation in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: A standard recipe for distilling the reasoning ability of large language models (LLMs) is to sample chains of thought from the model, keep those that reach the correct final answer, and fine-tune on the survivors. When sampling fails, a common fix shows the generator the gold answer and asks it to write a chain that reaches that answer. We show that this second step degrades the training data in a way that correctness filtering cannot catch. We run a controlled experiment that fixes the generato

summary.core_problem: 这项工作研究一个常见但危险的推理蒸馏做法：当模型不能自己采样出正确 CoT 时，把 gold answer 放进 prompt，让模型写一条通向该答案的推理链，再用最终答案正确性过滤。作者要回答的是：这种 answer-conditioned CoT 即使答案正确，是否仍然是好的训练目标。
summary.importance: 结论对 reasoning SFT、self-training、RL 前的数据构造都有直接影响。最终答案正确性不是充分的数据质量信号。带答案生成的链条容易变成 rationalization，即先知道答案再补推理，而不是在 token 序列中执行可迁移的搜索过程。训练学生模仿这类轨迹，会把“朝已知答案组织解释”的行为迁移到无答案推理场景，导致 verifiable reasoning 下降。贡献量级不小：在数学推理上，同一问题集、同一生成器、同一过滤器、同一训练 recipe 下，只改变是否展示答案，就能造成 MATH-500 16.2 个百分点、AIME 27.2 个百分点的差距。这个结果提醒预训练和后训练团队，推理数据的 provenance 需要进入质量控制，而不能只看答案是否可验证。
summary.technical_approach:
核心设计是 one-bit experiment。作者固定生成模型、训练题目、正确性过滤器、数据量、训练 recipe，只改变一个二值因素：生成 CoT 时是否在 prompt 中展示 gold answer，并要求模型推到该答案。answer-blind 条件下，模型只看题目，自行采样推理链，随后用答案匹配保留正确样本；answer-conditioned 条件下，模型看到题目和 gold answer，被要求写出能到达该答案的链，同样只保留最终答案正确的样本。这样排除了“题目不同、过滤不同、模型不同”带来的混杂。

机制分析分两步。第一，作者把 answer visibility 和 rationalization instruction 拆开：仅让模型看到答案但用中性指令，并不会造成同样程度的伤害；真正有害的是“请推导到这个答案”的指令。第二，作者发现 answer-conditioned 链条更早声明答案，形成一种 off-policy 轨迹。这里的 off-policy 指训练目标偏离了模型在不知道答案时的自然搜索分布。学生模仿后，也更倾向于在自己输出中提前落答案，再补解释。作者进一步用一个简单过滤器删除“过早陈述答案”的链，能部分修复性能，说明这类 rationalized chains 承担了主要伤害。
summary.experiments:
主要实验使用 Qwen3-8B 做全参数 SFT，训练题来自 Nemotron-Cascade-SFT-Stage-2 的数学 split，评测用 vLLM thinking mode，在 MATH-500 上使用 32,768 token 预算和符号答案匹配。核心对比基于固定的 935 道训练题。Qwen3-8B 在该评测 harness 下的 base 分数为 95.2。作者报告，answer-conditioned corpus 训练出的学生在 MATH-500 上比 answer-blind corpus 弱 16.2 个百分点；在更难的 AIME/olympiad setting 上差距扩大到 27.2 个百分点。长度匹配控制和训练预算 sweep 后，差距仍然存在，并且随问题难度上升而变大。

代码任务中也复现了下降：即使所有保留样本都通过测试，answer-conditioned CoT 仍会伤害学生。相反，在多选知识和科学题上没有明显 penalty，因为这些任务主要是选择答案，不要求模型产生长链条推导。机制实验显示，过早写出答案的链条携带主要伤害；在同一个 answer-conditioned corpus 内部做差分分析，三随机种子的 difference-in-differences 达到 16.9 个百分点。作者还提出一个训练前可测的 signature：从少量未标注生成中读取模型是否倾向于早说答案。这个指标在 8 个模型、4 个模型家族上能排序 leakage penalty，并在 held-out family 上达到 2.9 个百分点的平均绝对误差。若管线无法避免展示 gold answer，用“先推导，最后再给答案”的中性/约束式指令可恢复约三分之二的损失。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读。先看 Introduction 中的 one-bit experiment 图和贡献列表，确认实验隔离了什么变量。随后重点读 Isolating Answer Leakage，尤其是生成条件、过滤器、训练题数量、SFT recipe、MATH-500 harness 和 token budget；这些细节决定结论是否能迁移到自己的数据管线。机制部分要重点看 prompt ablation：它区分了“看到答案”和“被要求 rationalize 到答案”。再看 early-answer signature 与过滤实验，这是最容易落地到数据质检的部分。最后读任务对比：数学和代码有 penalty，多选知识题没有 penalty，这说明风险主要出现在需要派生过程的 verifiable reasoning 数据中。值得深挖的问题有三个：如何定义更稳健的 rationalization detector；answer-conditioned 数据在 RL warmup 中是否同样有害；是否可以用过程验证器替代最终答案过滤来降低这种偏差。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a common failure mode in reasoning distillation: when a model cannot sample a correct chain of thought on its own, the pipeline shows it the gold answer and asks it to produce a chain that reaches that answer. The key question is whether such answer-conditioned chains remain good training targets after final-answer correctness filtering.
summary_en.importance: The result matters directly for reasoning SFT, self-training, and data construction before RL. Final-answer correctness is not a sufficient quality signal for reasoning traces. Chains written while seeing the answer often become rationalizations: they organize an explanation around a known endpoint rather than reproduce the search process needed at test time. Training on these traces transfers the wrong behavior to the student. The effect size is large under controlled conditions: with the same generator, problems, correctness filter, data volume, and fine-tuning recipe, changing only answer conditioning creates a 16.2-point gap on MATH-500 and a 27.2-point gap on AIME-style problems. For pretraining and post-training teams, the practical lesson is that data provenance has to be part of reasoning-data quality control.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The central design is a one-bit experiment. In the answer-blind condition, the generator sees only the problem, samples a chain, and the pipeline keeps chains whose final answer is correct. In the answer-conditioned condition, the generator sees both the problem and the gold answer, is asked to reach that answer, and the same correctness filter is applied. The setup fixes the generator, problem set, filter, training recipe, and data budget, so the intervention is isolated.

The mechanism analysis separates answer visibility from the instruction to rationalize. Merely showing the answer under a neutral instruction is much less harmful; the main damage comes from asking the model to derive toward the known answer. The observable symptom is early answer declaration. Answer-conditioned chains tend to state the answer near the beginning and then fill in the explanation. This is an off-policy shift: the training traces no longer match the model’s own search distribution when the answer is unknown. After fine-tuning, the student inherits this habit in its own generations. A simple filter that removes chains with early answer statements partially repairs performance, which supports the claim that rationalized chains carry much of the harm.
summary_en.experiments:
The main experiments fine-tune Qwen3-8B with full-parameter SFT on math problems from the Nemotron-Cascade-SFT-Stage-2 split, disjoint from evaluation. Evaluation uses vLLM in thinking mode on MATH-500 with a 32,768-token budget and symbolic answer matching. The controlled comparison is built on a fixed set of 935 training problems. Under this harness, the Qwen3-8B base model scores 95.2. The answer-conditioned corpus trains a student that is 16.2 points weaker than the answer-blind corpus on MATH-500. On harder olympiad-style AIME problems, the gap grows to 27.2 points. The penalty remains under length-matched controls and training-budget sweeps, and it increases with difficulty.

The degradation also appears in code: even when every retained chain passes tests, answer-conditioned traces still hurt the student. The penalty is absent on multiple-choice knowledge and science benchmarks, where the task is mainly option selection rather than deriving an answer through a long process. Within a single answer-conditioned corpus, chains that state the answer early account for much of the damage; a three-seed difference-in-differences analysis reports a 16.9-point effect. The paper also proposes a pre-training diagnostic signature measured from a small set of unlabeled generations. Across eight models from four families, the signature ranks the leakage penalty and predicts a held-out family with a mean absolute error of 2.9 points. If a pipeline cannot avoid showing gold answers, prompting the model to derive first and state the answer only at the end recovers about two-thirds of the lost accuracy.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read closely. Start with the one-bit experiment in the introduction to understand exactly which variable is isolated. Then read the section on isolating answer leakage, especially the generation prompts, correctness filter, 935-problem training set, SFT recipe, MATH-500 harness, and token budget. The most important mechanism section is the prompt ablation that separates answer visibility from rationalization instruction. The early-answer signature and filtering experiments are the most actionable parts for data quality pipelines. The task comparison is also important: math and code show the penalty, while multiple-choice knowledge tasks do not, which narrows the risk to verifiable reasoning settings that require a derivation. Good follow-up questions are how to build a more robust rationalization detector, whether the same pathology appears in RL warmup data, and whether process verifiers can replace final-answer filtering in these pipelines.

paper.title: Harness Engineering for Self-Improvement
paper.abstract: The concept of recursive self-improvement (RSI) dates back to I. J. Good (1965), where he defined an “ultraintelligent machine” as a system that can surpass humans in all intellectual activities and design better machines to improve itself. Yudkowsky (2008) used the phrase “recursive self-improvement” for a specific

summary.core_problem: 这篇文章讨论的问题是：在模型权重之外，agent harness 如何成为自我改进系统的关键优化对象，尤其是在长时程 coding agent、auto-research 和工具使用场景中。
summary.importance: 对预训练的启发在于，它把 agent 能力拆成两层：模型本身的能力，以及模型周围的运行系统。预训练仍然决定基础能力，例如读写文件、理解代码、使用 shell、总结日志、跨步骤保持目标；但 harness 决定这些能力能否在长任务里稳定释放。这个视角会影响三类研究：agent 轨迹数据如何记录，SFT/RL 如何利用执行日志和失败案例，评测如何覆盖持久状态、后台任务和多轮自我修正。
summary.technical_approach: 文章给出的是设计模式和研究框架，不是一个新算法。核心模式有三类。第一，workflow automation：让模型在 plan、execute、observe/test、improve 的循环中工作，而不是只依赖静态 prompt。重点是让模型能分析自己的执行轨迹和失败原因，再通过 agent runtime 迭代。第二，file system as persistent memory：长任务中的代码 diff、实验日志、错误栈、论文摘要和过往轨迹不应全部塞进上下文，而应保存为文件、日志和状态记录。文件系统是简单但有效的持久记忆，因为现有 LLM 在预训练中已经学到大量 bash、代码仓库和文本文件操作模式。第三，sub-agent and backend jobs：主 agent 可以并行启动子 agent 或后台任务，用进程管理方式查看日志、取消失败任务、合并结果。文章还讨论了 harness 优化路径：从 prompt，到结构化上下文，到 workflow，到 harness code，再到 optimizer code。ACE 这类 context engineering 方法被用作例子：通过 generator、reflector、curator 维护一个可演化的 context playbook，而不是不断拉长 prompt。
summary.experiments: 没有新的实验结果或定量消融。证据主要来自对 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Cursor-style agents、Karpathy autoresearch repo 以及 Agentic Context Engineering 等工作的归纳。文章的可用信息不是性能数字，而是工程约束：长上下文不能替代持久状态；并行子任务如果只留在聊天上下文中会变得不可检查；失败日志和中间产物需要成为 agent 可读取、可恢复、可复盘的外部状态。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20 到 30 分钟。优先看 harness 定义，以及三个 design patterns：workflow automation、file system as persistent memory、sub-agent and backend jobs。coding agent harness case study 可以帮助理解为什么 IDE、shell、文件系统和测试循环比复杂 prompt 更重要。若关心预训练与后训练接口，重点看 context engineering 和 self-improving harness evolution 部分，思考这些运行轨迹如何转化为训练数据、reward 信号和 eval protocol。
summary.authors_note: Lilian Weng；OpenAI 研究员，长期写作方向包括 agent、RL、alignment、LLM 系统与自我改进。

summary_en.core_problem: The post asks how the agent harness, rather than model weights alone, becomes an optimization target for self-improving systems, especially in long-horizon coding agents, auto-research, and tool-use workflows.
summary_en.importance: The pretraining relevance comes from separating agent capability into two layers: the base model and the runtime system around it. Pretraining still determines core skills such as file editing, shell use, code understanding, log summarization, and goal maintenance across steps. The harness determines whether those skills remain usable over long tasks. This framing affects how agent trajectories should be recorded, how SFT or RL can use execution logs and failures, and how evaluations should test persistent state, background jobs, and iterative self-correction.
summary_en.technical_approach: The post is a design taxonomy rather than a new algorithm. It highlights three main patterns. First, workflow automation places the model in a plan, execute, observe/test, and improve loop, instead of relying on a static prompt. The important part is that the model can inspect its own trajectory and failures through an agent runtime. Second, file system as persistent memory argues that code diffs, experiment logs, stack traces, paper notes, and past rollouts should not all be carried in context. They should live as durable files, logs, and status records. This choice is practical because current LLMs already have strong priors for bash commands, repositories, and text-file workflows from pretraining. Third, sub-agents and backend jobs let a parent agent launch parallel attempts, monitor logs, cancel failed runs, and merge results back into the main thread. The post also sketches a progression of harness optimization targets: prompts, structured context, workflows, harness code, and eventually optimizer code. Agentic Context Engineering is used as an example of treating context as an evolving playbook maintained by generator, reflector, and curator components, rather than as an ever-growing prompt.
summary_en.experiments: No new quantitative experiments or ablations are presented. The evidence is qualitative, drawing on systems such as Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor-style agents, Karpathy's autoresearch repo, and Agentic Context Engineering. The useful observations are engineering constraints: long context does not remove the need for durable state; parallel subtask outputs become hard to inspect if they exist only in chat history; failure logs and intermediate artifacts need to be readable, recoverable external state.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is enough; budget about 20 to 30 minutes. Focus on the definition of a harness and the three design patterns: workflow automation, file-system memory, and sub-agent or backend-job management. The coding-agent case study is useful for seeing why IDE access, shell commands, files, and tests often matter more than prompt complexity. For pretraining and post-training researchers, the most relevant parts are context engineering and self-improving harness evolution, especially how these runtime traces could become training data, reward signals, or evaluation protocols.
summary_en.authors_note: Lilian Weng; OpenAI researcher, known for technical writing on agents, reinforcement learning, alignment, LLM systems, and self-improvement.

paper.title: MultiSynt/MT: Trillion-Token Multi-Parallel Pre-Training Data Translated Across 36 Languages
paper.abstract: Open web-scale pre-training corpora remain concentrated in English, limiting multilingual LLM development. We introduce MultiSynt/MT, an open synthetic parallel corpus with approximately 4.8 trillion target-language tokens across 36 European languages, produced by translating 100 billion high-quality Nemotron-CC tokens with Tower+ and OPUS-MT/HPLT-MT systems. For many medium- and lower-resource European languages, this is the largest openly available pre-training resource. On a broad multilingua

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是开放多语预训练里一个很现实的瓶颈：英语之外，尤其是中低资源欧洲语言，公开可用的高质量预训练语料既不够大，也不够干净，导致多语 LLM 的训练长期受限。作者选择的路径不是继续做原生网页抓取，而是把高质量英语网页语料系统性翻译成 36 种语言，构造一个可公开发布、规模达到 4.8T 目标语言 token 的 synthetic parallel pretraining corpus。论文真正要回答的不是“能不能翻译出很大数据”，而是更难的问题：翻译语料在预训练里到底能替代多少 native data，在哪些能力上有效，在哪些能力上会留下 translationese 和文化锚定的缺口，以及现有 benchmark 是否能看出这些差异。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值主要有三层。第一，它把“用机器翻译扩展多语预训练数据”从小规模尝试推进到 trillion-token 级别，并且是开放发布，这对资源稀缺语言的基座训练很实际。第二，它给出了一个比较扎实的数据效率结论：在标准多语 base-model benchmark 上，基于翻译语料训练的参考模型可以用大约少 72% 的预训练 token 追平 native-data baseline，且在同样 100B token 预算下相对提升约 15%。这说明高质量翻译数据不是简单的次优替代品，在很多任务上它反而是更高密度的训练信号。第三，论文没有把 translated data 讲成万能解，而是明确指出评测盲点和能力边界：标准多选 benchmark 对翻译质量差异不敏感，文化知识和习语类任务上 native data 仍然持续占优。这种“哪里能替代，哪里不能”对数据配比、continual pretrain、以及多语 curriculum 设计都很有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上有几个关键决策。数据源不是任意英文网页，而是 Nemotron-CC 的 actual high-quality split。作者引用已有基线工作说明，这个英语 HQ 子集在开放语料里有较强下游表现，因此先把源语质量抬高，避免把翻译系统的误差和源数据噪声混在一起。具体做法是从中均匀随机抽取约 1.55 亿文档，约 100B 英文 token，不再额外做主题或长度分层；这样每种目标语言都对应同一批源文档，天然形成多路平行语料。翻译系统选择上，作者没有押注单一模型家族，而是按覆盖率、质量和吞吐三者折中：高资源语言用 Tower+ 9B/72B，低资源补足靠 OPUS-MT/HPLT-MT。为了避免“拿能跑的就上”，他们先做了一个小规模人工 fluency ranking，覆盖 7 种语言、6 个候选系统、同源文档盲评，结果 Tower+ 明显最好，通用 instruction LLM 明显落后，因此生产池里去掉了后者。这个选择很重要，因为论文后面一个核心结论就是：翻译系统质量差异会真实传导到预训练效果，但常规 benchmark 未必测得出来。数据组织上，作者保留了 source-document 对齐和部分语言的多系统 row-aligned 版本，这让语料不仅能做单语预训练，也能做受控的 cross-system/cross-language 对比。论文的实验设计也比较干净：用参考 LLM 在 translated corpus 和 native baseline 上做 matched-budget 训练，分别看 token efficiency、MT system choice、benchmark blind spots，以及挪威语上的文化/习语/常识分解。
summary.experiments: 最关键的结果有四组。第一组是规模与覆盖。MultiSynt/MT 覆盖 36 种语言，总计约 4.8T 目标语言 token；对许多低中资源欧洲语言，它比公开 native 资源 HPLT 3.0 大一个数量级以上。第二组是预训练效率。在标准多语 base-model benchmark 上，参考模型用 MultiSynt/MT 训练，只需约少 72% 的 token 就能达到 HPLT 2.0 native baseline 的最终分数；在相同 100B token 预算下，translated-data 模型相对提升约 15%。这说明翻译语料的单位 token 信息密度很高。第三组是评测盲点。作者用 fluency-sensitive 的 LLM-as-judge 评估，能够稳定恢复 MT 系统质量排序；但标准 multiple-choice benchmark 基本分不出这些差异。再配合 embedding-space nearest-neighbor 诊断，发现 benchmark 题目附近往往有更多 MultiSynt/MT 文档而不是 HPLT 文档，说明 benchmark 分布更贴近翻译语料，因而高估了 translated pretraining 的泛化。第四组是能力边界。以挪威语为例，在习语和文化锚定知识任务上，native-data 模型在整个训练过程中都更强；但在 commonsense reasoning 上，translated-data 模型会逐渐追平并反超。这一点很重要，因为它把“translationese 有害”从泛泛而谈变成了可分解的现象：不是所有能力都受损，受损最明显的是文化局部性和本地表达习惯。摘要里还提到 Tower+ 72B 与 9B 在 5 语重叠上的下游差距不大，因此 9B 被作为默认生产系统，这对大规模数据构建的成本收益判断也很关键。
summary.reading_guide: 精读时建议按“数据构建—训练结果—评测反思”三段来读。先看 Section 3，重点不是流水账式的数据制作，而是三个选择：为什么源语料选 Nemotron-CC HQ，为什么翻译系统最终是 Tower+ 与 OPUS/HPLT-MT 的组合，以及如何保留 parallel alignment 以支持后续受控实验。然后看 Section 4，这是预训练研究者最该细看的部分，尤其是 token efficiency 的比较设置：训练预算是否匹配、baseline 是否公平、不同 MT 系统之间的差距有多大。再看 Section 5，这一节决定你如何解读前面的好结果。5.1 的 LLM-as-judge 与标准 benchmark 对照，5.2 的 embedding-space 诊断，5.3 的挪威语文化/习语/常识拆分，都在提醒读者不要把 benchmark 提升直接等同于“翻译语料已经替代 native 语料”。如果时间有限，优先看 Figure 1、Figure 3、Figure 6 以及 Section 4 和 5 的主表。值得深挖的点有两个：一是 translated data 与 native data 的最优 mixture 可能比二选一更重要，论文已经给出边界条件；二是 benchmark contamination 之外，还存在 benchmark distribution alignment 问题，未来多语预训练评测需要更刻意地区分 fluency、文化知识和推理能力。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a practical bottleneck in multilingual pretraining: outside English, especially for medium- and lower-resource European languages, openly available native pretraining corpora are often too small or too noisy to support strong LLM training. The authors take a synthetic-data route at unusual scale. They translate 100B high-quality English tokens into 36 languages, producing MultiSynt/MT, an open corpus with about 4.8T target-language tokens. The real question is not merely whether large translated corpora can be built, but how far translated pretraining data can substitute for native corpora, where it helps, where it fails because of translationese and English-centered cultural grounding, and whether current multilingual benchmarks can even detect those differences.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is threefold. First, it turns machine-translated multilingual pretraining from a small-scale idea into a trillion-token open resource. That is immediately useful for languages with weak native data availability. Second, it provides a concrete data-efficiency result: on standard multilingual base-model benchmarks, models trained on MultiSynt/MT can match a native-data baseline with roughly 72% fewer pretraining tokens, and at a matched 100B-token budget they improve by about 15% relative. That suggests high-quality translated text can be a denser training signal than existing open native corpora, not just a weaker fallback. Third, the paper is careful about the limits. It shows that standard benchmarks miss important differences, and that native data remains better for idiomatic and culturally grounded knowledge. That makes the work useful not only as a dataset release but also as guidance for data mixture design, continual pretraining, and multilingual curriculum choices.
summary_en.technical_approach: Several design choices matter. The source data is not arbitrary English web text but the actual high-quality split of Nemotron-CC, chosen because prior baseline work found it to be one of the strongest open English pretraining sources. This is important: by starting from a strong source corpus, the paper avoids conflating source-data noise with translation quality. The authors uniformly sample about 155 million documents, around 100B English tokens, and translate the same source set into each target language, which naturally creates a multi-way parallel corpus. On the translation side, they do not rely on a single model family. Instead they optimize over quality, throughput, and language coverage: Tower+ 9B and 72B for stronger-coverage higher-resource settings, and OPUS-MT/HPLT-MT for broader lower-resource coverage. Before production, they run a small human fluency study over seven languages and six candidate systems using blind ratings on matched source documents. Tower+ ranks highest, while general-purpose instruction LLMs lag clearly behind, so those are removed from the production pool. That decision matters because one of the paper’s later findings is that translation-system quality does affect downstream pretraining, even when standard benchmarks fail to expose it. The corpus preserves source-document alignment and, for some languages, multiple row-aligned translations from different systems. This makes the resource useful not only for per-language pretraining but also for controlled cross-system and cross-language experiments. The training setup is also fairly disciplined: reference LLMs are trained under matched budgets on translated data and native baselines, then compared on token efficiency, MT-system choice, benchmark blind spots, and phenomenon-specific Norwegian evaluations.
summary_en.experiments: Four result groups stand out. First is scale and coverage. MultiSynt/MT spans 36 languages and about 4.8T target-language tokens; for many lower- and medium-resource European languages it exceeds the largest comparable open native resource by more than an order of magnitude. Second is pretraining efficiency. On standard multilingual base-model benchmarks, models trained on MultiSynt/MT reach the final score of the HPLT 2.0 native-data baseline using about 72% fewer training tokens, and at a matched 100B-token budget they outperform it by roughly 15% relative. That is a strong indication that translated data can be highly information-dense. Third is evaluation blindness. A fluency-sensitive LLM-as-judge setup cleanly recovers the ranking of translation systems, while standard multiple-choice benchmarks largely fail to separate them. An embedding-space nearest-neighbor analysis further shows that benchmark items tend to sit closer to MultiSynt/MT documents than to HPLT documents, suggesting that benchmark distribution alignment may inflate the apparent strength of translated-data pretraining. Fourth is capability boundary analysis. On Norwegian tasks involving idioms and culturally grounded knowledge, native-data models remain better throughout training. On Norwegian commonsense reasoning, however, translated-data models close the gap and eventually overtake the native baseline. This is one of the most useful findings in the paper because it decomposes the usual criticism of translationese into something operational: translated data is not uniformly worse, but it is weaker on local cultural grounding and idiomatic expression. The overlap experiment between Tower+ 72B and 9B also matters: the downstream gap is small enough that 9B becomes the default production choice, which is relevant for cost-quality trade-offs in large-scale corpus construction.
summary_en.reading_guide: A good reading order is data construction, then training results, then evaluation critique. Start with Section 3. The important parts are not the mechanics of translation at scale but the choices: why Nemotron-CC HQ was used as the source, why the final production pool combines Tower+ with OPUS/HPLT-MT, and why preserving parallel alignment matters for later controlled analysis. Then read Section 4 carefully, since this is where the pretraining value is established. Pay attention to how token efficiency is measured, whether budgets are matched fairly, and how much downstream difference remains between translation systems. After that, read Section 5 with care, because it changes how the earlier gains should be interpreted. Section 5.1 compares LLM-as-judge with standard benchmarks, Section 5.2 gives the embedding-space diagnostic, and Section 5.3 breaks down Norwegian performance into cultural knowledge, idioms, and commonsense. Together they show that benchmark gains should not be read as proof that translated corpora fully replace native corpora. If time is limited, prioritize Figure 1, Figure 3, Figure 6, and the main tables in Sections 4 and 5. Two deeper questions are worth carrying forward: whether the best recipe is a translated-native mixture rather than either source alone, and how multilingual evaluation should separate fluency, cultural grounding, and reasoning instead of collapsing them into a single benchmark score.

recommendation.zh: 应读实验和数据配方；它会改变“翻译语料只能补尾部”的先验，尤其看 100B token matched 对比。
recommendation.en: Read the data recipe and matched-budget results; it weakens the prior that translated corpora are only a tail-language patch.

paper.title: Towards Engineering Scaling Laws with Pretraining Data Composition
paper.abstract: Neural scaling laws describe how model performance improves as a power law in compute, model size, and dataset size. While well-established for large language models, these relationships are emerging for large models in particle physics. As with language, empirical studies show that the performance scales as a power law. However, unlike natural language or image domains, fundamental physics has high-fidelity simulators that produce synthetic data cheaply. This favors scaling regimes where additi

summary.core_problem: 论文研究的是在高能物理模拟数据场景下，能否通过设计预训练数据组成来改变 scaling law 的形状和 compute-optimal 方向。具体任务是 hadronic jet 分类：固定下游任务，改变 JetClass-II 预训练子集里的物理过程组成，观察模型大小、预训练数据组成和微调性能之间的幂律关系。
summary.importance: 这不是 LLM 论文，领域任务也较窄；对基座预训练的价值在于数据组成与 scaling behavior 的关系。它把“数据更多”拆成更具体的问题：预训练数据是否覆盖更宽的生成过程，是否与下游任务的有效特征对齐。这个视角可以类比到语言模型的数据配比：不同语料不只是改变平均质量，也可能改变 scaling exponent、数据受限还是参数受限的最优区间，以及微调阶段对参数量和数据量的依赖。需要注意，论文中的数据来自可控物理模拟，和自然语言网页语料的采样约束不同，结论不能直接迁移。
summary.technical_approach: 方法使用一个处理 jet point cloud 的通用 Transformer。每个 jet 由 constituent particles 构成，每个粒子包含 4 个运动学特征、4 个轨迹位移特征和 1 个粒子 ID 特征。模型使用 learnable class token、pre-norm Transformer blocks、SwiGLU FFN，不使用位置编码，因为输入是集合而不是序列。模型深度固定为 4 层，attention head dimension 固定为 8，通过改变 embedding dimension 和 head 数得到 12 个模型规模，参数量约从 3K 到 10.5M。预训练数据来自 JetClass-II，共 188 类模拟 jet，分为 QCD、BSM two-prong resonance decay、BSM three/four-prong resonance decay 三组。论文构造四个预训练子集：QCD only、QCD+res2p、QCD+res34p、QCD+res2p+res34p。下游任务是在 JetClass 上做 10 类 jet 分类。核心设计是用 BSM resonance decay 增加预训练数据的 diversity 和 alignment：它们覆盖 QCD 不覆盖的相空间，并在 prong multiplicity、mass scale、substructure 等特征上更接近下游任务。
summary.experiments: 实验扫描 12 个模型规模和多种预训练数据组成，在 JetClass-II 上预训练后，在 JetClass 10 类分类任务上微调，并拟合性能随模型规模和数据组成变化的 scaling behavior。给定正文明确给出了模型规模范围、数据桶和预训练子集设计，但没有提供结果表格里的具体数值、拟合指数或误差下降幅度。可归纳的实验结论是：加入 BSM resonance decay 的预训练子集通过增加多样性和任务相关性，能够改变 fine-tuning scaling 的趋势，使 compute-optimal 分配更偏向使用数据，而不是单纯扩大模型。论文也承认当前实验没有分离 diversity 和 alignment 两个因素，因为 BSM-augmented 数据同时带来更宽支持集和更强下游相关性。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 15–25 分钟。LLM 研究者不需要细读物理背景，重点看 Introduction 里关于 engineering scaling laws 的问题设定，以及 Methods 里四个预训练子集如何定义 diversity 和 alignment。实验部分优先看 scaling fits、不同数据组成的性能曲线、compute-optimal 讨论。如果关心数据配比研究，可以重点关注作者如何把“数据组成”转化为可控变量；如果只关心通用 LLM 预训练，这篇可以作为方法类旁证，不需要深读物理任务细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether scaling behavior can be engineered by changing the composition of pretraining data. The study is set in hadronic jet classification, where high-fidelity simulators make it cheap to generate controlled pretraining corpora. The concrete question is how different JetClass-II pretraining mixtures affect the scaling relation between model size, data composition, and downstream fine-tuning performance on JetClass.
summary_en.importance: This is a physics-domain study rather than an LLM pretraining paper, so its direct relevance is limited. The useful idea is that data composition can change not only the intercept of a scaling curve but also the regime in which more data or more parameters are preferred. For LLM pretraining, the analogue would be mixtures whose diversity and task alignment affect scaling exponents, downstream transfer, and compute-optimal allocation. The caveat is important: particle physics has controllable synthetic data generation, while language pretraining usually depends on messy, naturally occurring corpora.
summary_en.technical_approach: The model is a Transformer over jet point clouds. Each jet is represented as a set of constituent particles, with kinematic features, trajectory displacement features, and particle identification features. The architecture uses a learnable class token, pre-norm Transformer blocks, SwiGLU feed-forward layers, and no positional encodings because the input is a set. Depth is fixed at four layers and the attention head dimension is fixed at eight; embedding width and number of heads are varied to obtain 12 model sizes from roughly 3K to 10.5M parameters. Pretraining uses JetClass-II, which contains 188 simulated jet classes grouped into QCD, two-prong BSM resonance decays, and three/four-prong BSM resonance decays. Four pretraining subsets are compared: QCD only, QCD plus res2p, QCD plus res34p, and the union of all three groups. The downstream task is 10-class jet classification on JetClass. The main design choice is to use BSM resonance decays as a controlled way to increase both distributional diversity and alignment with downstream substructure features.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments sweep model size and pretraining composition, then fine-tune on the JetClass classification task and analyze scaling trends. The available text gives the parameter range, architecture, data buckets, and mixture definitions, but not the exact fitted exponents or numerical performance gains. The reported qualitative result is that BSM-augmented pretraining mixtures alter the scaling behavior and move the preferred allocation toward data-rich regimes. The study also notes a limitation: diversity and alignment are not disentangled, because the BSM additions simultaneously broaden the pretraining support and improve feature overlap with the downstream task.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 15–25 minutes. For LLM pretraining readers, the useful parts are the introduction’s framing of engineered scaling laws and the methods section defining the four controlled data mixtures. In the results, focus on the scaling fits, mixture comparisons, and compute-allocation discussion. The particle-physics details can be read lightly unless you need to evaluate whether the claimed diversity and alignment variables are well controlled.

recommendation.zh: 数据组成可改变scaling幂律斜率的结论对LLM数据配比设计有直接参考，重点看数据组成调控scaling的实验部分。
recommendation.en: The finding that data composition shifts scaling law exponents is directly relevant to LLM data mixture design; focus on the data-modulated scaling experiments.
