summary.core_problem: 现有代码Agent基准要么直接回放历史GitHub PR，存在和预训练/微调/合成数据管线的污染风险，要么使用完全合成的任务，脱离真实仓库的实际开发优先级与约束，缺少同时保证任务真实性、无信息泄漏、符合仓库真实演进方向的代码任务构造方法。
summary.importance: 该工作解决了代码类训练数据与评测基准的污染难题，其时间隔离、预测驱动的合成思路对构造无泄漏的代码SFT/RL训练数据、干净的代码Agent评测集有直接实用价值，任务族预测的逻辑也可迁移到其他快速演进领域的训练/评测数据构造。
summary.technical_approach: 提出预测条件式数据合成框架SWE-Future，设置三个严格的时间节点实现信息隔离：1）预测快照T0：仅使用T0之前的仓库证据（issue、PR、标签、代码文本）预测未来的任务族，覆盖功能新增/增强、bug修复、重构三类开发活动，不预测具体的未来PR；2）回溯验证窗口(T0, T1]：冻结预测结果后，仅使用T0到T1之间的PR元数据验证预测的任务族是否匹配真实未来开发方向，丢弃未通过验证的任务族；3）任务生成快照Tgen：以验证通过的任务族为条件，基于Tgen时刻的仓库状态合成具体编码任务，再经过目标测试构造、泄漏检查、FAIL_TO_PASS/PASS_TO_PASS校验过滤不合格任务。
summary.experiments: 在80个Python生态仓库上开展回溯验证，任务族预测的未来工作相关性在主语义匹配指标下达到58.1%；最终构造了覆盖61个仓库、包含200个可执行验证任务的代码Agent数据集，所有任务严格遵守信息边界，不存在历史PR回放带来的数据污染问题。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注方法部分的时间边界设计（图2）、选择任务族而非具体PR作为预测单元的设计逻辑、最终的任务校验过滤流程，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing coding agent benchmarks either replay historical GitHub pull requests, which carries non-trivial data contamination risk for pretraining, fine-tuning, and synthetic data pipelines, or use fully synthetic tasks that drift away from real development priorities and constraints of production repositories. No prior approach balances task realism, strict leakage prevention, and alignment with actual repository evolution trajectories.
summary_en.importance: This work addresses the growing contamination problem in coding post-training datasets and evaluation benchmarks. Its time-isolated, forecast-driven synthesis design provides a practical template for building uncontaminated SFT/RL training data and clean coding agent test sets, and the task family prediction logic can generalize to data construction for other fast-evolving domains.
summary_en.technical_approach: SWE-Future implements a forecast-conditioned synthesis pipeline with three strict temporal cutoffs to enforce information boundaries: 1) Forecast snapshot T0: Only pre-T0 repository evidence (issues, PRs, labels, codebase text) is used to predict future task families covering feature additions/enhancements, bug fixes, and refactoring work, without forecasting exact future PRs. 2) Retrospective validation window (T0, T1]: Predictions are frozen, and post-T0 PR metadata is only used to check whether predicted families match actual future development activity, with unvalidated families discarded. 3) Task generation snapshot Tgen: Validated task families are used as conditioning signals to generate concrete coding tasks from the Tgen repository state, followed by a filtering pipeline including target test construction, leakage checks, and FAIL_TO_PASS/PASS_TO_PASS validation.
summary_en.experiments: Retrospective evaluation across 80 Python ecosystem repositories shows the forecaster achieves 58.1% future work relevance under the primary semantic matching metric. The final released dataset contains 200 executable coding tasks across 61 repositories, all constructed with strict information controls to eliminate contamination from historical PR replay.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim recommended. Focus on the temporal boundary design (Figure 2), the rationale for using task families instead of exact PRs as the forecast unit, and the final task validation pipeline. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和污染控制 setup；58.1% 相关性不高，但时间截断评测协议比又一批 GitHub replay 更干净。
recommendation.en: Read the method and contamination-control setup; 58.1% relevance is modest, but the temporal-cutoff protocol is cleaner than another GitHub replay benchmark.

paper.abstract: Self-supervised learning advances audio representation for multimedia analysis. However, prevailing data-centric approaches rely on massive real-world corpora, increasing training costs, curation burdens, and privacy barriers. To address this, we present AudioPG, a procedural synthesis framework eliminating real audio recordings during pre-training. AudioPG trains a Transformer-based masked autoencoder on waveforms generated on-the-fly from basic acoustic primitives and composition rules. The en

summary.core_problem: 现有音频自监督预训练依赖大规模真实语料，存在训练成本高、数据治理负担重、隐私合规风险等痛点
summary.importance: 方法创新+数据贡献，提出完全基于程序合成音频的预训练范式，无需真实录音即可高效获得可迁移且可解释的音频表征
summary.technical_approach: 提出AudioPG框架：从基础声学基元（基频、相对强度等）与组合规则实时生成合成波形，训练Transformer架构的掩码自编码器完成预训练，全程不使用真实音频数据
summary.experiments: 单GPU预训练耗时不足20分钟；在ESC-50（90.60%准确率）、FSD50K（0.546 mAP）、UrbanSound8K（88.17%准确率）、Speech Commands V2（97.03%准确率）4个真实音频基准上取得有竞争力的结果；潜空间分析显示基频、强度等物理因子呈正交分布，可线性解码

summary_en.core_problem: Existing audio self-supervised pretraining relies on large-scale real-world corpora, leading to high training costs, heavy curation burdens, and privacy compliance risks
summary_en.importance: Methodological and data contribution: proposes a pretraining paradigm fully based on procedurally synthesized audio, obtaining transferable and interpretable audio representations efficiently without any real recordings
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the AudioPG framework: generates synthetic waveforms on-the-fly from basic acoustic primitives (fundamental frequency, relative intensity, etc.) and composition rules, trains a Transformer-based masked autoencoder for pretraining without using any real audio data
summary_en.experiments: Pretraining completes in under 20 minutes on a single GPU; achieves competitive results on 4 real audio benchmarks: ESC-50 (90.60% accuracy), FSD50K (0.546 mAP), UrbanSound8K (88.17% accuracy), Speech Commands V2 (97.03% accuracy); latent space analysis shows physical factors like fundamental frequency and intensity are orthogonally distributed and linearly decodable

recommendation.zh: 音频领域的纯合成数据预训练思路，对低隐私/低资源场景的预训练语料构造有弱启发，仅看摘要和潜空间分析部分即可
recommendation.en: Pure synthetic pretraining idea in audio domain, provides weak inspiration for low-privacy/low-resource pretraining corpus construction, read only the abstract and latent space analysis section

paper.title: CodeAlchemy: Synthetic Code Rewriting at Scale
paper.abstract: Pre-training on raw code teaches syntax but provides sparse signal for diverse real-world task formats. While synthetic data has proven transformative for language models, code remains largely unexplored beyond limited quality improvements. We present CodeAlchemy, a synthetic data generation framework that transforms publicly sourced code into semantically-rich training data through 5 strategies: CodeEnhance (quality-aware rewriting), CodeQA (template-based problems), CodeDev (developer tasks),

summary.core_problem: 代码预训练长期依赖原始仓库语料，能学到语法和局部模式，但对真实开发任务中的问答、重写、调试、执行跟踪等监督信号覆盖很弱，导致模型对“会写代码”之外的开发能力学习不足。
summary.importance: 这是一个以预训练数据为核心的工作，贡献不在新模型，而在大规模合成代码语料构造。它把公开代码转成多种语义更密集的训练格式，并把执行轨迹也纳入语料，属于代码领域较少见的“数据形态扩展”路线；对通用 LLM 研究员的价值在于：它提供了一个较完整的 synthetic pretraining recipe，说明代码数据不必只以 next-token 形式存在。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CodeAlchemy 框架，用 5 类策略把原始代码转成合成训练数据：CodeEnhance 做质量感知重写，CodeQA 生成模板化问题，CodeDev 构造开发者任务，CodeDialogue 生成多轮对话，CodeTrace 通过插桩和执行收集控制流、状态变化和库调用知识。数据覆盖 3 个语料源、15 种语言，总计 500B+ 合成 token，外加 350B reasoning token。方法上更像“程序化数据工厂”而不是单一生成器，重点是把静态代码转成多视角监督信号。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出的实验规模较大：执行了 1.3M+ 文件，覆盖 14 种语言和 5K 库；并引入 DevEval 与 TraceEval 两个评测，分别测开发者任务和执行预测。摘要提到 frontier 模型在新 benchmark 上仍有明显不足，暗示这些数据形态确实触及现有代码模型的薄弱区。由于摘要截断，具体基线、模型尺寸和提升幅度未完全给出，但从定位看，重点应是验证不同合成数据子集对代码能力的增益，而不是追求单一榜单分数。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 MIT-IBM Watson AI Lab 与 IBM Research。Rameswar Panda 长期活跃于 IBM 的多模态与高效学习方向；这篇工作代表的是工业研究团队在“合成数据扩展代码预训练”上的系统化尝试。

summary_en.core_problem: Code pretraining still relies heavily on raw repositories, which teach syntax and local patterns but provide sparse supervision for real developer-facing formats such as QA, rewriting, debugging, and execution tracing.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a pretraining-data paper rather than a modeling paper. Its contribution is a large-scale synthetic code data pipeline that converts public code into semantically denser training views, including execution traces. For foundation-model researchers, the useful signal is that code corpora need not stay in plain next-token form.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces CodeAlchemy, a synthetic data generation framework with five transformation strategies: CodeEnhance for quality-aware rewriting, CodeQA for templated problems, CodeDev for developer tasks, CodeDialogue for multi-turn conversations, and CodeTrace for instrumented execution traces capturing control flow, state changes, and library knowledge. It processes three corpora across 15 languages, producing 500B+ synthetic tokens plus 350B reasoning tokens.
summary_en.experiments: The reported scale is substantial: 1.3M+ files executed across 14 languages and 5K libraries. The paper also introduces DevEval and TraceEval to test developer tasks and execution prediction. The abstract suggests that even frontier models remain weak on these benchmarks, implying that the generated data targets real blind spots. The exact model sizes, baselines, and gains are not fully visible from the truncated abstract, but the experimental focus appears to be capability gains from richer synthetic pretraining views rather than leaderboard chasing.
summary_en.authors_note: The work comes from MIT-IBM Watson AI Lab and IBM Research. Rameswar Panda is known for work in multimodal and efficient learning; this paper reflects a systematic industrial effort on synthetic data for code pretraining.

recommendation.zh: 这篇该当作“代码版数据炼丹术”来看：先看数据工厂设计和 Trace 部分，若你在做合成预训练数据，值得立刻对照内部 pipeline 补一轮多视角 ablation。
recommendation.en: Read this as a code-data factory paper, not a model paper: focus on the data transformations and the trace pipeline, then compare against your own synthetic pretraining stack with a clean ablation.

institutions: MIT-IBM Watson AI Lab, IBM Research

paper.title: Mix, Don't Pick: Why Synthetic Corpus Composition Matters for Time Series Foundation Model Pretraining
paper.abstract: Choosing the wrong synthetic generator for time-series foundation model pretraining is costly: under identical training budgets, the best and worst generators produce up to a $2\times$ gap in forecasting error, yet the field has no principled way to make this choice. The problem is compounded by the fact that generator rankings are not stable across architectures: across 11 generator families evaluated on Chronos-T5-Mini and Moirai-Small trained from scratch, we find that which generators are us

summary.core_problem: 时间序列基础模型预训练中合成数据生成器的选择缺乏原则性方法，且生成器排名在不同架构间不稳定
summary.importance: 数据贡献类，提出合成预训练是语料组合问题而非生成器选择问题；在相同训练预算下最优与最差生成器可产生高达2倍的预测误差差距
summary.technical_approach: 不解决生成器选择问题而是绕过它：简单等权重混合所有11个生成器家族，在Chronos-T5-Mini和Moirai-Small上均匹配或超越最优单一生成器；再与真实数据组合得到整体最强预训练语料
summary.experiments: 在Chronos-T5-Mini和Moirai-Small上从零训练，评估11个生成器家族；最优与最差生成器间预测误差差距高达2倍；等权重混合+真实数据组合效果最佳
summary.authors_note: Aaryan Nagpal, Debdeep Sanyal, Murari Mandal, Dhruv Kumar, Saurabh Deshpande（机构未明确）

summary_en.core_problem: No principled method exists for selecting synthetic data generators for time-series foundation model pretraining, and generator rankings are unstable across architectures
summary_en.importance: Data contribution; frames synthetic pretraining as a corpus composition problem rather than a generator selection problem; up to 2× gap in forecasting error between best and worst generators under identical training budget
summary_en.technical_approach: Sidesteps generator selection: a simple equal-weight mixture of all 11 generator families matches or beats the best individual generator on both Chronos-T5-Mini and Moirai-Small; composing this mixture with real data yields the strongest pretraining corpora
summary_en.experiments: Trained from scratch on Chronos-T5-Mini and Moirai-Small, evaluated 11 generator families; up to 2× forecasting error gap between best and worst generators; equal-weight mixture + real data composition achieves best overall results
summary_en.authors_note: Aaryan Nagpal, Debdeep Sanyal, Murari Mandal, Dhruv Kumar, Saurabh Deshpande (institutions not explicitly stated)

recommendation.zh: 时间序列领域的预训练数据策略研究，核心发现——等权重混合优于最优单一选择——与LLM数据mixture研究有类比，但领域差异大，仅作弱启发参考。
recommendation.en: Pretraining data strategy study in time-series domain; core finding — equal-weight mixture outperforms best single generator — has analogies to LLM data mixture research but domain differences limit transfer; weak heuristic reference only.

stage_evidence.quote: ix, Don't Pick: Why Synthetic Corpus Composition Matters for Time Series Foundation Model Pretraining

paper.title: Epidemiology of Model Collapse: Modeling Synthetic Data Contamination via Bilayer SIR Dynamics
paper.abstract: Training on synthetic data causes model collapse, but existing analyses treat this as single-chain degradation. In reality, the AI ecosystem involves cross-contamination: models ingest synthetic data from other models, produce new synthetic text, and contaminate shared corpora. We propose a bilayer coupled SIR/SIRS framework -- a phenomenological mean-field model treating data corpora and AI models as two interacting populations, each with susceptible, infected, and recovered compartments linked

summary.core_problem: 研究合成数据污染如何在开放模型生态中跨语料库和模型传播，并导致模型坍塌风险累积。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制建模和风险分析。它把模型坍塌从单模型递归退化问题扩展为生态系统级交叉污染问题，对预训练数据治理、合成数据过滤和持续预训练有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出双层耦合 SIR/SIRS 平均场模型，把数据语料和 AI 模型分别视为易感、感染、恢复群体，并用跨层传播项连接二者。主要推荐 SIRS 版本，因为过滤后的语料和重新训练后的模型仍可能再次暴露于合成数据污染。文中用 Next Generation Matrix 推导基本再生数 R0 = sqrt(β_D β_M / [(γ_D+μ_D)(γ_M+μ_M)])，并用流行病阈值判断污染是否进入超临界传播。
summary.experiments: 实验更接近情景校准而非训练实验。作者基于公开 AI 文本占比数据做示例性校准，并报告若干场景下 R0 大于 1，说明污染可能自我维持和扩散。没有给出真实大模型预训练中的可控消融，也没有验证具体过滤策略对下游模型质量的影响。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how synthetic-data contamination can spread across shared corpora and model populations, creating ecosystem-level model-collapse risk.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a mechanistic risk model rather than a training method. It reframes model collapse from a single recursive training chain into a coupled contamination process, which is relevant to pretraining data governance, synthetic-data filtering, and continual pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The author proposes a bilayer coupled SIR/SIRS mean-field model, with data corpora and AI models represented as interacting susceptible, infected, and recovered populations. The SIRS variant is preferred because filtered corpora and retrained models can lose protection and become contaminated again. The paper derives the reproduction number R0 = sqrt(β_D β_M / [(γ_D+μ_D)(γ_M+μ_M)]) using the Next Generation Matrix and applies epidemic threshold reasoning to the coupled system.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical component is scenario calibration, not large-scale model training. The paper uses public estimates of AI-generated text prevalence to illustrate supercritical regimes where R0 exceeds 1. It does not provide controlled pretraining ablations or direct measurements of filtering policies on model quality.

recommendation.zh: 可扫公式和假设；它提醒数据污染是生态反馈问题，但缺少真实训练闭环验证，别把 R0 当工程阈值用。
recommendation.en: Skim the equations and assumptions; it frames contamination as ecosystem feedback, but R0 is not yet an engineering threshold without training-loop validation.

paper.title: In-Context Multiple Instance Learning
paper.abstract: Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) addresses problems where supervision is available at the level of bags of instances and has been successfully applied in fields ranging from computational pathology to satellite imagery. Nevertheless, existing algorithms struggle in the low-label regime that characterizes many real-world applications. Flexible models overfit and rigid ones fail to adapt to the task at hand. We show that pretraining an in-context learner with a Perceiver-style architecture on synt

summary.core_problem: 解决多实例学习（MIL）在低标签数据场景下容易过拟合或无法适应新任务的问题。
summary.importance: 首次将上下文学习（In-Context Learning）引入多实例学习，通过在合成数据上预训练 Perceiver 架构，实现了在推理时无需梯度更新的 few-shot MIL 分类。
summary.technical_approach: 使用 Perceiver 风格的架构作为上下文学习器，在多种合成的包结构数据生成器上进行预训练。推理时，模型通过单次前向传播处理包含少量标记包的上下文，直接对新包进行分类。
summary.experiments: 在 12 个 MIL 基准测试中，预训练模型在 few-shot 设置下取得了最佳平均性能，优于现有的 MIL 算法。
summary.authors_note: 柏林工业大学和 BIFOLD 团队工作，Klaus-Robert Müller 为知名机器学习学者。

summary_en.core_problem: Addressing the issue of Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) algorithms overfitting or failing to adapt to new tasks in low-label data regimes.
summary_en.importance: Introduces In-Context Learning to Multiple Instance Learning for the first time, achieving few-shot MIL classification without gradient updates at inference by pretraining a Perceiver architecture on synthetic data.
summary_en.technical_approach: Uses a Perceiver-style architecture as an in-context learner, pretrained on various synthetic bag-structured data generators. At inference, the model processes a context of a few labeled bags in a single forward pass to classify new bags.
summary_en.experiments: Achieved the best average performance across 12 MIL benchmarks in a few-shot setting, outperforming existing MIL algorithms.
summary_en.authors_note: Work from TU Berlin and BIFOLD, Klaus-Robert Müller is a renowned machine learning scholar.

recommendation.zh: 将 ICL 范式迁移到多实例学习（MIL）任务，证明了在合成数据上预训练可以泛化到真实 MIL 任务，作为 ICL 泛化能力的侧面印证可扫一眼。
recommendation.en: Transfers the ICL paradigm to Multiple Instance Learning (MIL), proving that pretraining on synthetic data generalizes to real MIL tasks; worth a glance as a side validation of ICL's generalization capability.

paper.title: CoEval: Ranking Language Models for Custom Tasks Without Labeled Data or Trustworthy Benchmarks
paper.abstract: Choosing or ranking language models for a specific application is hardest when no task-specific labeled data exists, and standard public benchmarks cannot be trusted, their items having likely leaked into pretraining, so scores reflect memorization rather than fitness. summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是无标注数据、公共 benchmark 又可能被污染时，如何为某个自定义任务选择和排序语言模型。
summary.importance: 这是一篇评测基础设施工作，对基座研究的直接价值在于动态评测和污染规避。它不改进预训练算法，但针对当前模型选择中的一个真实痛点：静态公开题集容易进入预训练语料，分数可能反映记忆而不是泛化。CoEval 的思路是每次按任务描述重新生成评测集，并用跨模型家族 judge ensemble 评分。这个框架对内部模型迭代、continual pretrain 后的能力回归测试、以及面向特定数据分布的模型选择都有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: CoEval 包含两步。第一步，teacher model 根据任务或领域描述生成 attribute-stratified benchmark，也就是按用户声明的能力、难度、子领域等属性控制题目分布。由于题目每次运行时新生成，目标是降低静态 benchmark 泄漏到训练语料中的风险。第二步，candidate models 在这些题目上作答，再由来自不同模型厂商或模型家族的 judge ensemble 评分。论文强调 judge panel 的关键不是数量，而是组成：跨家族、多来源的 judge 更能降低同源偏好；如果盲目加入低一致性的 judge，可靠性反而下降。聚合时利用不同 judge 对长答案偏好的方向差异抵消 verbosity bias，并通过 vendor-disjoint 设计减少 self-preference。
summary.experiments: 论文报告了一个四任务中等规模实验，产生 7,978 条有效评测，总成本为 5.89 美元。在有 ground truth 的设置中，CoEval 能恢复真实模型排序，并且 label-free judging 与 ground-truth correctness 的相关性达到 rho=0.86。实验还分析了 judge ensemble 的组成与可靠性的关系，结论是 vendor diversity 比单纯增加 panel size 更重要；加入低一致性 judge 会降低整体可靠性。论文还给出 rubric generalization、污染抵抗、成本，以及三个自定义垂直场景的端到端案例。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–35 分钟。优先看框架定义部分，理解 declarative task specification 如何变成可执行 benchmark；再看 Section 5.1 和 Table 3，确认它在有 ground truth 场景下能否恢复正确排序；随后看 judge ensemble 的消融，尤其是 composition-over-size 的结果。对预训练研究员来说，最值得借鉴的是“动态生成评测分布 + 跨家族 judge 聚合”的工程设计，而不是某个具体任务上的排名。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses model selection for a custom task when there is no labeled task-specific data and public benchmarks may be contaminated by pretraining exposure.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an evaluation-infrastructure paper. Its relevance to foundation-model research comes from dynamic evaluation and contamination control, rather than from a new training method. Static public benchmarks are increasingly weak signals for model choice because items can leak into pretraining corpora. CoEval proposes a renewable evaluation pipeline: generate a fresh task-specific benchmark from a task description and rank candidate models with a cross-family judge ensemble. This is useful for internal model iteration, continual-pretraining regression tests, and deployment-oriented model selection under a target distribution.
summary_en.technical_approach: CoEval has two main components. First, a teacher model synthesizes an attribute-stratified benchmark from a domain or task specification, controlling dimensions such as capability, difficulty, and subdomain coverage. Since items are generated anew for each run, the benchmark is designed to reduce exposure to student-model training data. Second, candidate model responses are scored by a judge ensemble drawn from different model vendors or families. The paper’s central methodological point is that judge composition matters more than judge count. A diverse panel can reduce same-family self-preference, while adding low-agreement judges can make reliability worse. The aggregation scheme also aims to cancel verbosity bias because individual judges may have biases with different signs.
summary_en.experiments: The reported medium-scale study covers four tasks and produces 7,978 valid evaluations at an end-to-end cost of USD 5.89. In settings where ground truth exists, CoEval recovers the correct model ranking and its label-free judging correlates with ground-truth correctness at rho = 0.86. The experiments also examine judge-panel reliability and find that vendor diversity is a stronger lever than simply increasing the number of judges. Additional analyses cover rubric generalization, contamination resistance, cost, and three end-to-end custom-domain case studies.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Read the framework section to understand how a declarative task specification is turned into a generated benchmark. Then check Section 5.1 and Table 3 for validation against ground-truth rankings. The most useful part is the judge-ensemble analysis, especially the composition-over-size finding. For pretraining researchers, the transferable idea is the evaluation design: dynamically generated target distributions combined with cross-family judging, not the ranking outcome for any single task.

recommendation.zh: 做模型选型和内部 eval 的人可以看；新意在 judge panel 设计而不在生成 benchmark，本身不改 pretrain prior，但可直接影响你怎么搭无标注评测流水线。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you build internal eval stacks; the useful bit is judge-panel composition rather than benchmark synthesis, and it won’t change pretraining priors but may change how you run label-free model ranking.

paper.title: Not All Synthetic Data Is Yours to Learn From
paper.abstract: Can a language model improve from plain text sampled from itself, with no prompts, no teacher, no verifier, and no reward model? Yes, but only when the synthetic corpus is compatible with the student, a relational property of the source-student pair rather than an intrinsic property of the data. We call this the latent capability resurfacing hypothesis: weak self-training can amplify capabilities already present in the pretrained model, but only under this compatibility condition. We study this

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的不是“合成数据能不能用”这个泛问题，而是一个更尖锐的问题：在没有 prompt、没有 teacher、没有 verifier、没有 reward model 的极弱设定下，模型能否仅靠自己从 BOS 无条件采样出来的纯文本继续训练，并得到稳定收益。作者把问题进一步收紧为一个关系性判断：决定收益的关键，不是某份 synthetic corpus 自身“质量高不高”，而是 source model 与 student model 是否兼容。全文围绕一个具体假设展开：预训练已经把一部分能力编码进参数里，但这些能力在 base decoding 行为中没有充分显现；弱自训练只能把这些潜在能力重新表面化，而不能可靠地凭空注入缺失能力。这个问题对预训练研究很关键，因为它直接触到 synthetic data 的边界条件、self-training 的有效机制，以及“模型从自己生成的数据里到底学到了什么”。
summary.importance: 影响主要有三层。第一，它给“模型坍塌”叙事补了一个重要限定：不是所有自生成数据都会把模型带坏，关键在 source-student compatibility。也就是说，synthetic utility 是 relational property，不是 corpus intrinsic property。第二，它把很多分散在 code self-distillation、reasoning self-training、inference-time sampling 里的现象，收束到一个更基础的解释框架：收益更像是 latent capability resurfacing，而不是新知识注入。这对理解 continual pretrain、mid-train synthetic mixing、以及 RL/SFT 为什么常常像“激活已有能力”而非“创造能力”都有直接启发。第三，它提出了一个对数据研究很不舒服但很重要的结论：常见的静态 proxy——比如 student 对语料的平均 NLL、语料和 benchmark 的语义相似度、source 模型更大更强——都不足以预测 transfer utility。对做数据配比、合成数据筛选、teacher 选择的人来说，这意味着现有很多经验法则并不稳。
summary.technical_approach:
方法设计刻意做得很“干净”。训练管线只有三步：从某个 source model 以 BOS token 为起点无条件采样，得到 plain text synthetic corpus；用这些文本继续微调一个 base student；然后在一组下游 benchmark 上评估变化。整个过程中不引入任务提示、拒绝采样、答案校验、reward、偏好模型或外部数据过滤，因此任何收益都只能来自 student 与 synthetic signal 的相互作用，而不是额外监督。

核心分析框架有三部分。第一部分是 compatibility study。作者系统比较了 self-generated、same-lineage、different-recipe、cross-family 等 source-student 配对。以 Qwen student 为例，self data 最有效；同家族但更大的 Qwen2.5-7B 往往优于训练 recipe 已变化的 Qwen3-8B；跨家族如 LLaMA-3.2-1B 常常更弱甚至有害。这里的关键不是 source 绝对能力，而是 tokenizer、训练分布、建模习惯、内部表示结构等共同形成的“谱系相容性”。论文没有把 compatibility 简化成单一可观测量，而是把它当作一个经验上可验证、但未被简单 proxy 捕获的关系属性。

第二部分是对“intrinsic data quality”解释的反证。作者检验了几类直觉上应该有效的 proxy：student 对 synthetic corpus 的 mean NLL、synthetic corpus 与 benchmark 的语义接近度、增大 synthetic support 的规模等。结果显示，这些指标和真实 downstream gain 的对应关系很弱，甚至会出现“相同 NLL、相反收益”或“benchmark similarity 不同、收益相近”的情况。这个结果很重要，因为它说明自训练收益不是简单的 distribution matching，也不是“更像测试集就更好”。

第三部分是 latent capability resurfacing 的机制证据。作者不是只看 benchmark 分数，而是同时看 extractability。若收益只是 rehearse 了 source 生成的具体序列，那么 utility 上升通常会伴随更高的 verbatim extraction 风险。作者在 Pythia 控制实验里观察到相反现象：在合适的自训练区间，held-out exact-match extractability 明显下降，而 benchmark utility 保持甚至上升。这支持一种更分布式的解释：训练更新强化了参数中已有但未充分表达的任务结构，而不是记住更多具体句子。

此外，全文还讨论了 temperature 的作用。温度不是越高越好或越低越好，而是在 fidelity 与 coverage 之间做权衡：低温更贴近 source 的高置信模式，高温带来更广覆盖但也更噪。只有在兼容配对里，这个 trade-off 才能转化为稳定收益；在不兼容配对里，增加多样性并不能补救谱系错配。
summary.experiments:
实验结论比摘要里更完整，重点有四组。第一组是 source-student 配对实验。Qwen student 在 self-training 下收益最好；same-lineage transfer 次之；different recipe 和 cross-family 明显更差。作者特别强调一个反直觉点：较小但同谱系的 source，可能比更大但训练 recipe 改过的 source 更有用。这说明“teacher 越强越好”在这里不成立。

第二组是模型家族差异。Qwen 系列在 reasoning、math、code 上能得到更广泛收益；作者测试的 LLaMA student 收益更窄，主要集中在理解型 benchmark，对 structured generation 的改善不稳定。这一点支持“自训练放大预训练已支持的能力边界”而不是“补齐模型短板”。如果预训练里没有足够强的结构化生成基础，单靠 BOS-only synthetic text 很难补出来。

第三组是 proxy 失效实验。作者把 downstream gain 与 mean NLL、benchmark similarity、synthetic support size 等做对照，发现这些量都不能稳定排序不同 synthetic corpora 的效用。尤其是 mean NLL 这个结果很关键，因为它否定了一个常见想法：只要 student 觉得数据“顺口”，继续训练就会有帮助。论文给出的证据是，同样容易被 student 拟合的数据，可能带来相反的迁移结果。

第四组是 utility-extractability frontier。Pythia 控制实验中，compatible self-training 把点推向“更高 utility、更低 verbatim extractability”的区域。摘要里只说了趋势，正文强调下降是明显的，而不是边际波动。这组结果是全文最有机制含义的一部分，因为它把“不是简单记忆”从口头判断变成了可测现象。

从全文可见，作者更重视现象的稳健排序和机制辨析，而不是追求单个 benchmark 上的大幅绝对增益。参数规模和数据规模在正文中用于构造不同 source-student 关系，例如 Qwen2.5-0.5B student、Qwen2.5-7B source、Qwen3-8B source、LLaMA-3.2-1B source，以及 Pythia 系列的受控实验。合成数据来自 BOS-only unconditional sampling，且作者还考察了 temperature 和 synthetic support 的变化，但结论是扩大样本量本身带来的额外稳定收益有限，远不如 compatibility 重要。
summary.reading_guide:
建议按“假设—反证—机制证据”这条线读。

先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1。Figure 1 基本把全文三条主结论都压缩进去了：utility 是关系性的、简单 proxy 失效、utility 可以和 extractability 反向变化。读懂这张图，全文主旨就清楚了。

然后重点看 source-student pairing 的主实验部分。这里要注意作者不是在比较谁更强，而是在比较 lineage、recipe、family 变化如何影响 transfer。读的时候可以把 tokenizer、数据分布、训练目标细节这些潜变量放在脑中，因为 compatibility 很可能就是这些因素的合成结果。

接着看 proxy analysis。这里最值得深挖的是为什么 mean NLL 和 benchmark similarity 都不够。一个可继续思考的问题是：如果静态 proxy 不行，是否需要基于训练动态、梯度对齐、表示几何或 Fisher overlap 的 compatibility 指标。

Pythia 的 extractability 实验值得精读，尤其是 utility-extractability frontier 的图表和实验设置。这部分决定了论文是否只是“又一个 self-training 有点用”的经验结论，还是对机制有更强约束。若时间有限，至少把 exact-match extraction 的定义、held-out 构造方式、以及与 benchmark utility 的联动关系看清楚。

最后看 temperature 与 synthetic support 的消融。这里能帮助判断这项工作对实际 recipe 的含义：该优先调 source 选择，还是调采样温度，还是盲目扩 synthetic corpus。预计认真读完主文需要 45 到 70 分钟；若连附录中的更多配对和消融一起看，时间会更长。
summary.authors_note: UT Austin VITA Group。文中可确认的作者包括通讯作者 Sina Alemohammad；其研究背景与 model collapse、synthetic data、生成模型训练分布偏移相关。其余作者信息在给定全文片段中无法完整确认。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a deliberately minimal question: can a language model improve by continuing training on plain text sampled from a model with only a BOS token as input, with no prompts, no teacher annotations, no verifier, and no reward model? The answer is yes, but only under a compatibility condition between the source model and the student. The central claim is not that synthetic text has an intrinsic quality level that makes it useful or harmful. Instead, usefulness is relational. The paper formalizes this through the latent capability resurfacing hypothesis: pretraining already encodes capabilities that are only partially expressed by the base model, and weak self-training can resurface them when the synthetic corpus is compatible with the student. In incompatible settings, the same procedure does little or can even hurt. This is a sharp question for pretraining research because it probes what synthetic data is actually doing, where self-training breaks, and whether gains come from new information injection or from amplifying structure already present in the pretrained weights.
summary_en.importance: The contribution matters in three ways. First, it adds an important qualifier to the model-collapse narrative. Recursive synthetic training is not uniformly bad; the outcome depends strongly on source-student compatibility. That shifts the discussion from intrinsic corpus quality to pairwise transfer geometry. Second, it provides a cleaner explanatory frame for several scattered observations from code self-distillation, reward-free reasoning self-training, and inference-time sampling: many gains may be better understood as resurfacing latent capabilities rather than creating new ones. That has direct implications for continual pretraining, synthetic data mixing, and the interface between pretraining and post-training. Third, it shows that common static proxies are poor predictors of synthetic utility. Source size, source capability, mean NLL under the student, and benchmark similarity all fail to reliably rank synthetic corpora. For anyone working on data curation, teacher selection, or synthetic filtering, that is a nontrivial warning.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The experimental design is intentionally stripped down. A source model generates unconditional text from BOS. That synthetic corpus is then used to continue training a base student. The student is evaluated on downstream benchmarks. There are no prompts, no task formatting, no rejection sampling, no correctness filtering, no reward model, and no external supervision. This makes the setup unusually clean: if gains appear, they must come from the interaction between the pretrained student and weak self-generated signal.

The analysis has three main components. First is the compatibility study. The paper compares self-generated data, same-lineage transfer, different-recipe transfer, and cross-family transfer. For Qwen students, self-generated data works best; a same-lineage source such as Qwen2.5-7B transfers better than a differently trained but larger source such as Qwen3-8B; cross-family sources such as LLaMA-3.2-1B are weaker and can be harmful. The key point is that absolute source strength is not the right axis. Compatibility likely reflects a bundle of factors such as tokenizer alignment, training distribution, optimization recipe, and internal representational structure.

Second, the paper directly tests and rejects intrinsic-data explanations. It evaluates several plausible proxies: mean token NLL of the synthetic corpus under the student, semantic similarity between the synthetic corpus and benchmark distributions, and scaling the amount of synthetic support. None of these reliably predicts downstream gains. The paper explicitly shows cases where similar NLL leads to opposite transfer outcomes, and where benchmark similarity differs without corresponding utility differences. This is a strong argument against simple distribution matching stories.

Third, the paper provides mechanism-oriented evidence for latent capability resurfacing by jointly measuring utility and extractability. If gains were mainly due to rehearsal of specific generated sequences, one would expect better downstream performance to come with higher verbatim extraction risk. In controlled Pythia experiments, the paper finds the opposite in favorable regimes: held-out exact-match extractability drops while downstream utility is preserved or improved. That points to reinforcement of more distributed task structure rather than memorization of specific strings.

The paper also studies temperature as a coverage-fidelity trade-off. Lower temperature stays closer to high-confidence source modes; higher temperature broadens support but adds noise. This trade-off only becomes useful when the source-student pair is already compatible. More diversity does not rescue an incompatible pairing.
summary_en.experiments:
The empirical story has four important pieces. First, source-student pairing experiments establish the main ranking: self-training is strongest, same-lineage transfer is next, and different-recipe or cross-family transfer is weaker. A notable result is that a smaller but lineage-matched source can outperform a larger source trained with a different recipe. So stronger teacher does not imply better synthetic data in this setting.

Second, the paper compares student families. Qwen students show broader gains across reasoning, math, and code. The LLaMA student examined in the paper improves more narrowly, mostly on comprehension-style benchmarks, with little reliable gain on structured generation. This supports the claim that BOS-only self-training amplifies abilities already supported by pretraining rather than filling in missing structured capabilities.

Third, proxy-failure experiments show that mean NLL under the student, benchmark similarity, and synthetic support size do not reliably explain downstream gains. This is especially important for mean NLL, since it rules out a common intuition that data the student already finds easy should be safe and useful for continued training.

Fourth, the Pythia-controlled experiments examine the utility-extractability frontier. Compatible self-training moves the model toward better benchmark utility with lower held-out exact-match verbatim extraction. The paper presents this as a clear shift, not a tiny fluctuation. That is the strongest evidence in the paper against a simple rehearsal explanation.

The paper uses concrete source-student configurations such as Qwen2.5-0.5B as student, Qwen2.5-7B and Qwen3-8B as alternative sources, LLaMA-3.2-1B as a cross-family source, and Pythia models for controlled analysis. Synthetic corpora are generated via BOS-only unconditional sampling. The paper also varies temperature and synthetic support size, and finds that scaling support alone yields limited stable benefit compared with getting compatibility right.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the Introduction and Figure 1. Figure 1 already contains the paper’s three central claims: utility is relational, simple intrinsic proxies fail, and utility can improve while extractability decreases. If that figure is clear, the rest of the paper becomes much easier to parse.

Then read the main source-student pairing experiments carefully. The important question is not which source is larger or stronger, but how lineage, recipe, and family changes affect transfer. While reading, keep latent variables such as tokenizer overlap, pretraining distribution, and optimization recipe in mind, since compatibility is likely an aggregate effect of these factors.

Next, focus on the proxy analysis. This section is worth reading slowly because it explains what does not work. A useful follow-up question is what a better compatibility metric might look like: gradient alignment, representation overlap, Fisher geometry, or some training-dynamics-based signal may be more promising than static corpus scores.

The Pythia extractability section deserves close attention, especially the utility-extractability frontier plots and the exact definition of held-out exact-match extraction. This is the part that turns the paper from an empirical self-training note into a stronger mechanism paper.

If time is limited, read the main text plus the key figures on pairing, proxy failure, and extractability. That should take around 45 to 70 minutes. The appendix is worth checking if you care about robustness across pairings and additional ablations.

summary.core_problem: 在不依赖外部 verifier/奖励/执行反馈的前提下，让 self-distillation 产生可跨领域泛化的增益，并避免把自生成数据里的风格、格式、错误模式一起蒸馏进去导致信号被稀释。
summary.importance: 对 post-train/持续自训练更直接：它提供了一种“内部信号”做自生成数据的能力选择（capability-selective）方法，试图把自蒸馏从“全量模仿输出”变成“只放大目标能力相关的表示方向”。对预训练研究的启发点在于：用梯度在激活空间里抽取低秩子空间，再用投影钩子在生成阶段做 steering，是一种把“训练信号”前置到数据生成环节的思路，可能比事后过滤更便宜、更通用。
summary.technical_approach:
SPD 分两阶段：
1) 子空间提取（calibration）：用一个小校准集，定义 correctness spans（直接决定任务成败的答案 token 区间），只在这些位置计算 loss。然后对选定层的 key/value 激活求梯度，收集梯度矩阵并做 SVD，得到低秩 capability subspace（分别针对 K/V）。直觉是：这些梯度方向更“对准”目标能力，而不是格式/风格。
2) 生成期 steering + 蒸馏：在解码时对对应层的 KV 激活注册 projection hooks，把中间表示投影到上述子空间（不改参数），用 hooked 模型为每个 prompt 生成一个 completion，构造自生成语料。生成完移除 hooks，用原模型对 prompt–completion 做标准 NTP 微调。
关键取舍：不做外部筛选（省成本、适用于 frontier 模型缺少可靠外部信号的场景）；也不直接用原模型裸生成（避免把噪声/风格一起学回去）。用“梯度-低秩-投影”在生成阶段做软约束，等价于一种轻量的 test-time representation editing 来改善训练数据分布。
summary.experiments:
覆盖三类能力域：代码、数学推理、多选 QA；并在五个 backbone 上评估（文中未在给定片段列出具体模型名）。设置包含 in-domain 与 out-of-domain transfer 两种。
结果以相对提升汇报：相对无外部信号的 SOTA 自蒸馏方法最高提升 13%；相对预训练基线 in-domain 最高提升 16%；out-of-domain 最高提升 15%。
从方法结构看，关键对照应包括：不加投影钩子的裸 self-distill、不同秩 r、不同层位置/只投影 K 或 V、以及 correctness span 定义方式；这些决定“能力选择”是否真实发生，而不是简单的解码扰动带来的偶然收益（建议读实验/消融确认）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读路径：
- 先读方法 3.2/3.3：搞清楚 correctness span 怎么标、梯度对 KV 激活怎么取、SVD 得到的投影矩阵如何挂到解码图里。
- 再看主结果图（Fig.1 及对应表格）：重点看 out-of-domain 是否稳定、以及不同 backbone 是否一致。
- 最后扫消融：rank/层/只 K 或只 V/校准集大小，对判断可复现性最关键。
预计阅读时间：30–45 分钟能抓住方法与主要结论；要复现实现细节需要再加 30 分钟看附录/实现说明（如果提供）。

summary_en.core_problem: Make self-distillation work without any external signals (verifiers, rewards, execution feedback) while remaining domain-general, by preventing self-generated data from entangling the target capability with style/formatting artifacts and model-specific errors.
summary_en.importance: Most directly relevant to post-training and continual self-training: it proposes an internal, capability-selective way to shape self-generated corpora before distillation. The broader pretraining-facing idea is to use gradients to extract a low-rank “capability subspace” in activation space, then apply projection hooks during decoding to steer generations—shifting part of the supervision design from after-the-fact filtering to data generation-time control.
summary_en.technical_approach:
SPD is a two-phase pipeline:
1) Calibration / subspace extraction: define correctness spans (answer tokens that determine success) and compute a loss only on those positions. Collect gradients w.r.t. key/value activations at selected layers across a small calibration set, then run SVD to obtain low-rank projection subspaces for K and V.
2) Generation-time steering + distillation: register projection hooks on the corresponding KV activations during decoding to project intermediate representations onto the capability subspace (no parameter updates). Use the hooked model to generate one completion per training prompt, forming a self-generated corpus. Remove hooks and fine-tune the original model on the prompt–completion pairs with standard next-token loss.
Design trade-off: avoids costly/fragile external curation, but also avoids naive “train on raw self-outputs” by biasing generations toward capability-aligned directions rather than style/noise.
summary_en.experiments:
Evaluated across three capability domains (code, math reasoning, multiple-choice QA) and five backbones (not enumerated in the provided excerpt). Two transfer regimes are reported: in-domain and out-of-domain.
Reported gains are relative improvements: up to 13% over prior self-distillation methods without external signals, up to 16% over pretrained baselines in-domain, and up to 15% better out-of-domain.
Key validations to look for in the paper’s ablations: removing hooks (plain self-distill), varying subspace rank, layer placement, projecting only K vs only V, and calibration set size / correctness-span definitions—these determine whether the method is truly capability-selective rather than a generic decoding perturbation.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan:
- Sections 3.2–3.3 to understand the mechanics (correctness spans, how KV gradients are collected, how SVD projections are implemented as decoding hooks).
- Main results (Fig. 1 and core tables): focus on out-of-domain transfer stability and consistency across backbones.
- Ablations: rank/layer/K-only vs V-only/calibration size are the most informative for reproducibility.
Time: ~30–45 minutes for the core idea and results; add ~30 minutes if you want implementation-level clarity from appendices.

recommendation.zh: 想做无 verifier 的 self-bootstrapping 可以看；关键不是结果表，而是它把“能力”近似成梯度低秩子空间，这个假设值得单独做 ablation。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you care about verifier-free self-bootstrapping; the real idea is treating capability as a low-rank gradient subspace, which deserves standalone ablation.

paper.title: The Economics of Model Collapse: Equilibrium, Welfare, and Optimal Provenance Subsidies in Synthetic Data Markets
paper.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence is rapidly transforming the supply side of training data: an increasing share of new tokens, images, and structured records is produced by previous-generation models rather than by human originators. Recursive training on such synthetic content induces a measurable and often irreversible loss of distributional fidelity, a phenomenon known as model collapse. We develop the first unified microeconomic theory of synthetic data markets under model collapse. We intr

summary.core_problem: 缺少针对合成数据市场中模型塌缩现象的统一微观经济学理论，无法量化其对社会福利的影响及最优监管策略。
summary.importance: 首次建立合成数据市场在模型塌缩下的微观经济均衡框架，属于交叉领域原理分析，为数据治理政策提供理论参考。
summary.technical_approach: 定义合成数据污染均衡（SDCE）并证明其存在性与唯一性，推导包含模型塌缩损失的福利分解，给出福利最大化的来源补贴与水印强度的闭式解。
summary.experiments: 论文为纯理论经济模型工作，无针对LLM预训练的实证实验，所有结论均通过经济理论推导得出。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自斯德哥尔摩大学经济系，专注于AI相关的经济理论研究，无公开的LLM工程领域相关工作。

summary_en.core_problem: There is no unified microeconomic theory for the model collapse phenomenon in synthetic data markets, making it impossible to quantify its impact on social welfare and the optimal regulatory strategy.
summary_en.importance: It is the first work to establish a microeconomic equilibrium framework for synthetic data markets under model collapse, belonging to cross-field principle analysis, and provides theoretical reference for data governance policies.
summary_en.technical_approach: Define Synthetic Data Contamination Equilibrium (SDCE) and prove its existence and uniqueness, derive welfare decomposition including model collapse loss, and give closed-form solutions for welfare-maximizing provenance subsidy and watermark strength.
summary_en.experiments: This is a pure theoretical economic model work with no empirical experiments on LLM pretraining; all conclusions are derived through economic theory.
summary_en.authors_note: The author is from the Department of Economics at Stockholm University, focusing on AI-related economic theory, with no publicly related work in the LLM engineering field.

recommendation.zh: 作为合成数据治理的交叉理论参考，预训练研究员无需深入正文，仅了解核心结论即可。
recommendation.en: It can be used as a cross-theoretical reference for synthetic data governance; pretraining researchers do not need to delve into the text, only understanding the core conclusions is sufficient.

stage_evidence.quote: This is a pure theoretical economic model work with no empirical experiments on LLM pretraining; all conclusions are derived through economic theory.

summary.core_problem: 研究合成数据市场中，递归训练导致的 model collapse 如何影响市场均衡、社会福利和数据溯源补贴。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是经济学与理论建模分析，主题与预训练数据污染、合成数据比例和 provenance 机制有关，但不是直接的 LLM 数据配比实验或训练 recipe。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Synthetic Data Contamination Equilibrium，给出存在性和唯一性论证，构造福利分解项，并引入 Wasserstein-gradient-flow 形式描述平均场 collapse 极限。还推导了 provenance subsidy 和 watermark strength 的闭式表达。
summary.experiments: 摘要主要描述理论推导，没有报告真实 LLM 预训练实验、合成数据污染曲线、模型规模、token 规模或可复现 benchmark。结论更适合作为政策或数据市场模型假设，而不是训练工程证据。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how recursive training and model collapse affect equilibrium, welfare, and provenance subsidies in synthetic data markets.
summary_en.importance: This is an economics and theory-modeling contribution. The topic touches pretraining data contamination, synthetic-data share, and provenance, but it is not an LLM data-mixture experiment or a training recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces a Synthetic Data Contamination Equilibrium, proves existence and generic uniqueness, defines a welfare decomposition, and uses a Wasserstein-gradient-flow mean-field limit to describe collapse. It also derives closed-form provenance-subsidy and watermark-strength expressions.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract is primarily theoretical and reports no real LLM pretraining runs, synthetic-data contamination curves, model sizes, token budgets, or reproducible benchmarks. The results are better read as policy-model assumptions than as training evidence.

recommendation.zh: 主题贴近数据污染，但证据是经济模型；可记下变量设定，不要把闭式补贴公式当训练结论。
recommendation.en: The topic is close to data contamination, but the evidence is an economic model; note the assumptions, not the closed-form subsidy as a training result.

paper.title: MIND: Decoupling Model-Induced Label Noise via Latent Manifold Disentanglement
paper.abstract: The paradigm of learning from automatic annotations driven by pre-trained experts and Foundation Models dominates data-hungry applications. However, it introduces a critical challenge: model-induced label noise. Unlike stochastic noise in classical robust learning, this noise stems from annotator inductive biases, manifesting as systematic errors tightly coupled with local feature manifolds. Existing methods relying on global transition matrices underfit these structural patterns, while learning

summary.core_problem: 处理由预训练专家模型或基础模型自动标注带来的系统性标签噪声，而不是传统随机标签噪声。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是数据质量和噪声建模分析。它不直接研究LLM预训练，但“模型生成标注会携带标注器归纳偏置”这一问题对合成数据、蒸馏数据和自动标注数据的质量控制有弱相关性。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 Model-Induced Noise Decoupling，即 MIND。核心假设是高维噪声流形可通过 Latent Manifold Disentanglement 分解为若干子空间相关的误差模式。Latent Decoupling Estimator 动态把样本投影到具有一致错误模式的潜在结构簇中，再做噪声识别和处理。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体数据集、模型规模、基线和提升幅度。可确认的是方法针对由自动标注专家和基础模型产生的数据场景，并与全局转移矩阵或实例级转移矩阵路线形成对比。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses systematic label noise induced by pretrained experts and foundation-model annotators, rather than classical stochastic label noise.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a noise-modeling framework for machine-generated annotations. It is not an LLM pretraining paper, but the failure mode is relevant to synthetic data, distillation data, and automated labeling pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: MIND, or Model-Induced Noise Decoupling, assumes that high-dimensional model-induced noise can be decomposed into subspace-dependent components through latent manifold disentanglement. Its Latent Decoupling Estimator dynamically projects samples into latent structural clusters with consistent error modes to support noise identification.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify datasets, model sizes, baselines, or numerical improvements. The comparison target is the family of global transition-matrix methods and intractable instance-specific transition-matrix approaches.

recommendation.zh: 对合成标注数据有旁路价值；只看噪声随局部流形成簇这个假设，别期待LLM数据配方答案。
recommendation.en: Useful as a side signal for synthetic-label pipelines; read only the manifold-clustered noise assumption, not as an LLM data recipe.

stage_evidence.quote: 处理由预训练专家模型或基础模型自动标注带来的系统性标签噪声，而不是传统随机标签噪声。

paper.title: KamonBench: A Grammar-Based Dataset for Evaluating Compositional Factor Recovery in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Kamon (family crests) are an important part of Japanese culture and a natural test case for compositional visual recognition: each crest combines a small number of symbolic choices, but the space of possible descriptions is sparse. We introduce KamonBench, a grammar-based image-to-structure benchmark with 20,000 synthetic composite crests and auxiliary component examples. Each composite crest is paired with a formal kamon description language - "kamon yōgo" - description, a segmented Japanese an

summary.core_problem: KamonBench 解决的是 VLM 是否真的能从图像中恢复可组合视觉因子的问题，而不是只做自由文本 caption 或记忆常见图文配对。家纹图像由 container、modifier、motif 三类因素组合而成，语言侧有相对形式化的 kamon description language。这个设定把“看懂图像”转成了“恢复结构化生成程序”的问题。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在评测侧。它提供了一个低噪声、可控、可组合的 image-to-structure benchmark，用来检查 VLM 是否学到可复用视觉因子。相比常规 VQA 或 caption 指标，这类任务更接近对多模态表示的诊断：模型是否把 motif、容器、空间排列、形变这几类因素分开表示，是否能在少样本或未见组合上重组。对研究视觉 tokenizer、native multimodal pretraining、组合泛化评测有一定参考价值，但它不是新的预训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是用语法生成合成家纹数据。每个样本从已知因子生成，包括容器、修饰/空间排列、基础 motif。每张合成 crest 配有多种目标表示：KDL 描述、日语分词分析、英文翻译、非语言 program code。这样做的取舍很清楚：不用真实网页家纹，是为了避免闭源 VLM 可能已经在预训练中见过常见家纹；使用合成语法，是为了拿到精确的生成因子，能做比 caption accuracy 更细的评估。论文强调家纹空间很稀疏：真实常见图样有限，但组合空间很大，当前非递归因子库存约有 77 万种组合。这使它适合测试模型是否掌握组合规则，而不是记住整图。
summary.experiments: 数据集规模为 20,000 个合成 composite crests，并提供辅助 component examples。评测不只看文本匹配，还支持 program-code factor metrics，即分别检查 container、modifier、motif 是否恢复正确；也支持受控的 factor-pair recombination，用来测试模型在未见组合上的泛化。提供内容里没有完整列出各 VLM 的具体分数，因此更应把实验部分理解为 benchmark 设计和评测协议，而不是模型方法的性能改进。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 15–25 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 kamon 因子结构的定义，以及 Kamon as a machine learning problem 对稀疏组合空间的论证。若关心多模态评测，优先看数据生成语法、program-code 指标、factor recovery 指标和重组测试设计。无需在文化背景部分停留太久，核心信息是：它把图像理解任务压成了可控的结构恢复任务。

summary_en.core_problem: KamonBench asks whether VLMs can recover compositional visual factors from an image, rather than produce a plausible caption or memorize frequent image-text pairs. A kamon crest is generated from factors such as container, modifier, and motif, and the target language is a constrained kamon description language. The task is therefore image-to-structure, not ordinary captioning.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretraining research is diagnostic. The benchmark gives a controlled way to test whether a multimodal model has learned reusable visual factors and can recombine them under sparse supervision. This is more informative than standard VQA or caption accuracy when the question is representation quality: whether the model separates motif identity, containment, spatial arrangement, and visual modification. It is relevant to studies of visual tokenization, native multimodal pretraining, and compositional generalization, but it is not a new pretraining method.
summary_en.technical_approach: The dataset is generated by a grammar over kamon factors. Each synthetic crest has known latent factors and is paired with multiple outputs: a KDL description, segmented Japanese analysis, English translation, and a non-linguistic program code. The design choice is deliberate. Real web images would be hard to use for evaluating proprietary VLMs because common crests may already appear in their training data. Synthetic generation provides unseen combinations and exact factor labels. The paper also emphasizes sparsity: although common real crests are limited, the non-recursive factor inventory already yields roughly 770,000 combinations.
summary_en.experiments: KamonBench contains 20,000 synthetic composite crests plus auxiliary component examples. The evaluation supports more than caption-level scoring: direct program-code factor metrics can measure recovery of container, modifier, and motif separately, and controlled factor-pair recombination tests whether models generalize to unseen combinations. The provided content does not include full per-model scores, so the experimental contribution should be read mainly as a benchmark protocol and data construction pipeline.
summary_en.reading_guide: A light read is enough, about 15–25 minutes. Focus on the factor definition in the introduction and the argument in the machine-learning section for why kamon is a sparse compositional recognition task. For multimodal evaluation work, inspect the grammar, program-code target, factor-level metrics, and recombination tests. The cultural background is useful context, but the main technical point is the conversion of visual recognition into controlled structure recovery.

recommendation.zh: 读数据生成 grammar 和 factor metrics 就够；它对 VLM 预训练诊断有用，但合成家纹域的外推性要打折。
recommendation.en: Read the grammar and factor metrics; it is useful for VLM diagnostics, but the synthetic crest domain limits how far the conclusions travel.

stage_evidence.quote: 合成 crest 配有多种目标表示：KDL 描述、日语分词分析、英文翻译、非语言 program code。这样做的取舍很清楚：不用真实网页家纹，是为了避免闭源 VLM 可能已经在预训练中见过常见家纹；使用合成语法，是为了拿到精确的生成因子，能做比 caption accuracy 更细的评估。论文强调家纹空间很稀疏：真实常见图样有限，但组合空间很大，当前非递归因子库存约有 77 万种组合。这使它适合测试模型是否掌握组合规则，而不是记住整图。

paper.title: Evolutionary Task Discovery: Advancing Reasoning Frontiers via Skill Composition and Complexity Scaling
paper.abstract: The reasoning frontier of Large Language Models (LLMs) has advanced significantly through modern post-training paradigms (e.g., Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR)). However, the efficacy of these methods remains fundamentally constrained by the diversity and complexity of the training data. One practical solution is data synthesis; yet, prevalent methods relying on unstructured mutation or exploration suffer from homogeneity collapse, failing to systematically expand the reaso

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是 RLVR 训练中的推理数据扩展问题：现有合成方法常用“改得更难”“增加约束”这类非结构化提示，容易生成近重复样本，或者只覆盖技能标签而没有系统控制题目复杂度。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对基座预训练的直接贡献不大，但对 post-train 数据引擎有参考价值。它把推理数据合成从文本扰动推进到结构化搜索：同时控制“需要什么算法技能”和“实例复杂度如何变化”。这个视角适合用于 RLVR、SFT 数据构造，也能反哺预训练阶段对算法题、数学题、程序合成数据的组织方式。贡献量级属于方法框架和数据生成范式改进，不是模型架构或预训练目标的改动。
summary.technical_approach: EvoTD 将 reasoning task 表示为两个相对独立的维度：Algorithmic Skills 和 Complexity Attributes。前者描述逻辑骨架，例如二分、堆、图算法；后者描述结构约束，例如输入规模、图大小、约束数量。方法包含两个演化算子：Attribute Mutation 用来放大或改变复杂度属性，Skill Crossover 用来组合不同技能，生成新的复合任务。系统采用 proposer-solver 流程：proposer 生成任务，solver 在这些任务上训练。为了避免样本太简单或完全不可学，作者引入基于当前 solver policy 的 Zone of Proximal Development 过滤，只保留处在当前模型可学习区间内的样本。随着 solver 变强，过滤器会接受更难的任务，从而形成动态课程。另一个过滤环节使用 LLM 的自评能力检查合成任务是否真的匹配目标技能，避免技能标签和题目内容脱节。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖代码生成和数学推理等五类 benchmark。作者报告 EvoTD 在多种 backbone 上都优于启发式合成方法，包括 Qwen3、LLaMA，不同预训练状态的 Base/Instruct 模型，以及 3B 到 8B 参数规模。以 Qwen3-4B reasoning model 为例，AIME 24 提升 8.2 个百分点，AIME 25 提升 7.2 个百分点。增益还能迁移到 MMLU-Pro、SuperGPQA 等通用推理评测，主要集中在 STEM 相关科目。文中给出的实验信息说明，收益不只来自生成更多样本，而是来自技能组合、复杂度扩展和动态可学习性过滤的配合。不过从摘要和正文片段看，仍需要重点检查合成成本、验证器误判、以及生成题目和真实 benchmark 分布之间的距离。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 15–20 分钟。优先看方法部分对 Algorithmic Skills / Complexity Attributes 的形式化定义，再看 Attribute Mutation、Skill Crossover 和 ZPD 过滤流程。实验部分重点看三类内容：与普通 prompt mutation 的对比、去掉两个演化算子的消融、不同模型规模和 Base/Instruct 设置下的稳定性。如果时间有限，只看任务空间建模和过滤器设计即可；这是对 RLVR 数据合成最有信息量的部分。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a data-scaling bottleneck in RLVR: current synthetic reasoning data pipelines often rely on unstructured prompt mutations, which tend to produce near-duplicates or broaden skill coverage without systematically increasing instance complexity.
summary_en.importance: The work is more relevant to post-training data engines than to core pretraining objectives, but it carries useful lessons for pretraining data construction as well. Its main contribution is a structured view of reasoning-data synthesis: control the algorithmic skill being exercised and the complexity attributes of the instance separately. This is a practical abstraction for RLVR curricula, SFT data generation, and possibly large-scale algorithmic data mixtures in pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: EvoTD models a reasoning task along two axes: Algorithmic Skills, which specify the logical backbone such as binary search, heaps, or graph algorithms; and Complexity Attributes, which specify structural constraints such as input size, graph size, or the number of conditions. The framework introduces two evolutionary operators. Attribute Mutation scales or changes complexity attributes. Skill Crossover composes skills to discover new compound tasks. A proposer generates candidate tasks, and a solver learns from tasks that pass filtering. The key filter is based on the solver’s current policy and keeps tasks in the model’s zone of proximal development: not already trivial, but not impossible either. As the solver improves, the accepted task distribution shifts toward harder instances. The pipeline also uses an LLM-based metacognitive check to verify that the generated task aligns with the intended skills.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover five benchmarks across code generation and mathematical reasoning. The reported results show consistent gains over heuristic synthesis methods across Qwen3 and LLaMA backbones, Base and Instruct variants, and model sizes from 3B to 8B. On Qwen3-4B reasoning model, EvoTD improves AIME 24 by 8.2 percentage points and AIME 25 by 7.2 percentage points. Gains also transfer to MMLU-Pro and SuperGPQA, with stronger effects on STEM-adjacent categories. The reported evidence suggests that the benefit comes from the combination of skill composition, complexity scaling, and learnability filtering rather than from simply adding more generated examples. The remaining questions are generation cost, verifier reliability, and distributional distance between synthesized tasks and target benchmarks.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 15–20 minute skim is enough. Focus on the formalization of Algorithmic Skills and Complexity Attributes, then read the definitions of Attribute Mutation, Skill Crossover, and the solver-dependent filtering rule. In the experiments, check comparisons against plain prompt mutation, ablations of the two evolutionary operators, and robustness across model scale and Base/Instruct settings. If time is limited, the task-space abstraction and filtering mechanism are the most useful parts.

recommendation.zh: 看任务空间定义和去重实验；若复杂度轴干净，可直接借到 internal RLVR 数据管线。
recommendation.en: Read the task-space definition and dedup tests; if the complexity axis is clean, it is usable for internal RLVR data pipelines.

paper.title: L2P: Unlocking Latent Potential for Pixel Generation
paper.abstract: Pixel diffusion models have recently regained attention for visual generation. However, training advanced pixel-space models from scratch demands prohibitive computational and data resources. To address this, we propose the Latent-to-Pixel (L2P) transfer paradigm, an efficient framework that directly harnesses the rich knowledge of pre-trained LDMs to build powerful pixel-space models. Specifically, L2P discards the VAE in favor of large-patch tokenization and freezes the source LDM's intermedia

summary.core_problem: 如何在几乎不收集真实数据、低算力条件下，把预训练latent diffusion的生成能力迁移到像素空间扩散模型，并支持超高分辨率生成。
summary.importance: 提供一种“从latent到pixel”的迁移范式：冻结大部分预训练扩散网络、只学浅层映射，并用合成数据自举训练；对生成模型预训练/迁移与数据闭环有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出L2P：去掉VAE，改用大patch tokenization；冻结源LDM的中间层，仅训练浅层以学习latent-to-pixel变换；训练数据完全来自源LDM生成的合成图像，从“已平滑的流形”上快速收敛；去除VAE带来的显存瓶颈以解锁原生4K生成。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出关键指标与对比细节；宣称仅用8张GPU训练、可实现原生4K生成，并在多组实验中验证（具体baseline/提升幅度需看正文）。

summary_en.core_problem: How to transfer a pretrained latent diffusion model into a pixel-space diffusion model with minimal compute and no real-data collection, while enabling ultra-high-resolution generation.
summary_en.importance: A transfer paradigm from latent to pixel space: freeze most of a pretrained diffusion backbone, learn a shallow mapping, and bootstrap training purely from synthetic samples—useful as a reference for generative pretraining/transfer and synthetic-data loops.
summary_en.technical_approach: L2P removes the VAE and uses large-patch tokenization; freezes intermediate layers of the source LDM and trains only shallow layers to learn a latent-to-pixel transformation; trains solely on images synthesized by the source LDM to fit an already-smooth manifold; removing the VAE alleviates memory bottlenecks to unlock native 4K generation.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract lacks concrete metrics and baselines; claims training with 8 GPUs and native 4K generation, with extensive experiments (details require the paper).

recommendation.zh: 更像“扩散模型迁移/蒸馏”的工程范式：只看冻结策略+纯合成数据闭环是否真能不崩（重点查对比与失败案例）。
recommendation.en: An engineering-heavy diffusion transfer recipe; worth checking whether the freeze+synthetic-only loop is actually stable—focus on baselines and failure modes, not the narrative.

stage_evidence.quote: 如何在几乎不收集真实数据、低算力条件下，把预训练latent diffusion的生成能力迁移到像素空间扩散模型，并支持超高分辨率生成。

paper.title: Mind the Gap? A Distributional Comparison of Real and Synthetic Priors for Tabular Foundation Models
paper.abstract: Tabular foundation models are pre-trained on one of three classes of corpus: curated datasets drawn from benchmark repositories, tables harvested at scale from the web, or synthetic tables sampled from a parametric generative prior. Despite the centrality of pre-training data to model performance, little is known about how these corpora relate to one another in distribution, and the impact this has on downstream performance. In this work we take three canonical, archetypal datasets used to train

summary.core_problem: 核心问题是：表格基础模型的预训练语料到底覆盖了怎样的表格分布，真实表格、网页抓取表格、人工整理表格和合成先验之间是否真的相近。作者关心的不只是“合成数据能不能训练模型”，而是合成先验是否生成了真实表格空间中的样本，以及这种分布距离是否能解释下游性能。
summary.importance: 对 LLM 预训练研究的直接贡献有限，但对“预训练数据先验如何定义、如何验证”有参考价值。表格基础模型和语言模型共享一个问题：预训练语料不是越大越好，关键是覆盖哪些任务分布。该工作给出的启发是，合成预训练任务即使在机制上看似合理，也可能只覆盖真实数据空间中很小的区域；而分布相近与下游性能之间也未必存在简单单调关系。这对用程序化数据、合成任务、环境生成器训练基础模型有借鉴意义。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是把不同来源的表格映射到统一的表级特征空间，再比较分布。作者选取三类代表性语料：T4 代表网页抓取表格，TabFM 代表 Kaggle 等来源的人工整理表格，TabICL 代表公开参数的合成先验。由于表格没有固定结构，作者没有使用特定模型的 learned embedding 作为主分析工具，而是构造了表级、列级和列间关系的聚合特征，避免结论绑定到某个模型。主要特征集包括 Full 特征，维度为 70；Scalars 特征，维度为 9。列类型通过唯一值比例判断，唯一值比例低于 0.2 的列被视为类别列。分布比较用了两类指标：一类是训练判别器预测表格来源，若来源容易区分，则说明样本级分布差异明显；另一类是基于近邻的 coverage 指标，用来衡量一个数据源是否覆盖另一个数据源的区域。作者还尝试优化 TabICL 合成先验参数，希望让合成表格更接近真实语料，并用大规模网格搜索检验这种可调性。
summary.experiments: 关键结果有三点。第一，TabICL 类合成先验只占据真实表格特征空间中很小的一块区域；反过来，真实表格能够较好覆盖合成表格空间。这说明合成先验的多样性在机制描述上可能很丰富，但落到观测特征空间后仍然偏窄。第二，网页抓取表格 T4 与人工整理表格 TabFM 在特征空间中有较大重叠，但单个表格仍能被判别器区分来源。这解释了为什么规模较小但质量较高的 curated 表格语料可以取得接近大规模网页语料的预训练效果。第三，作者对合成先验做了包括约 86k trial 网格搜索在内的参数优化，仍然难以提升对真实表格分布的覆盖，合成与真实样本接近可分。性能侧的初步结果显示，在作者构造的特征空间下，测试表格到合成先验的距离与下游性能没有清晰相关性。这一点很重要：分布覆盖不足是真问题，但简单的表级统计距离未必就是性能的充分解释变量。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看 Introduction 中四个研究问题，能快速把握作者对合成先验、网页语料和整理语料的比较逻辑。Method 部分重点看特征构造、判别器评估和 coverage 指标，尤其是为什么作者避免使用模型 embedding。实验部分建议关注三类结论：合成先验覆盖真实数据的程度、T4 与 TabFM 的重叠、合成先验参数搜索失败。对预训练研究更有用的是方法论，而不是具体表格模型结果：用可解释的分布诊断工具去审计预训练语料，而不是只用下游分数倒推数据质量。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether the pretraining corpora used for tabular foundation models actually live in the same distributional space. It compares web-scraped tables, curated benchmark/Kaggle-style tables, and synthetic tables generated from a parametric prior, with a focus on whether the synthetic prior covers realistic tabular data and whether distributional proximity explains downstream behavior.
summary_en.importance: The direct relevance to text LLM pretraining is moderate, but the data-centric lesson is useful. The work is a concrete case study in auditing a pretraining prior before trusting it as a generator of tasks. It shows that a hand-designed synthetic task generator can be mechanistically plausible yet occupy only a narrow region of the real-data space. It also cautions against assuming that simple distributional proximity metrics will directly predict downstream performance.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors compare three archetypal corpora: T4 for web-scraped tables, TabFM for curated Kaggle-like tables, and TabICL for a synthetic prior with public parameters. Because tables have variable row counts, column counts, types, and order, they map each table into aggregate feature vectors rather than relying on model-specific learned embeddings. The main feature set has 70 dimensions, covering table-level, column-level, and inter-column statistics; a smaller scalar-only feature set has 9 dimensions. Categorical columns are identified using a uniqueness ratio threshold of 0.2. Two families of metrics are used. First, discriminators are trained to predict the source corpus of a table, measuring sample-level distinguishability. Second, nearest-neighbor coverage metrics estimate how much one corpus covers another in the constructed feature space. The paper also attempts to tune the synthetic prior parameters to better match real tables, including a large grid search.
summary_en.experiments: The main empirical finding is that the TabICL-style synthetic prior covers only a small part of the space occupied by real tables, while real tables broadly cover the synthetic region. Curated and web-scraped tables overlap substantially, although individual tables remain distinguishable by source. This helps explain why a smaller curated corpus can be competitive with a much larger web-derived corpus for pretraining. Attempts to reparameterize the synthetic prior do not close the gap: even after an extensive search of about 86k trials, synthetic and real tables remain close to separable. A preliminary downstream analysis finds no clear correlation between model performance and proximity to the synthetic prior under the proposed feature sets, suggesting that the chosen distributional statistics are diagnostic but not a complete account of transfer.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough. Read the research questions in the introduction, then inspect the feature construction and the two evaluation tools: source discriminators and nearest-neighbor coverage. The most useful parts for pretraining researchers are the design choices around model-agnostic corpus diagnostics and the negative result from synthetic-prior optimization. The downstream-performance section should be read as preliminary evidence rather than a full causal explanation.

recommendation.zh: 揭示了表格数据预训练中合成数据与真实数据之间的分布鸿沟，对理解数据质量和合成数据在预训练中的局限性有参考价值。
recommendation.en: Reveals the distributional gap between synthetic and real data in tabular pre-training; valuable for understanding data quality and the limitations of synthetic data in pre-training.

paper.title: Iterative Finetuning is Mostly Idempotent
paper.abstract: If a model has some behavioral tendency, such as sycophancy or misalignment, and it is trained on its own outputs, will the tendency be amplified in the next generation of models? We study this question by training a series of models where each model is finetuned on data generated by its predecessor, and the initial model is seeded with some persona or belief. We test three settings: supervised finetuning (SFT) on instruct models, synthetic document finetuning (SDF) on base models, and direct pr

summary.core_problem: 互联网上LLM生成内容占比持续提升，未来预训练数据将包含大量前代模型输出，需要明确在模型自身输出上迭代微调是否会放大已有行为倾向（如谄媚、错位）。
summary.importance: 明确了不同微调范式下迭代自训练的特质演化规律，为预训练数据过滤、对齐阶段的风险防控提供了实证依据，也为持续学习的安全边界提供了参考。
summary.technical_approach: 构造7类不同特质（包括错位、厌世、谄媚等）的种子数据集，分别在有监督微调（SFT）、合成文档微调（SDF）、直接偏好优化（DPO）三种范式下开展多轮迭代自训练实验，每轮用当前模型生成的合成数据训练下一代模型，用LLM-as-judge评估特质强度与输出连贯性的变化。
summary.experiments: SFT与SDF场景下特质放大非常罕见，对超参数高度敏感，仅在极少量配置下出现，且放大伴随输出连贯性的显著下降；DPO场景下持续训练（不重新初始化模型）可稳定出现特质放大，若每轮重新初始化模型则特质保持或衰减；特质放大的阈值定义为连续4轮后特质得分较种子模型上升≥15分（满分100）。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点看实验设计与三类微调范式的结果对比部分，不需要深究单组实验的超参数细节，预计阅读时间12分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: The proportion of LLM-generated content on the internet keeps rising, so future pretraining corpora will include large volumes of outputs from predecessor models. It is necessary to clarify whether iterative fine-tuning on a model's own outputs will amplify existing behavioral tendencies such as sycophancy and misalignment.
summary_en.importance: It specifies the trait evolution rules of iterative self-training under different fine-tuning paradigms, provides empirical evidence for pretraining data filtering and risk control during alignment, and offers reference for the safety boundary of continual learning.
summary_en.technical_approach: Seed datasets for 7 different traits (including misalignment, misanthropy, sycophancy, etc.) are constructed, and multi-round iterative self-training experiments are conducted under three paradigms: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), Synthetic Document Fine-Tuning (SDF) and Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). For each round, synthetic data generated by the current model is used to train the next-generation model. LLM-as-judge is used to evaluate changes in trait strength and output coherence.
summary_en.experiments: Trait amplification is extremely rare in SFT and SDF scenarios, highly sensitive to hyperparameters, only occurs under very few configurations, and is accompanied by a significant drop in output coherence. In DPO scenarios, trait amplification occurs stably under continual training (without model reinitialization), while traits persist or decay if the model is reinitialized each round. Trait amplification is defined as a trait score increase of ≥15 points (out of 100) compared to the seed model after 4 consecutive cycles.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the experiment design section and result comparison across three fine-tuning paradigms. No need to dive into hyperparameter details of individual experiments. Expected reading time: 12 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看实验矩阵和 DPO 重置对照；它修正了“自举微调必然放大偏见”这个常见先验，但规模需打折。
recommendation.en: Read the experimental grid and the DPO reinitialization control; it usefully weakens the naive prior that self-training always amplifies traits.

paper.title: Structure Liberates: How Constrained Sensemaking Produces More Novel Research Output
paper.abstract: Scientific discovery is an extended process of ideation--surveying prior work, forming hypotheses, and refining reasoning--yet existing approaches treat this phase as a brief preamble despite its central role in research. We introduce SCISENSE, a sensemaking-grounded framework that operationalizes ideation as a structured sequence of eight cognitive stages (Pirolli \& Card, 2005). We construct SCISENSE-Traj, a 100K-scale dataset of citation-conditioned research trajectories in two modes: Target,

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的是科研 agent 的“上游规划”问题：现有系统往往把 ideation 当成很短的一段计划，导致后续代码生成、实验设计和论文写作都容易模板化、浅层化。作者要解决的核心问题不是如何直接提升某个下游科研 benchmark，而是如何把研究构思过程结构化、可监督化，并验证这种结构化 supervision 是否真的能带来更好的研究轨迹和更好的下游产物。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身的直接影响有限，它更接近 post-train / agent planning 数据构造与蒸馏工作。但它有两个可能的启发点。第一，它展示了“强约束 supervision 反而带来更高多样性”的现象，这对合成训练数据、trajectory distillation、甚至 reasoning data 设计都有参考价值。第二，它把 citation-conditioned 研究轨迹做成 100K 规模数据集，并区分 reconstructive Target 与 open-ended Infer 两种监督模式，这种数据构造思路对需要长程规划信号的模型训练是有借鉴意义的。若关心 pretrain-posttrain 接口，可以把它看成一种高结构化中间任务：不是直接教模型答案，而是教模型如何组织证据、形成研究计划。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 SciSense 框架。作者借用 sensemaking 理论，把科研 ideation 拆成八个有顺序的认知阶段，用 citation neighborhood 作为条件上下文，构造“研究轨迹”而不是单段 proposal。数据集 SciSense-Traj 有两种模式。Target 模式中，给定一篇目标论文及其引用文献，让模型从 cited works 反推一条通向该论文的合理 ideation trajectory；Infer 模式中，给定同样的引用上下文，但不锚定已知结果，而是让模型提出新的研究方向。作者随后用这些轨迹蒸馏出 SciSense-LM，模型规模从 3B 到 70B。

这篇论文最值得注意的点不是八阶段框架本身，而是监督信号设计。直觉上，开放式 Infer 似乎更有利于“创造性”；作者却发现 outcome-anchored 的 Target supervision 反而产生更高质量、也更有多样性的轨迹。论文给出的机制解释是：Target 轨迹更强调 Schema、Elaboration 这类建设性阶段，能把已有文献组织成更完整的解释框架；而 Infer 更容易过早进入 Hypothesis、Questioning，导致计划前段发散但后段支撑不足。也就是说，约束不是简单压缩搜索空间，而是在高维规划任务里提供了更稳定的结构先验。

从训练范式看，这更像一种 trajectory distillation：先用较强模型或流程生成结构化研究轨迹，再把这种能力蒸馏到不同规模的基础模型中。它不是基座预训练方法创新，但属于“如何构造高质量长链 supervision”的一类工作。
summary.experiments:
实验主结论很集中。Target 监督在不同模型家族和尺度上，都同时优于 Infer 的多样性和质量，没有出现常见的 quality-diversity tradeoff。文中给出的数字是：Target 在 aggregate plan quality 上比 Infer 高 2.0%，同时在多种自动多样性指标上也更强。作者还做了机制层面的 stage 分析，发现 Target 计划更偏向 Schema 和 Elaboration，Infer 则更偏向前置的 Hypothesis 和 Questioning。

更关键的是下游迁移实验。作者把这些 trajectory 用作 coding agent 的条件输入，发现 Target 轨迹能提升生成 scientific artifacts 的质量，尤其是在 scientific grounding 上更好，同时 executability 和 downstream utility 也有改善。这个结果说明上游规划不是装饰性文本，而会真实影响后续 agent 行为。

从规模上看，数据集是 100K 级，蒸馏模型覆盖 3B 到 70B。若精读实验部分，建议重点核对三件事：1）多样性指标是否只是 lexical variation，还是包含语义层面的差异；2）人工评测和自动评测是否一致；3）下游 coding agent 的提升幅度是否稳定，还是只在特定任务/模型上成立。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇更适合泛读，不建议当作基座预训练必读。阅读时先看 framework 和 dataset construction，弄清楚八阶段 sensemaking 是如何落到可训练样本上的。然后直接看 Target vs Infer 的主实验和 stage-distribution 分析，这两部分决定论文是否成立。最后看 downstream evaluation，判断这些结构化轨迹是否真的能改善后续科研 agent 输出。若只想抓住主要信息，25–35 分钟足够。

值得留意的点有两个。第一，Target supervision 的优势是否来自“更强约束”本身，还是来自它隐含地泄露了更接近真实论文分布的结构模板。第二，这种 citation-conditioned trajectory 是否会过度依赖已有文献邻域，导致生成更像“重组已有方向”而不是提出真正偏离分布的新问题。若关心训练数据设计，这两个问题比 benchmark 分数更重要。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper focuses on the upstream planning stage of research agents. Many current systems treat ideation as a short preamble, which often leads to shallow downstream code generation, experimentation, and writing. The core question is not how to improve a single scientific benchmark directly, but how to make the ideation process structured and supervisable, and whether that structured supervision actually yields better research trajectories and better downstream artifacts.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to pretraining is limited; this is closer to post-training, planning data construction, and trajectory distillation for research agents. Still, it offers two useful lessons. First, it reports an interesting result: stronger structural constraints can produce not only higher-quality outputs but also more diverse ones. That is relevant to synthetic data design, reasoning trajectory supervision, and long-horizon planning data. Second, it builds a 100K-scale citation-conditioned trajectory dataset with two supervision modes, Target and Infer, which is a useful template for training models on structured planning rather than final answers. For people interested in the pretrain–posttrain interface, this can be viewed as a highly structured intermediate task for teaching evidence organization and plan formation.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method centers on the SciSense framework. Drawing from sensemaking theory, the authors decompose research ideation into eight ordered cognitive stages and use citation neighborhoods as conditioning context, producing full research trajectories rather than short proposals. The dataset, SciSense-Traj, has two modes. In Target mode, given a target paper and its cited works, the model reconstructs a plausible ideation trajectory that could have led from those citations to the known paper. In Infer mode, given the same citation context, the model proposes novel directions without anchoring to a known outcome. These trajectories are then distilled into SciSense-LM models ranging from 3B to 70B.

The most interesting part is not the eight-stage framework by itself, but the supervision design. Intuitively, open-ended Infer supervision might seem more creative. The paper finds the opposite: outcome-anchored Target supervision produces trajectories that are both higher quality and more diverse. The proposed mechanism is that Target trajectories spend more effort on constructive stages such as Schema and Elaboration, which organize prior work into a coherent explanatory structure, whereas Infer trajectories overemphasize early Hypothesis and Questioning stages, leading to broader but less grounded plans. In that sense, the constraint is not merely narrowing the search space; it provides a stabilizing structural prior for a difficult planning problem.

From a training perspective, this is best understood as trajectory distillation: generate structured research plans with a stronger process, then transfer that planning behavior into smaller or more standard LLMs.
summary_en.experiments:
The main empirical result is consistent and simple: Target supervision beats Infer on both diversity and quality across model families and scales, without the usual quality–diversity tradeoff. The paper reports a 2.0% gain in aggregate plan quality for Target over Infer, while also showing stronger diversity under multiple automatic metrics. It also includes stage-level analysis showing that Target plans emphasize Schema and Elaboration, whereas Infer plans front-load Hypothesis and Questioning.

The downstream transfer result is more important than the planning metrics alone. When these trajectories are used to condition coding agents, Target trajectories improve the quality of generated scientific artifacts, especially scientific grounding, and also help executability and downstream utility. That suggests the planning text is not decorative; it changes downstream agent behavior in measurable ways.

In terms of scale, the dataset is around 100K trajectories and the distilled models span 3B to 70B. When reading the full experiments, the main things to verify are whether the diversity metrics capture semantic diversity rather than surface variation, whether human and automatic evaluations agree, and whether the downstream gains are robust across tasks and model choices.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper rather than a must-read for core pretraining. Start with the framework and dataset construction to understand how the eight-stage sensemaking process is operationalized into trainable trajectories. Then jump to the Target-vs-Infer comparison and the stage-distribution analysis; those sections carry the central claim. Finish with the downstream evaluation to judge whether structured trajectories materially improve research-agent outputs. A 25–35 minute pass should be enough.

Two questions are worth keeping in mind. First, is the advantage of Target supervision due to structure itself, or because it implicitly matches the distribution of real papers more closely? Second, does citation-conditioned planning encourage grounded synthesis at the cost of genuinely out-of-distribution ideas? Those questions matter more than the headline benchmark numbers if the goal is to learn from this work for training-data design.

recommendation.zh: 有个值得记的反直觉点：更强结构监督不一定压制探索；先看 Target vs Infer 的评测定义，若 judge 够干净，这个结论值得迁到 reasoning data 合成。
recommendation.en: The useful surprise is that tighter structural supervision may not reduce exploration; read the Target-vs-Infer evaluation carefully, and if the judges are clean, port the idea to reasoning-data synthesis.
